theorem bernoulliAverage_expect_comm_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {α : Type*} (A : Finset α)
    (p : ℝ) (f : (ι → Bool) → α → ℝ) :
    bernoulliAverage p (fun s => 𝔼 x ∈ A, f s x) =
      𝔼 x ∈ A, bernoulliAverage p (fun s => f s x)

statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_indicator_bounds_internal {n : ℕ} (A : Set (Fin n → Bool))
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp' : p ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ bernoulliAverage p (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∧
      bernoulliAverage p (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 1

statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_linear_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (p a b : ℝ) (f g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    bernoulliAverage p (fun x => a * f x + b * g x) =
      a * bernoulliAverage p f + b * bernoulliAverage p g

    (hA : IsLowerSet A)
    {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp' : p ≤ 1) (hq : q ≤ 1)
    (h : ℕ) (hh : (h : ℝ) * p ≤ q) :
    bernoulliAverage q (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      bernoulliAverage p (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ^ h

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_lowerSet_transfer_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_lowerSet_transfer_internal {n : ℕ} {A : Set (Fin n → Bool)}
    (hA : IsLowerSet A) (hA' : A.Nonempty) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr' : r ≤ 1 / 20) :
    (bernoulliAverage (1 / 4) (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) ^ (5 * r) ≤
      bernoulliAverage r (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_lowerSet_union_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_lowerSet_union_internal {n : ℕ} {A : Set (Fin n → Bool)}
    (hA : IsLowerSet A)
    {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp' : p ≤ 1) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq' : q ≤ 1) :
    bernoulliAverage (p + q - p * q) (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      bernoulliAverage p (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
        bernoulliAverage q (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

    (hmul : IsMultiplicative f) (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → Cube n) :
    f (∑ i ∈ s, g i) = ∏ i ∈ s, f (g i)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.multiplicative_zero
statement:
theorem multiplicative_zero (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f)
    (hmul : IsMultiplicative f) : f 0 = 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.parityFun_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parityFun_add (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x y : Cube n) :
    (χ S) (x + y) = (χ S) x * (χ S) y

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.parityFun_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parityFun_empty : (χ (∅ : Finset (Fin n))) = fun _ => 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.parityFun_isBoolean

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.parityFun_mul
statement:
theorem parityFun_mul (S T : Finset (Fin n)) (x : Cube n) :
    (χ S) x * (χ T) x = (χ (symmDiff S T)) x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.parityFun_mul_cancel
statement:
theorem parityFun_mul_cancel (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x y : Cube n) :
    (χ S) y * (χ S) (x + y) = (χ S) x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.parityFun_orthonormal

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.parityFun_orthonormal_proof

theorem parityFun_orthonormal_proof (S T : Finset (Fin n)) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.parityFun_sq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parityFun_sq (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : Cube n) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.parityFun_zero
statement:

theorem parityFun_zero (S : Finset (Fin n)) : (χ S) 0 = 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.parseval_boolean_proof
statement:
theorem parseval_boolean_proof (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.parseval_proof
statement:
theorem parseval_proof (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    ⟪f, f⟫ = ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), (𝓕 f S) ^ 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.plancherel_proof
statement:
theorem plancherel_proof (f g : BooleanFunction n) :
    ⟪f, g⟫ = ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), 𝓕 f S * 𝓕 g S

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.prob_boolean_sum_one
statement:
theorem prob_boolean_sum_one (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.prob_nonneg
statement: theorem prob_nonneg (P : Cube n → Prop) : 0 ≤ Pr[P]

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.prob_shift

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.setDensity_singleton_zero_proof

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.Internal.triple_expect_eq
statement:
theorem triple_expect_eq (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    𝔼[fun x => 𝔼[fun y => f x * f y * f (x + y)]] = ⟪f, f ⊛ f⟫

statement:
theorem variance_dist_bounds_arith (p q : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hpq : p + q = 1) :

theorem blr_completeness (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsLinear f) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.parseval
statement:
theorem parseval (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    ⟪f, f⟫ = ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), (𝓕 f S) ^ 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.parseval_boolean
statement:
theorem parseval_boolean (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :
    ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), (𝓕 f S) ^ 2 = 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.plancherel
statement:
theorem plancherel (f g : BooleanFunction n) :
    ⟪f, g⟫ = ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), (𝓕 f S) * (𝓕 g S)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.sensitivityOp_eq_parityFun_mul_derivative
statement:
theorem sensitivityOp_eq_parityFun_mul_derivative (i : Fin n) (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    sensitivityOp i f = fun x => (χ ({i} : Finset (Fin n))) x * (derivative i f) x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.setDensity_isDensity
statement:
theorem setDensity_isDensity (A : Finset (Cube n)) (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    IsDensity (setDensity A)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.setDensity_singleton_zero
statement:
theorem setDensity_singleton_zero :
    ∀ y : Cube n, setDensity ({0} : Finset (Cube n)) y =
      ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), (χ S) y

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.sq_expect_le_noiseStability
statement:
theorem sq_expect_le_noiseStability {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    𝔼[f] ^ 2 ≤ noiseStability ρ f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.sum_degreePart
statement:
theorem sum_degreePart (f : BooleanFunction n) (x : Cube n) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), degreePart f k x = f x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.sum_fourierCoeff_singleton_sq_eq_fourierWeightAtDegree_one
statement:
theorem sum_fourierCoeff_singleton_sq_eq_fourierWeightAtDegree_one (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, (𝓕 f {i}) ^ 2 = 𝐖 f 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.sum_fourierCoeff_singleton_sq_le_totalInfluence
statement:
theorem sum_fourierCoeff_singleton_sq_le_totalInfluence (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, (𝓕 f {i}) ^ 2 ≤ totalInfluence f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.sum_fourierWeightAtDegree
statement:
theorem sum_fourierWeightAtDegree (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 𝐖 f k = ⟪f, f⟫

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.sum_fourierWeightAtDegree_boolean
statement:
theorem sum_fourierWeightAtDegree_boolean (f : BooleanFunction n)
    (hf : IsBooleanValued f) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 𝐖 f k = 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_boolean_eq_expect_sensitive
statement:
theorem totalInfluence_boolean_eq_expect_sensitive (f : BooleanFunction n)
    (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :
    totalInfluence f
      = 𝔼[fun x => ∑ i : Fin n, if f x ≠ f (flipCoord i x) then (1 : ℝ) else 0]

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_boolean_le
statement:
theorem totalInfluence_boolean_le (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :
    totalInfluence f ≤ (n : ℝ)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_boolean_le_of_degree
statement:
theorem totalInfluence_boolean_le_of_degree (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : ∀ S : Finset (Fin n), d < S.card → 𝓕 f S = 0) :
    totalInfluence f ≤ (d : ℝ)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_eq_sum_influence
statement:
theorem totalInfluence_eq_sum_influence (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    totalInfluence f = ∑ i : Fin n, influence i f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_eq_sum_weight
statement:
theorem totalInfluence_eq_sum_weight (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    totalInfluence f = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (k : ℝ) * 𝐖 f k

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_le
statement: theorem totalInfluence_le (f : BooleanFunction n) : totalInfluence f ≤ (n : ℝ) * ⟪f, f⟫

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_le_of_degree
statement:
theorem totalInfluence_le_of_degree (f : BooleanFunction n) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ S : Finset (Fin n), d < S.card → 𝓕 f S = 0) :
    totalInfluence f ≤ (d : ℝ) * ⟪f, f⟫

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_nonneg
statement: theorem totalInfluence_nonneg (f : BooleanFunction n) : 0 ≤ totalInfluence f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_parityFun
statement:
theorem totalInfluence_parityFun (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    totalInfluence (χ S) = (S.card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.two_point_hypercontractive
statement:
theorem two_point_hypercontractive (a b : ℝ) :
    ((a + b / Real.sqrt 3) ^ 4 + (a - b / Real.sqrt 3) ^ 4) / 2 ≤ (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ^ 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_boolean
statement:
theorem variance_boolean (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :
    Var[f] = 1 - (𝔼[f]) ^ 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_boolean_le_one
statement:
theorem variance_boolean_le_one (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :
    Var[f] ≤ 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_boolean_nonneg
statement:
theorem variance_boolean_nonneg (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :
    0 ≤ Var[f]

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_boolean_prob
statement:
theorem variance_boolean_prob (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :
    Var[f] = 4 * Pr[fun x => f x = 1] * Pr[fun x => f x = -1]

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_dist_bounds
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_eq_self_inner_sub_fourierWeightAtDegree_zero
statement:
theorem variance_eq_self_inner_sub_fourierWeightAtDegree_zero (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    Var[f] = ⟪f, f⟫ - 𝐖 f 0

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_eq_sum_fourierCoeff_sq
statement:
theorem variance_eq_sum_fourierCoeff_sq (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    Var[f] = ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset (Fin n) => S ≠ ∅),
      (𝓕 f S) ^ 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_eq_sum_fourierWeightAtDegree_pos
statement:
theorem variance_eq_sum_fourierWeightAtDegree_pos (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    Var[f] = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, 𝐖 f (k + 1)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_le_totalInfluence
statement: theorem variance_le_totalInfluence (f : BooleanFunction n) : Var[f] ≤ totalInfluence f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_nonneg
statement: theorem variance_nonneg (f : BooleanFunction n) : 0 ≤ Var[f]

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_bool_internal
statement:
theorem expect_bool_internal (f : Bool → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 b, f b) = (f false + f true) / 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_pair_internal
statement:
theorem expect_pair_internal {β : Type*} [Fintype β] (f : α × β → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 x, f x) = 𝔼 a, 𝔼 b, f (a, b)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_average_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_average_internal {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    {f : β → α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ y x, 0 ≤ f y x) :
    (𝔼 y, harmonicMean (f y)) ≤ harmonicMean (fun x => 𝔼 y, f y x)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_concave_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_concave_internal {f g : α → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht' : t ≤ 1) :
    t * harmonicMean f + (1 - t) * harmonicMean g ≤
      harmonicMean (fun x => t * f x + (1 - t) * g x)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_const_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_const_internal (c : ℝ) :
    harmonicMean (fun _ : α => c) = c

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_equiv_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_equiv_internal {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (e : α ≃ β) (f : β → ℝ) : harmonicMean (fun x => f (e x)) = harmonicMean f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_exists_weight_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_exists_weight_internal {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    ∃ w : α → ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) ∧ (𝔼 x, w x) = 1 ∧
      (𝔼 x, f x * w x ^ 2) = harmonicMean f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_le_energy_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_le_energy_internal {f w : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hw : (𝔼 x, w x) = 1) : harmonicMean f ≤ 𝔼 x, f x * w x ^ 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_le_expect_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_le_expect_internal {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    harmonicMean f ≤ 𝔼 x, f x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_light_fraction_le_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_light_fraction_le_internal {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha' : a ≤ harmonicMean f) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    (𝔼 x, if f x ≤ b then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ b / a

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_mono_internal
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_nonneg_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_nonneg_internal {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    0 ≤ harmonicMean f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_pair_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_pair_internal {f : Bool → α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ b x, 0 ≤ f b x) :
    harmonicMean (fun x : Bool × α => f x.1 x.2) =
      2 * harmonicMean (f false) * harmonicMean (f true) /
        (harmonicMean (f false) + harmonicMean (f true))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_variational_internal
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_cons_internal
statement:
theorem expect_cons_internal {n : ℕ} (f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 x, f x) = ((𝔼 x, f (Fin.cons false x)) + (𝔼 x, f (Fin.cons true x))) / 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_cons_false_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_cons_false_internal {n : ℕ}
    (f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ) (selected : Fin n → Bool) :
    harmonicTransform f (Fin.cons false selected) =
      harmonicTransform
        (fun x => (f (Fin.cons false x) + f (Fin.cons true x)) / 2) selected

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_cons_true_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_cons_true_internal {n : ℕ}
    {f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (selected : Fin n → Bool) :
    harmonicTransform f (Fin.cons true selected) =
      2 * harmonicTransform (fun x => f (Fin.cons false x)) selected *
        harmonicTransform (fun x => f (Fin.cons true x)) selected /
      (harmonicTransform (fun x => f (Fin.cons false x)) selected +
        harmonicTransform (fun x => f (Fin.cons true x)) selected)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_const_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_const_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (c : ℝ) (selected : ι → Bool) : harmonicTransform (fun _ => c) selected = c

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_midpoint_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_midpoint_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {f g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x)
    (selected : ι → Bool) :
    (harmonicTransform f selected + harmonicTransform g selected) / 2 ≤
      harmonicTransform (fun x => (f x + g x) / 2) selected

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_nonneg_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_nonneg_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (selected : ι → Bool) :
    0 ≤ harmonicTransform f selected

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.projectionAverage_cons_false_internal
statement:
theorem projectionAverage_cons_false_internal {n : ℕ}
    (f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ) (selected x : Fin n → Bool) (b : Bool) :
    projectionAverage f (Fin.cons false selected) (Fin.cons b x) =
      projectionAverage (fun x => (f (Fin.cons false x) + f (Fin.cons true x)) / 2)
        selected x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.projectionAverage_cons_true_internal
statement:
theorem projectionAverage_cons_true_internal {n : ℕ}
    (f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ) (selected x : Fin n → Bool) (b : Bool) :
    projectionAverage f (Fin.cons true selected) (Fin.cons b x) =
      projectionAverage (fun x => f (Fin.cons b x)) selected x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.projectionAverage_midpoint_internal
statement:
theorem projectionAverage_midpoint_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (selected x : ι → Bool) :
    projectionAverage (fun x => (f x + g x) / 2) selected x =
      (projectionAverage f selected x + projectionAverage g selected x) / 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.projectionAverage_nonneg_internal
statement:
theorem projectionAverage_nonneg_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (selected x : ι → Bool) :
    0 ≤ projectionAverage f selected x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_sqrt_le_bernoulliAverage_sqrt_harmonicTransform_internal
statement:
theorem expect_sqrt_le_bernoulliAverage_sqrt_harmonicTransform_internal {n : ℕ}
    {f : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    (𝔼 x, Real.sqrt (f x)) ≤
      bernoulliAverage (1 / 4) (fun selected => Real.sqrt (harmonicTransform f selected))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_sqrt_pair_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_sqrt_pair_internal {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    (Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b) / 2 ≤
      3 / 4 * Real.sqrt ((a + b) / 2) + 1 / 4 * Real.sqrt (2 * a * b / (a + b))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicPair_le_midpoint_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicPair_le_midpoint_internal {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    2 * a * b / (a + b) ≤ (a + b) / 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicPair_mono_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicPair_mono_internal {a b c d : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hac : a ≤ c) (hbd : b ≤ d) : 2 * a * b / (a + b) ≤ 2 * c * d / (c + d)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_antitone_internal
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_concave_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_concave_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {f g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht' : t ≤ 1) (selected : ι → Bool) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_empty_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_empty_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) : harmonicTransform f (fun _ => false) = 𝔼 x, f x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_full_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_full_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) : harmonicTransform f (fun _ => true) = harmonicMean f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_le_expect_internal
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_good_probability_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_good_probability_internal {n : ℕ}
    {f : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hmean : (𝔼 x, f x) = 1)
    {B : ℝ} (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hbound : ∀ x, f x ≤ B) :
    1 / (2 * Real.sqrt B) ≤ bernoulliAverage (1 / 4)
      (fun selected => if 1 / (4 * B) ≤ harmonicTransform f selected then 1 else 0)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_coordinateMarginal_internal
statement:
theorem expect_coordinateMarginal_internal (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (selected : ι → Bool) :
    (𝔼 z, coordinateMarginal f selected z) = 𝔼 x, f x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_eq_harmonicMean_coordinateMarginal_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_eq_harmonicMean_coordinateMarginal_internal

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.projectionAverage_eq_coordinateMarginal_internal
statement:
theorem projectionAverage_eq_coordinateMarginal_internal
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (selected x : ι → Bool) :
    projectionAverage f selected x = coordinateMarginal f selected (fun i => x i)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.coordinateMarginal_light_fraction_le
statement:
theorem coordinateMarginal_light_fraction_le {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (selected : ι → Bool) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (ha' : a ≤ harmonicTransform f selected) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    (𝔼 z, if coordinateMarginal f selected z ≤ b then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ b / a

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_coordinateMarginal
statement:
theorem expect_coordinateMarginal (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (selected : ι → Bool) :

statement:
theorem expect_sqrt_le_bernoulliAverage_sqrt_harmonicTransform {n : ℕ}

statement:
theorem harmonicMean_mono {f g : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)

theorem harmonicTransform_good_probability {n : ℕ} {f : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ}

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_variational
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_variational {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (selected : ι → Bool) :
    harmonicTransform f selected = sInf {a : ℝ |
      ∃ w : ({i // selected i = true} → Bool) → ℝ,
        (∀ z, 0 ≤ w z) ∧ (𝔼 z, w z) = 1 ∧
          (𝔼 z, coordinateMarginal f selected z * w z ^ 2) = a}

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_reindex_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_reindex_internal {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (e : ι ≃ κ) (f : (κ → Bool) → ℝ)
    (s : ι → Bool) :
    harmonicTransform (fun y => f (fun j => y (e.symm j))) s =
      harmonicTransform f (fun j => s (e.symm j))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.projectionAverage_reindex_internal
statement:
theorem projectionAverage_reindex_internal {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (e : ι ≃ κ) (f : (κ → Bool) → ℝ)
    (s x : ι → Bool) :
    projectionAverage (fun y => f (fun j => y (e.symm j))) s x =
      projectionAverage f (fun j => s (e.symm j)) (fun j => x (e.symm j))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.coordinateMarginal_normalize_internal
statement:
theorem coordinateMarginal_normalize_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_sparse_good_probability_fin_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_sparse_good_probability_fin_internal {n : ℕ} {f : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ}

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bad_modifications_probability_aux_internal
statement:
theorem bad_modifications_probability_aux_internal (X : Finset (ι → Bool)) (hX : X.Nonempty)
    {k p q r : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hdef : uniformDeficit X ≤ k)
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp' : p ≤ 1) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq' : q ≤ 1)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr' : r ≤ 1 / (32768 * k))
    (hjoint : (p + q - p * q) * r = p * (1 - q)) :
    31 / 32 ≤ bernoulliAverage p (fun P => bernoulliAverage q (fun Q =>
      𝔼 x ∈ X, if (𝔼 y, if coordinateDensity X Q (resample P x y) <
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (-194 * k) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-k - 6) then 1 else 0))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.coordinateDensity_eq_projection_internal
statement:
theorem coordinateDensity_eq_projection_internal (X : Finset (ι → Bool)) (s x : ι → Bool) :
    coordinateDensity X s x =
      projectionAverage (fun y => if y ∈ X then 1 else 0) (fun i => !s i) x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.coordinateDensity_resample_union_internal
statement:
theorem coordinateDensity_resample_union_internal (X : Finset (ι → Bool)) (P Q x y : ι → Bool) :
    coordinateDensity X Q (resample P x y) =
      coordinateDensity X Q (resample (fun i => P i || Q i) x y)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.coordinateFiber_light_patterns_internal
statement:
theorem coordinateFiber_light_patterns_internal (X : Finset (ι → Bool)) (hX : X.Nonempty)
    (s : ι → Bool) {k r : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hdef : uniformDeficit X ≤ k)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr' : r ≤ 1 / (32768 * k)) :
    31 / 32 ≤ 𝔼 x ∈ X, bernoulliAverage r (fun R =>
      if uniformDeficit (coordinateFiber X s x) ≤ 64 * k ∧
        (𝔼 z, if coordinateMarginal (uniformDensity (coordinateFiber X s x)) R z ≤
          (2 : ℝ) ^ (-128 * k - 2) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-64 * k)
        then 1 else 0)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_coordinateMarginal_comp_internal
statement:
theorem expect_coordinateMarginal_comp_internal (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (s : ι → Bool) (g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 x, g (projectionAverage f s x)) = 𝔼 z, g (coordinateMarginal f s z)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.fiber_completion_density_internal
statement:
theorem fiber_completion_density_internal (X : Finset (ι → Bool)) (s x : ι → Bool)
    (hX : (coordinateFiber X s x).Nonempty) (R : {i // s i = true} → Bool)
    {k : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hd : uniformDeficit (coordinateFiber X s x) ≤ 64 * k)
    (hl : (𝔼 z, if coordinateMarginal (uniformDensity (coordinateFiber X s x)) R z ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (-128 * k - 2) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-64 * k)) :
    (𝔼 u, if coordinateDensity X (fun i => if h : s i = true then !R ⟨i, h⟩ else false)
      (completePattern s x u) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (-194 * k) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (-k - 6)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.fiber_completion_density_union_internal
statement:
theorem fiber_completion_density_union_internal (X : Finset (ι → Bool)) (P Q x : ι → Bool)
    (hx : x ∈ X) {k : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hd : uniformDeficit (coordinateFiber X (fun i => P i || Q i) x) ≤ 64 * k)
    (hl : (𝔼 z, if coordinateMarginal
      (uniformDensity (coordinateFiber X (fun i => P i || Q i) x))
      (fun i => P i && !Q i) z ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-128 * k - 2) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (-64 * k)) :
    (𝔼 y, if coordinateDensity X Q (resample P x y) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (-194 * k) then
      (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-k - 6)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.mirror_bad_modifications_probability_internal
statement:
theorem mirror_bad_modifications_probability_internal (X : Finset (ι → Bool)) (hX : X.Nonempty)
    {k p q : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hdef : uniformDeficit X ≤ k) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hq : q = 32768 * k * p) (hq' : q ≤ 1 / 2) :
    31 / 32 ≤ bernoulliAverage p (fun P => bernoulliAverage q (fun Q =>
      𝔼 x ∈ X, if (𝔼 y, if coordinateDensity X Q (resample P x y) <
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (-194 * k) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-k - 6) then 1 else 0))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.projectionAverage_const_mul_internal
statement:
theorem projectionAverage_const_mul_internal (a : ℝ) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (s x : ι → Bool) :
    projectionAverage (fun y => a * f y) s x = a * projectionAverage f s x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.projectionAverage_fiber_internal
statement:
theorem projectionAverage_fiber_internal (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (s x : ι → Bool)
    (R u : {i // s i = true} → Bool) :
    projectionAverage (fun z => f (completePattern s x z)) R u =
      projectionAverage f (fun i => if h : s i = true then R ⟨i, h⟩ else true)
        (completePattern s x u)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.projectionAverage_uniformDensity_fiber_internal
statement:
theorem projectionAverage_uniformDensity_fiber_internal (X : Finset (ι → Bool)) (s x : ι → Bool)
    (hX : (coordinateFiber X s x).Nonempty) (R u : {i // s i = true} → Bool) :
    projectionAverage (uniformDensity (coordinateFiber X s x)) R u =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ uniformDeficit (coordinateFiber X s x) *
        coordinateDensity X (fun i => if h : s i = true then !R ⟨i, h⟩ else false)
          (completePattern s x u)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.densityLimit_complement_internal
statement:
theorem densityLimit_complement_internal (X : Finset (ι → Bool)) (q t : ℝ) (z : ι → Bool) :
    bernoulliAverage q (fun Q => if coordinateDensity X Q z < (2 : ℝ) ^ (-t) then
      (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 1 - bernoulliAverage q
        (fun Q => if (2 : ℝ) ^ (-t) ≤ coordinateDensity X Q z then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_guidingDensity_internal
statement:
theorem expect_guidingDensity_internal (Y : Finset (ι → Bool)) (k : ℝ) (P x : ι → Bool) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_resample_internal
statement:
theorem expect_resample_internal (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (P : ι → Bool) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_resample_subset_le_internal
statement:
theorem expect_resample_subset_le_internal (X : Finset (ι → Bool)) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (P : ι → Bool) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.guidedAverage_bad_completion_internal
statement:
theorem guidedAverage_bad_completion_internal (X Y : Finset (ι → Bool)) (hX : X.Nonempty)
    {k p q : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hdef : uniformDeficit X ≤ k) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hq : q = 32768 * k * p) (hq' : q ≤ 1 / 2) :
    guidedAverage X Y p k (fun z => bernoulliAverage q (fun Q =>
      if coordinateDensity X Q z < (2 : ℝ) ^ (-194 * k) then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) ≤ 1 / 16

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.guidedAverage_bernoulli_internal
statement:
theorem guidedAverage_bernoulli_internal (X Y : Finset (ι → Bool)) (p q k : ℝ)
    (f : (ι → Bool) → (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    guidedAverage X Y p k (fun z => bernoulliAverage q (fun Q => f Q z)) =
      bernoulliAverage p (fun P => bernoulliAverage q (fun Q =>
        𝔼 x ∈ X, 𝔼 y, guidingDensity Y k P x y * f Q (resample P x y)))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.guidedAverage_bound_internal
statement:
theorem guidedAverage_bound_internal (X Y : Finset (ι → Bool)) {p k : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp' : p ≤ 1) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z) :
    guidedAverage X Y p k f ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (∑ z, f z) / X.card

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.guidedAverage_const_internal
statement:
theorem guidedAverage_const_internal (X Y : Finset (ι → Bool)) (hX : X.Nonempty) (p k c : ℝ) :
    guidedAverage X Y p k (fun _ => c) = c

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.guidedAverage_hits_internal
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.guidedAverage_linear_internal
statement:
theorem guidedAverage_linear_internal (X Y : Finset (ι → Bool)) (p k a b : ℝ)
    (f g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    guidedAverage X Y p k (fun z => a * f z + b * g z) =
      a * guidedAverage X Y p k f + b * guidedAverage X Y p k g

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.guidedAverage_mirror_mass_internal
statement:
theorem guidedAverage_mirror_mass_internal (X Y : Finset (ι → Bool)) (hX : X.Nonempty)
    {k p q : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hdef : uniformDeficit X ≤ k) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hq : q = 32768 * k * p) (hq' : q ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hlim : ∀ x ∈ X, IsDensityLimit Y p k x) :
    1 / 4 ≤ guidedAverage X Y p k
      (fun z => if z ∈ Y ∧ IsDensityLimit X q (194 * k) z then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.guidedAverage_mono_internal
statement:
theorem guidedAverage_mono_internal (X Y : Finset (ι → Bool)) {p k : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp' : p ≤ 1)
    {f g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hfg : ∀ z, f z ≤ g z) :
    guidedAverage X Y p k f ≤ guidedAverage X Y p k g

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.guidingDensity_hits_internal
statement:
theorem guidingDensity_hits_internal (Y : Finset (ι → Bool)) (k : ℝ) (P x : ι → Bool) :
    (if (2 : ℝ) ^ (-k) ≤ coordinateDensity Y P x then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      𝔼 y, guidingDensity Y k P x y * (if resample P x y ∈ Y then 1 else 0)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.guidingDensity_le_internal
statement:
theorem guidingDensity_le_internal (Y : Finset (ι → Bool)) {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 ≤ k)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.guidingDensity_nonneg_internal
statement:
theorem guidingDensity_nonneg_internal (Y : Finset (ι → Bool)) (k : ℝ) (P x y : ι → Bool) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.guidingDensity_small_event_internal
statement:
theorem guidingDensity_small_event_internal (Y : Finset (ι → Bool)) {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (P x : ι → Bool) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y) (hf' : ∀ y, f y ≤ 1) :
    (𝔼 y, guidingDensity Y k P x y * f y) ≤
      65 / 64 - (if (𝔼 y, f y) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-k - 6) then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.improved_mirror_set_internal
statement:
theorem improved_mirror_set_internal (X Y : Finset (ι → Bool)) (hX : X.Nonempty)
    {k p q : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hdef : uniformDeficit X ≤ k) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hq : q = 32768 * k * p) (hq' : q ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hlim : ∀ x ∈ X, IsDensityLimit Y p k x) :
    ∃ Y' : Finset (ι → Bool), Y' ⊆ Y ∧ Y'.Nonempty ∧ uniformDeficit Y' ≤ 2 * k + 2 ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Y', IsDensityLimit X q (194 * k) y

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.sum_expect_resample_internal

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.improved_mirror_set
statement:
theorem improved_mirror_set {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X Y : Finset (ι → Bool)) (hX : X.Nonempty) {k p q : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)

    ∃ Y' : Finset (ι → Bool), Y' ⊆ Y ∧ Y'.Nonempty ∧ uniformDeficit Y' ≤ 2 * k + 2 ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Y', IsDensityLimit X q (194 * k) y

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.mirror_bad_modifications_probability
statement:
theorem mirror_bad_modifications_probability {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X : Finset (ι → Bool)) (hX : X.Nonempty) {k p q : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)

name: Complexity.BP.eval_append

name: Complexity.BP.eval_cons

name: Complexity.BP.eval_nil

name: Complexity.BP.eval_postMul
statement:

    s.ncard ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (s ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}).ncard

name: Complexity.Frontier.Sweep.ncard_le
statement:
theorem ncard_le [Finite ι] [Finite U] {K : ℕ} (hS : RectangleFree S K) (hK : K ≤ S.ncard) :
    S.ncard ≤ (K - 1) ^ 2 * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range P.length, (P.transition t '' S).ncard

name: Complexity.Frontier.Sweep.ncard_le_of_small_sides
statement:
theorem ncard_le_of_small_sides [Finite ι] [Finite U] {KL KR : ℕ}
    (hKL : 1 < KL) (hK : KL ≤ S.ncard)
    (hsmall : ∀ t, ∀ x ∈ S, (P.pastSide t x).ncard < KL ∨ (P.futureSide t x).ncard < KR) :
    S.ncard ≤ (KL - 1) * (KR - 1) * P.transitionCount

name: Complexity.Frontier.Sweep.ncard_pastSide_length
statement:
theorem ncard_pastSide_length {x : ι → U} (hx : x ∈ S) :

name: Complexity.Frontier.Sweep.ncard_pastSide_zero_le
statement: theorem ncard_pastSide_zero_le (x : ι → U) : (P.pastSide 0 x).ncard ≤ 1

name: Complexity.Frontier.Sweep.pastSide_lt_or_futureSide_lt
statement:
theorem pastSide_lt_or_futureSide_lt {K : ℕ} (hS : RectangleFree S K) (t : ℕ) (x : ι → U) :
    (P.pastSide t x).ncard < K ∨ (P.futureSide t x).ncard < K

name: Complexity.Frontier.Sweep.Coherent.erase
statement:
theorem Coherent.erase (hP : P.Coherent) (t : ℕ) (x : ι → U) :

name: Complexity.Frontier.Sweep.Coherent.peers_eq_rectangle
statement:
theorem Coherent.peers_eq_rectangle (hP : P.Coherent) (t : ℕ) (x : ι → U) :

name: Complexity.Frontier.Sweep.abs_sumOn_le_of_budget
statement:
theorem abs_sumOn_le_of_budget [Finite ι] [Finite U] (hP : P.Coherent) (hL : 0 < P.length)
    {KL KR : ℕ} (hKL : 1 < KL) (hKR : 1 < KR)
    {w cost : (ι → U) → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hw : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ a)
    (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ cost x) (hrect : RectangleBudget w cost KL KR) :
    |sumOn w S| ≤ sumOn cost S + a * ((KL - 1) * (KR - 1) * P.transitionCount : ℕ)

name: Complexity.Frontier.RectangleBias.abs_sumOn_le_of_dependsOn
statement:
theorem RectangleBias.abs_sumOn_le_of_dependsOn [Finite ι] [Finite U]
    {f : (ι → U) → Bool} {K : ℕ} {β : ℝ} (hf : RectangleBias f K β)
    (hK : 1 < K) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) {S : Set (ι → U)} {R : Set ι}
    (hR : DependsOn (· ∈ S) R) (hle : K ≤ Nat.card U ^ Rᶜ.ncard) :
    |sumOn (fun x => boolSign (f x)) S| ≤ β * S.ncard + (Nat.card U * K ^ 2 : ℕ)

name: Complexity.Frontier.abs_boolSign

name: Complexity.Frontier.agreement_le_of_output_bias
statement:
theorem agreement_le_of_output_bias [Finite α] [Nonempty α] (f g : α → Bool) {β R : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ b : Bool, |sumOn (fun x => boolSign (f x)) {x | g x = b}| ≤
      β * ({x | g x = b}.ncard : ℝ) + R) :
    agreement f g ≤ (1 + β) / 2 + R / Nat.card α

name: Complexity.Frontier.agreement_not
statement:
theorem agreement_not [Finite α] [Nonempty α] (f g : α → Bool) :

name: Complexity.Frontier.sign_sum_eq
statement:
theorem sign_sum_eq [Finite α] (f g : α → Bool) :
    sumOn (fun x => boolSign (f x) * boolSign (g x)) univ =
      2 * ({x | f x = g x}.ncard : ℝ) - Nat.card α

name: Complexity.Frontier.sign_sum_split
statement:
theorem sign_sum_split [Finite α] (f g : α → Bool) :
    sumOn (fun x => boolSign (f x) * boolSign (g x)) univ =
      sumOn (fun x => boolSign (f x)) {x | g x = true} -
        sumOn (fun x => boolSign (f x)) {x | g x = false}

theorem sq_sum_bilinear_mul_two_pow_rank_le [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α]
    [DecidableEq β] (B : Matrix α β (ZMod 2)) (P : Finset (α → ZMod 2))
    (Q : Finset (β → ZMod 2)) (g : (α → ZMod 2) → ℝ) (h : (β → ZMod 2) → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ p, |g p| ≤ 1) (hh : ∀ q, |h q| ≤ 1) :
    (∑ p ∈ P, ∑ q ∈ Q, g p * h q * zsign (p ⬝ᵥ B.mulVec q)) ^ 2 * 2 ^ B.rank ≤
      P.card * Q.card * 2 ^ Fintype.card α * 2 ^ Fintype.card β

name: Complexity.Correlation.quad_merge
statement:
theorem quad_merge [Fintype ι] [Fintype X] [Fintype ↥Xᶜ] (Q : Matrix ι ι (ZMod 2))
    (u : X → ZMod 2) (v : ↥Xᶜ → ZMod 2) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, Q i j * merge X u v i * merge X u v j =
      (∑ i : X, ∑ j : X, Q i j * u i * u j) + (∑ i : ↥Xᶜ, ∑ j : ↥Xᶜ, Q i j * v i * v j) +
        u ⬝ᵥ (cutMatrix Q X).mulVec v

name: Complexity.TM.exists_reachesIn_of_rewindStep_frame
statement:
theorem exists_reachesIn_of_rewindStep_frame (tm : TM n)
    {rewindState targetState : tm.Q}
    (h_step_left : ∀ c : Cfg n tm.Q,
      c.state = rewindState →
      c.output.read ≠ Γ.start →
      c.output.cells 0 = Γ.start → (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.output.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      c.input.head ≥ 1 → (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.input.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      (∀ i, (c.work i).head ≥ 1) → (∀ i j, j ≥ 1 → (c.work i).cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      ∃ c', tm.step c = some c' ∧
        c'.state = rewindState ∧
        c'.output.head = c.output.head - 1 ∧
        c'.output.cells = c.output.cells ∧
        c'.input = c.input ∧ c'.work = c.work)
    (h_step_base : ∀ c : Cfg n tm.Q,
      c.state = rewindState →
      c.output.read = Γ.start →
      c.output.cells 0 = Γ.start → (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.output.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      c.input.head ≥ 1 → (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.input.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      (∀ i, (c.work i).head ≥ 1) → (∀ i j, j ≥ 1 → (c.work i).cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      ∃ c', tm.step c = some c' ∧
        c'.state = targetState ∧
        c'.output.head = 1 ∧
        c'.output.cells = c.output.cells ∧
        c'.input = c.input ∧ c'.work = c.work) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (c : Cfg n tm.Q),
    c.state = rewindState →
    c.output.cells 0 = Γ.start →
    (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.output.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
    c.output.head = p →
    c.input.head ≥ 1 → (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.input.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
    (∀ i, (c.work i).head ≥ 1) → (∀ i j, j ≥ 1 → (c.work i).cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
    ∃ c_target,
      tm.reachesIn (p + 1) c c_target ∧
      c_target.state = targetState ∧
      c_target.output.head = 1 ∧
      c_target.output.cells = c.output.cells ∧
      c_target.input = c.input ∧

name: Complexity.TM.exists_reachesIn_of_rewindStep_output
statement:
theorem exists_reachesIn_of_rewindStep_output (tm : TM n)
    {rewindState targetState : tm.Q}
    (h_step_left : ∀ c : Cfg n tm.Q,
      c.state = rewindState →
      c.output.read ≠ Γ.start →
      c.output.cells 0 = Γ.start →
      (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.output.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      ∃ c', tm.step c = some c' ∧
        c'.state = rewindState ∧
        c'.output.head = c.output.head - 1 ∧
        c'.output.cells = c.output.cells)
    (h_step_base : ∀ c : Cfg n tm.Q,
      c.state = rewindState →
      c.output.read = Γ.start →
      c.output.cells 0 = Γ.start →
      (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.output.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      ∃ c', tm.step c = some c' ∧
        c'.state = targetState ∧
        c'.output.head = 1 ∧
        c'.output.cells = c.output.cells) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (c : Cfg n tm.Q),
    c.state = rewindState →
    c.output.cells 0 = Γ.start →
    (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.output.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
    c.output.head = p →
    ∃ c_target,
      tm.reachesIn (p + 1) c c_target ∧
      c_target.state = targetState ∧
      c_target.output.head = 1 ∧
      c_target.output.cells = c.output.cells

name: Complexity.TM.exists_reachesIn_of_rewindStep_tape

theorem exists_reachesIn_of_rewindStep_tape (tm : TM n) (tape : Cfg n tm.Q → Tape)
    {rewindState targetState : tm.Q}
    (h_step_left : ∀ c : Cfg n tm.Q,
      c.state = rewindState →
      (tape c).read ≠ Γ.start →
      (tape c).cells 0 = Γ.start →
      (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → (tape c).cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      ∃ c', tm.step c = some c' ∧
        c'.state = rewindState ∧
        (tape c').head = (tape c).head - 1 ∧
        (tape c').cells = (tape c).cells)
    (h_step_base : ∀ c : Cfg n tm.Q,
      c.state = rewindState →
      (tape c).read = Γ.start →
      (tape c).cells 0 = Γ.start →
      (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → (tape c).cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      ∃ c', tm.step c = some c' ∧
        c'.state = targetState ∧
        (tape c').head = 1 ∧
        (tape c').cells = (tape c).cells) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (c : Cfg n tm.Q),
    c.state = rewindState →
    (tape c).cells 0 = Γ.start →
    (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → (tape c).cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
    (tape c).head = p →
    ∃ c_target,
      tm.reachesIn (p + 1) c c_target ∧
      c_target.state = targetState ∧
      (tape c_target).head = 1 ∧
      (tape c_target).cells = (tape c).cells

    (choices : Fin (T + U) → Bool) (c : Cfg n tm.Q) :
    tm.trace (T + U) choices c =
      tm.trace U (fun i => choices (Fin.natAdd T i))
        (tm.trace T (fun i => choices (Fin.castLE (Nat.le_add_right T U) i)) c)

      tm.trace U (fun i => choices (T + i.val))

    tm.trace (T + 2) choices c =
      tm.trace T (fun i => choices ⟨i.val + 2, by omega⟩)
        (tm.trace 2 (fun i => choices ⟨i.val, by omega⟩) c)

    tm.trace (T + 1) choices c =
      tm.trace T (fun i => choices ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩)
        (tm.trace 1 (fun _ => choices ⟨0, by omega⟩) c)

statement:
theorem HoareTime.exists_first_halt_time {tm : NTM n}
    {pre post : TapePred n} {bound : ℕ}
    (h : tm.HoareTime pre post bound)
    {inp : Tape} {work : Fin n → Tape} {out : Tape}
    (hpre : pre inp work out) (choices : Fin bound → Bool) :
    ∃ t, ∃ ht : t ≤ bound,
      tm.halted (tm.trace t (fun i => choices (Fin.castLE ht i))
        { state := tm.qstart, input := inp, work := work, output := out }) ∧
      ∀ s, (hs : s < t) →
        ¬ tm.halted (tm.trace s
          (fun i => choices (Fin.castLE (le_trans (Nat.le_of_lt hs) ht) i))
          { state := tm.qstart, input := inp, work := work, output := out })

    (h : tm.DecidesInTime L T) (x : List Bool) :
    tm.HoareTime
      (fun inp work out => inp = Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool) ∧
                           (work = fun _ => Tape.init []) ∧
                           out = Tape.init [])

                      (x ∉ L → out.cells 1 = Γ.zero))

name: Complexity.TM.AllTapesWF.transition
statement:
theorem AllTapesWF.transition {inp : Tape} {work : Fin n → Tape} {out : Tape}
    (h : AllTapesWF inp work out) :
    (transitionInput inp).head ≥ 1 ∧
    (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → (transitionInput inp).cells j ≠ Γ.start) ∧
    (∀ i, (transitionTape (work i)).head ≥ 1) ∧
    (∀ i j, j ≥ 1 → (transitionTape (work i)).cells j ≠ Γ.start) ∧
    (transitionTape out).cells = out.cells ∧
    (transitionTape out).head ≥ 1

statement:
theorem complementTM_hoareTime (tm : TM n)
    {pre : TapePred n} {b p_bound : ℕ}
    {cell1_pred : Γ → Prop}
    (h_tm : tm.HoareTime pre
      (fun _ _ out =>
        out.cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
        (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → out.cells j ≠ Γ.start) ∧
        out.head ≤ p_bound ∧
        cell1_pred (out.cells 1))
      b) :
    tm.complementTM.HoareTime pre
      (fun _ _ out => ∃ g, cell1_pred g ∧ out.cells 1 = (flipBit g).toΓ)
      (b + p_bound + 4)

name: Complexity.TM.ifTM_hoareTime
statement:
theorem ifTM_hoareTime (tmTest tmThen tmElse : TM n)
    {pre mid_test mid_then mid_else post_then post_else post : TapePred n}
    {b_test b_then b_else p_bound : ℕ}
    (h_test : tmTest.HoareTime pre mid_test b_test)
    (h_wf : ∀ inp work out, mid_test inp work out → AllTapesWF inp work out)
    (h_head : ∀ inp work out, mid_test inp work out → out.head ≤ p_bound)
    (h_to_then : ∀ inp work out, mid_test inp work out → out.cells 1 = Γ.one →
      mid_then (transitionInput inp) (fun i => transitionTape (work i))
               ⟨1, out.cells⟩)
    (h_to_else : ∀ inp work out, mid_test inp work out → out.cells 1 ≠ Γ.one →
      mid_else (transitionInput inp) (fun i => transitionTape (work i))
               ⟨1, out.cells⟩)
    (h_then : tmThen.HoareTime mid_then post_then b_then)
    (h_else : tmElse.HoareTime mid_else post_else b_else)
    (h_post_then : ∀ inp work out, post_then inp work out →
      post (transitionInput inp) (fun i => transitionTape (work i))
           (transitionTape out))
    (h_post_else : ∀ inp work out, post_else inp work out →
      post (transitionInput inp) (fun i => transitionTape (work i))
           (transitionTape out)) :
    (ifTM tmTest tmThen tmElse).HoareTime pre post
      (b_test + p_bound + max b_then b_else + 5)

name: Complexity.TM.loopTM_hoareTime
statement:
theorem loopTM_hoareTime (tmBody tmTest : TM n)
    {inv post : TapePred n} {b_iter k : ℕ}
    {variant : Tape → (Fin n → Tape) → Tape → ℕ}
    (h_variant_bound : ∀ inp work out, inv inp work out → variant inp work out ≤ k)
    (h_iter : ∀ inp work out, inv inp work out →
      (∃ c' t, t ≤ b_iter ∧
        (loopTM tmBody tmTest).reachesIn t
          ⟨(loopTM tmBody tmTest).qstart, inp, work, out⟩ c' ∧
        (loopTM tmBody tmTest).halted c' ∧
        post c'.input c'.work c'.output)
      ∨
      (∃ inp' work' out' t, t ≤ b_iter ∧
        (loopTM tmBody tmTest).reachesIn t
          ⟨(loopTM tmBody tmTest).qstart, inp, work, out⟩
          ⟨(loopTM tmBody tmTest).qstart, inp', work', out'⟩ ∧
        inv inp' work' out' ∧
        variant inp' work' out' < variant inp work out)) :
    (loopTM tmBody tmTest).HoareTime inv post ((k + 1) * b_iter)

    (x y : List Bool) :

      (fun inp work out =>
        inp = (Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool)).move Dir3.right ∧
        work counterIdx = (Tape.init []).move Dir3.right ∧
        work passiveIdx = (Tape.init (y.map Γ.ofBool)).move Dir3.right ∧
        out = (Tape.init []).move Dir3.right)
      (fun inp work out =>
        inp.cells = (Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool)).cells ∧
        inp.head = x.length + 1 ∧
        work passiveIdx = (Tape.init (y.map Γ.ofBool)).move Dir3.right ∧
        (work counterIdx).HasUnaryCounter (x.length + 1) ∧
        (work counterIdx).cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
        (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → (work counterIdx).cells j ≠ Γ.start) ∧
        out = (Tape.init []).move Dir3.right)

    (emitBitsTM (n := n) w).HoareTime
      (fun inp work out => inp = inp₀ ∧ work = work₀ ∧ OutAcc ys out)

    (hinp₀ : Parked inp₀) (hwork₀ : ∀ i, Parked (work₀ i))
    (hout₀ : OutAcc ys out₀) :
    ∃ c',
      (emitBitsTM (n := n) w).reachesIn w.length
        { state := (emitBitsTM (n := n) w).qstart
          input := inp₀
          work := work₀
          output := out₀ } c' ∧

      OutAcc (ys ++ w) c'.output

      (EmitPred inp₀ work₀ ys)

name: Complexity.Frontier.eventually_lt_of_demand
statement:
theorem eventually_lt_of_demand {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ η₀ > 0, ∀ η, 0 < η → η ≤ η₀ → ∀ (C : ℝ) (e : ℕ → ℝ), e =o[atTop] (fun n => (n : ℝ)) →
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ s v w : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ v → v ≤ κ * (n + s + 1) →
        (n : ℝ) ≤ w + e n + κ * Real.log (v + 1) →
        w ≤ (A + η) * (s - n + e n) + η * v + C →
        (1 + 1 / A - ε) * n < s

name: Complexity.Frontier.isLittleO_log_affine
statement:
theorem isLittleO_log_affine {α β : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hβ : 1 ≤ β) :
    (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (α * n + β)) =o[atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ)

name: Complexity.Frontier.div_two_pow_le_of_logb
statement:
theorem div_two_pow_le_of_logb {x γ : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (h : Real.logb 2 x ≤ (1 - γ) * n) :
    x / (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-γ * n)

name: Complexity.Frontier.eventually_frontier_log_error
statement:
theorem eventually_frontier_log_error {A ε γ : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hγ1 : γ < 1) (hγε : γ < A * ε) (K : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hK : (fun n => Real.log (K n)) =o[atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ)) :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      1 + 2 * Real.logb 2 (K n) ≤ (1 - γ) * n ∧
      ∀ s v w : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ v → s ≤ (1 + 1 / A - ε) * n → v ≤ 4 * s + 3 →
        w ≤ (A + η) * (s - n + Real.logb 2 (K n) + 1) + η * v + C →
        w + 4 + 3 * Real.logb 2 (K n) + Real.logb 2 (v + 1) ≤ (1 - γ) * n

name: Complexity.Frontier.Sweep.abs_sumOn_le_codes
statement:
theorem abs_sumOn_le_codes (hP : P.Coherent) (hL : 0 < P.length)
    {D : ℕ → Type*} (code : ∀ t, (ι → U) → D t) (C : ∀ t, Set (D t))
    (hC : ∀ t < P.length, (C t).Finite)
    (hmem : ∀ t < P.length, ∀ x ∈ S, code t x ∈ C t)
    (hdet : ∀ t < P.length, ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S,
      code t x = code t y → P.transition t x = P.transition t y)
    {KL KR : ℕ} (hKL : 1 < KL) (hKR : 1 < KR)
    {w cost : (ι → U) → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hw : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ a)
    (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ cost x) (hrect : Frontier.RectangleBudget w cost KL KR) :
    |Frontier.sumOn w S| ≤ Frontier.sumOn cost S +
      a * ((KL - 1) * (KR - 1) * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range P.length, (C t).ncard : ℕ)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Sweep.transitionCount_le_codes
statement:
theorem transitionCount_le_codes {D : ℕ → Type*}
    (code : ∀ t, (ι → U) → D t) (C : ∀ t, Set (D t))
    (hC : ∀ t < P.length, (C t).Finite)
    (hmem : ∀ t < P.length, ∀ x ∈ S, code t x ∈ C t)
    (hdet : ∀ t < P.length, ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S,
      code t x = code t y → P.transition t x = P.transition t y) :
    P.transitionCount ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range P.length, (C t).ncard

name: Complexity.Frontier.Sweep.transitionCount_le_linear_codes
statement:
theorem transitionCount_le_linear_codes (L : ℕ → (ι → F) →ₗ[F] W)
    (hdet : ∀ t < P.length, ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S,
      L t x = L t y → P.transition t x = P.transition t y) :
    P.transitionCount ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range P.length,
      Nat.card F ^ Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range (L t))

name: Complexity.Frontier.LayoutBound.exists_layout_componentwise
statement:
theorem LayoutBound.exists_layout_componentwise {d : ℕ} {A : ℝ} (h : LayoutBound d A) {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (V E : Type) [Finite V] [Finite E] (G : Multigraph V E),
      G.Loopless → G.MaxDegreeLE d →
        ∃ π : Layout V, ∀ t (ht : t < Nat.card V), ∃ W : Set V,
          π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩ ∈ W ∧ G.cut W = ∅ ∧ W.ncard ≤ (G.touching W).ncard + 1 ∧
          G.cut (π.initial t) ⊆ G.touching W ∧ G.cut (π.initial (t + 1)) ⊆ G.touching W ∧
          ((G.cut (π.initial t)).ncard : ℝ) ≤
            (A + η) * G.cycleRankOn W + η * Nat.card V + C ∧
          ((G.cut (π.initial (t + 1))).ncard : ℝ) ≤
            (A + η) * G.cycleRankOn W + η * Nat.card V + C

statement:

name: Complexity.Frontier.Multigraph.exists_spanning_tree

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_kernel_mul_ge
statement:
theorem sum_kernel_mul_ge (degree : ∀ v, H.degree v ≤ 3) (q : ℝ) (R : ℕ) {u v : W}
    (huv : H.Adj u v) :
    2 * q / (1 + q ^ 2) * ((∑ z, kernel H q R u z ^ 2) + ∑ z, kernel H q R v z ^ 2) / 2 -
        3 * (2 * q ^ 2) ^ R ≤ ∑ z, kernel H q R u z * kernel H q R v z

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_kernel_mul_ge_degree
statement:
theorem sum_kernel_mul_ge_degree {D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (degree : ∀ v, H.degree v ≤ D)
    (q : ℝ) (R : ℕ) {u v : W}
    (huv : H.Adj u v) :
    2 * q / (1 + q ^ 2) * ((∑ z, kernel H q R u z ^ 2) + ∑ z, kernel H q R v z ^ 2) / 2 -
        D * ((D - 1 : ℕ) * q ^ 2) ^ R ≤ ∑ z, kernel H q R u z * kernel H q R v z

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_unitKernel_mul_ge

theorem sum_unitKernel_mul_ge (degree : ∀ v, H.degree v ≤ 3) {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (R : ℕ)
    {u v : W} (huv : H.Adj u v) :
    2 * q / (1 + q ^ 2) - 3 * (2 * q ^ 2) ^ R ≤
      ∑ z, unitKernel H q R u z * unitKernel H q R v z

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_unitKernel_mul_ge_degree
statement:
theorem sum_unitKernel_mul_ge_degree {D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (degree : ∀ v, H.degree v ≤ D)
    {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (R : ℕ)
    {u v : W} (huv : H.Adj u v) :
    2 * q / (1 + q ^ 2) - D * ((D - 1 : ℕ) * q ^ 2) ^ R ≤
      ∑ z, unitKernel H q R u z * unitKernel H q R v z

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_unitKernel_sq
statement: theorem sum_unitKernel_sq (q : ℝ) (R : ℕ) (v : W) : ∑ z, unitKernel H q R v z ^ 2 = 1

name: Complexity.Frontier.LocalLayout.cutSize_improve_cubic_le
statement:
theorem cutSize_improve_cubic_le (I : Finset V)
    (hI : ∀ e, ¬(G.src e ∈ I ∧ G.tgt e ∈ I))
    (edges : ∀ v, Fin 3 ≃ G.edgesAt v) (key : V → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    G.cutSize (fun v => decide (improve I
      (fun v i => G.otherEnd v (edges v i).1) key v < t)) ≤
        G.cutSize (fun v => decide (key v < t))

name: Complexity.Frontier.LocalLayout.cutSize_improve_le
statement:
theorem cutSize_improve_le (I : Finset V) (hI : ∀ e, ¬(G.src e ∈ I ∧ G.tgt e ∈ I))
    (neighbours : V → Fin 3 → V)
    (hstar : ∀ v ∈ I, ∀ c : V → Bool,
      G.localCut c v = disagreements3 (c v) (fun i => c (neighbours v i)))
    (hout : ∀ v ∈ I, ∀ i, neighbours v i ∉ I) (key : V → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    G.cutSize (fun v => decide (improve I neighbours key v < t)) ≤
      G.cutSize (fun v => decide (key v < t))

name: Complexity.Frontier.LocalLayout.disagreements_median3_le
statement:
theorem disagreements_median3_le (k : Fin 3 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (c : Bool) :
    disagreements3 (decide (median3 (k 0) (k 1) (k 2) < t)) (fun i => decide (k i < t)) ≤
      disagreements3 c (fun i => decide (k i < t))

name: Complexity.Frontier.LocalLayout.improve_of_mem
statement:
theorem improve_of_mem {I : Finset V} (neighbours : V → Fin 3 → V) (key : V → ℝ)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ I) : improve I neighbours key v =
      median3 (key (neighbours v 0)) (key (neighbours v 1)) (key (neighbours v 2))

name: Complexity.Frontier.LocalLayout.improve_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem improve_of_not_mem {I : Finset V} (neighbours : V → Fin 3 → V) (key : V → ℝ)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∉ I) : improve I neighbours key v = key v

name: Complexity.Frontier.LocalLayout.localCut_eq_star
statement:
theorem localCut_eq_star (v : V) (edges : Fin 3 ≃ G.edgesAt v) (c : V → Bool) :

name: Complexity.Frontier.LocalLayout.otherEnd_notMem
statement:
theorem otherEnd_notMem (I : Finset V) (hI : ∀ e, ¬(G.src e ∈ I ∧ G.tgt e ∈ I))

name: Complexity.Frontier.Multigraph.crossing_eq_otherEnd
statement:
theorem crossing_eq_otherEnd (c : V → Bool) (v : V) {e : E} (he : G.Incident v e) :

name: Complexity.Frontier.Multigraph.cutSize_add_local_eq
statement:
theorem cutSize_add_local_eq (I : Finset V) (hI : ∀ e, ¬(G.src e ∈ I ∧ G.tgt e ∈ I))
    (c c' : V → Bool) (hfix : ∀ v, v ∉ I → c' v = c v) :
    G.cutSize c' + ∑ v ∈ I, G.localCut c v =
      G.cutSize c + ∑ v ∈ I, G.localCut c' v

name: Complexity.Frontier.Multigraph.cutSize_eq_add_gain
statement:
theorem cutSize_eq_add_gain (I : Finset V) (hI : ∀ e, ¬(G.src e ∈ I ∧ G.tgt e ∈ I))
    (c c' : V → Bool) (hfix : ∀ v, v ∉ I → c' v = c v)
    (hlocal : ∀ v ∈ I, G.localCut c' v ≤ G.localCut c v) :
    G.cutSize c = G.cutSize c' + ∑ v ∈ I, (G.localCut c v - G.localCut c' v)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Multigraph.cutSize_lt_of_local

name: Complexity.Frontier.Multigraph.card_cut_le_grid
statement:
theorem card_cut_le_grid {d : ℕ} (degree : G.MaxDegreeLE d) (score : W → ℝ)
    (P : Finset W) {m a δ : ℝ} (hP : ∀ v ∈ P, score v ≤ m)
    (hPc : ∀ v ∉ P, m ≤ score v) (hδ : 0 < δ) (M : ℕ) {B : ℝ}
    (low : d * (#{v | score v < a} : ℝ) ≤ B)
    (high : d * (#{v | a + M * δ ≤ score v} : ℝ) ≤ B)
    (mid : ∀ i < M,
      ((G.crossingFinset {v | score v < a + i * δ}).card : ℝ) +
        d * #{v | a + i * δ ≤ score v ∧ score v < a + (i + 1) * δ} ≤ B) :
    ((G.crossingFinset P).card : ℝ) ≤ B

name: Complexity.Frontier.Multigraph.exists_key_of_vertexScore
statement:
theorem exists_key_of_vertexScore {d : ℕ} (degree : G.MaxDegreeLE d) (score : W → ℝ)
    {a δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (M : ℕ) {B : ℝ}
    (low : d * (#{v | score v < a} : ℝ) ≤ B)
    (high : d * (#{v | a + M * δ ≤ score v} : ℝ) ≤ B)
    (mid : ∀ i < M,
      ((G.crossingFinset {v | score v < a + i * δ}).card : ℝ) +
        d * #{v | a + i * δ ≤ score v ∧ score v < a + (i + 1) * δ} ≤ B) :
    ∃ key : W → ℕ, Function.Injective key ∧ ∀ t,
      ((G.crossingFinset {v | key v < t}).card : ℝ) ≤ B

name: Complexity.Frontier.Multigraph.mem_crossingFinset_iff

      u ∈ P ∧ v ∉ P

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussPi_abs_le_mul_abs
statement:
theorem gaussPi_abs_le_mul_abs (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) :
    (gaussPi (Fin 2)).real {ω | |ω 0| ≤ k * |ω 1|} = 2 / Real.pi * Real.arctan k

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussPi_between_le_arccos
statement:
theorem gaussPi_between_le_arccos {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] {α β : ι → ℝ}
    (hα : ∑ i, α i ^ 2 = 1) (hβ : ∑ i, β i ^ 2 = 1) (hx : -1 < ∑ i, α i * β i) (t : ℝ) :
    (gaussPi ι).real {ω | Between t (form α ω) (form β ω)} ≤
      Real.arccos (∑ i, α i * β i) / Real.pi

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussPi_between_le_arctan
statement:
theorem gaussPi_between_le_arctan {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (α β : ι → ℝ)
    (hnorm : ∑ i, α i ^ 2 = ∑ i, β i ^ 2) (hsum : 0 < ∑ i, (α i + β i) ^ 2) (t : ℝ) :
    (gaussPi ι).real {ω | Between t (form α ω) (form β ω)} ≤
      2 / Real.pi *
        Real.arctan (Real.sqrt (∑ i, (β i - α i) ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (∑ i, (α i + β i) ^ 2))

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussPi_map_form
statement:
theorem gaussPi_map_form (a : ι → ℝ) :
    (gaussPi ι).map (form a) = gaussianReal 0 (∑ i, a i ^ 2).toNNReal

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussPi_map_form_pair
statement:
theorem gaussPi_map_form_pair (a b : ι → ℝ) (hab : ∑ i, a i * b i = 0) :
    (gaussPi ι).map (fun ω => (form a ω, form b ω)) =
      (gaussianReal 0 (∑ i, a i ^ 2).toNNReal).prod
        (gaussianReal 0 (∑ i, b i ^ 2).toNNReal)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussPi_tail_le
statement:
theorem gaussPi_tail_le (α : ι → ℝ) (hα : ∑ i, α i ^ 2 = 1)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    (gaussPi ι).real {ω | T ≤ |form α ω|} ≤ 1 / T ^ 2

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussPi_window_le
statement:
theorem gaussPi_window_le (α : ι → ℝ) (hα : ∑ i, α i ^ 2 = 1)
    (s : ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (gaussPi ι).real {ω | s ≤ form α ω ∧ form α ω < s + δ} ≤ δ / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussianReal_Icc_le

theorem gaussianReal_Icc_le (v : ℝ≥0) (c w : ℝ) :

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.le_inner_of_le_inner
Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_arccos_le
Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_arccos_star_le
statement:
theorem sum_arccos_star_le {ι J : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq J] {x : ι → ℝ}
    (hx : ∑ i, x i ^ 2 = 1) (s : Finset J) (hs : s.card = 3) (y : J → ι → ℝ)
    (hy : ∀ j ∈ s, ∑ i, y j i ^ 2 = 1) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 7 / 8 ≤ κ)
    (hyx : ∀ j ∈ s, κ ≤ ∑ i, y j i * x i) :
    ∑ j ∈ s, ∑ j' ∈ s.erase j, Real.arccos (∑ i, y j i * y j' i) ≤
      6 * Real.arccos ((3 * κ ^ 2 - 1) / 2)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_inner_ordered_pairs_ge
statement:
theorem sum_inner_ordered_pairs_ge {ι J : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq J] {x : ι → ℝ}
    (hx : ∑ i, x i ^ 2 = 1) (s : Finset J) (y : J → ι → ℝ)
    (hy : ∀ j ∈ s, ∑ i, y j i ^ 2 = 1) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (hyx : ∀ j ∈ s, κ ≤ ∑ i, y j i * x i) :
    (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * κ ^ 2 - s.card ≤
      ∑ j ∈ s, ∑ j' ∈ s.erase j, ∑ i, y j i * y j' i

name: Complexity.Frontier.Network.ncard_accepted_le
statement:
theorem ncard_accepted_le [Finite ι] [Finite U] [Finite E] {K : ℕ}
    (hfree : RectangleFree N.accepted K) (hK : K ≤ N.accepted.ncard)
    {w d m : ℕ} (hw : ∀ t, (N.frontier π t).ncard ≤ w) (hd : N.MaxDegreeLE d)
    (hm : ∀ v, (N.readAt v).ncard ≤ m) :
    N.accepted.ncard ≤
      (K - 1) ^ 2 * (Nat.card V * Nat.card U ^ (w + d + m) + Nat.card U ^ N.readᶜ.ncard)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Network.ncard_accepted_le_labels
statement:
theorem ncard_accepted_le_labels [Finite ι] [Finite U] {Λ : Type*} [Finite Λ]
    (label : E → Λ) (value : (ι → U) → Λ → U)
    (hval : ∀ x ∈ N.accepted, ∀ e, N.witness x e = value x (label e))
    {K b : ℕ} (hfree : RectangleFree N.accepted K) (hK : K ≤ N.accepted.ncard)
    (hb : ∀ t, ∀ ht : t < Nat.card V,
      (label '' (N.frontier π t ∪ N.frontier π (t + 1))).ncard +
        (N.readAt (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)).ncard ≤ b) :
    N.accepted.ncard ≤ (K - 1) ^ 2 *
      (Nat.card V * Nat.card U ^ b + Nat.card U ^ N.readᶜ.ncard)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Network.ncard_transition_last_le
statement:

      ((fun x => (extra (Nat.card V) x, extra (Nat.card V + 1) x)) '' S).ncard *

name: Complexity.Frontier.Network.ncard_transition_le
statement:
theorem ncard_transition_le [Finite ι] [Finite U] [Finite E] {t : ℕ} (ht : t < Nat.card V) :
    ((N.frontierSweep π val extra hlast hsplice).transition t '' S).ncard ≤
      ((fun x => (extra t x, extra (t + 1) x)) '' S).ncard *
        Nat.card U ^ ((N.frontier π t ∪ N.frontier π (t + 1)).ncard +
          (N.readAt (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)).ncard)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Network.ncard_transition_le_of_touching
statement:
theorem ncard_transition_le_of_touching [Finite ι] [Finite U] {t : ℕ} (ht : t < Nat.card V)
    {W : Set V} (hv : π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩ ∈ W)
    (hC : N.frontier π t ∪ N.frontier π (t + 1) ⊆ N.touching W)
    (hdet : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, extra t x = extra t y → extra (t + 1) x = extra (t + 1) y →
      EqOn x y (N.readIn W) → EqOn (val x) (val y) (N.touching W)) :
    ((N.frontierSweep π val extra hlast hsplice).transition t '' S).ncard ≤
      ((fun x => (extra t x, extra (t + 1) x)) '' S).ncard *
        Nat.card U ^ (N.readIn W).ncard

name: Complexity.Frontier.TreeFrontier.abs_sumOn_le_of_budget

theorem abs_sumOn_le_of_budget [Finite ι] [Finite U] [Fintype N]
    (hP : P.Coherent) {K : ℕ} (hK : 1 < K)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Network.abs_sumOn_accepted_le_tree
statement:
theorem abs_sumOn_accepted_le_tree [Finite ι] [Finite U] [Finite E] [Fintype B]
    (hlam : ∀ u v, T.region u ⊆ T.region v ∨ T.region v ⊆ T.region u ∨
      Disjoint (T.region u) (T.region v))
    (hunique : ∀ x α β, G.Satisfies x α → G.Satisfies x β → α = β)
    {K : ℕ} (hK : 1 < K) {w cost : (ι → U) → ℝ} {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hw : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ a) (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ cost x)
    (hrect : RectangleBudget w cost K K) :
    |sumOn w G.accepted| ≤ sumOn cost G.accepted + a * ((K - 1) ^ 3 *
      ∑ v, Nat.card U ^ ((G.cut (T.region v) ∪ G.cut (T.region (T.left v)) ∪
        G.cut (T.region (T.right v))).ncard +
          ((G.treeFrontier T hread).localInputs v).ncard) : ℕ)

statement:
theorem run_swapPlayers_internal {ι M : Type*} :
    ∀ {d : ℕ} (P : RoundProtocol ι M d) (x y : ι → Bool),
    P.swapPlayers.run x y = P.run y x
  | _, .answer _, _, _ => rfl
  | _, .alice send next, x, y => run_swapPlayers_internal (next (send y)) x y
  | _, .bob send next, x, y => run_swapPlayers_internal (next (send x)) x y

name: Complexity.KarchmerWigderson.RoundProtocol.SolvesKW.swapPlayers

theorem SolvesKW.swapPlayers {ι M : Type*} {d : ℕ} {P : RoundProtocol ι M d}

name: Complexity.KarchmerWigderson.RoundProtocol.run_swapPlayers
statement:
theorem run_swapPlayers {ι M : Type*} {d : ℕ} (P : RoundProtocol ι M d) (x y : ι → Bool) :

name: Complexity.KarchmerWigderson.finite_budget_of_cost_internal

theorem finite_budget_of_cost_internal {n d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_coordinate_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_coordinate_internal (p : ℝ) (i : ι) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_nonempty_internal

theorem bernoulliAverage_nonempty_internal (p : ℝ) :
    bernoulliAverage p (fun P : ι → Bool => if ∃ i, P i = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.one_sub_pow_bound_internal
statement:
theorem one_sub_pow_bound_internal {p : ℝ} (hp' : p ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) :

name: Complexity.blockAppend_fst_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockAppend_fst_snd (a b : ℕ) (w : Fin (a + b) → Bool) :

name: Complexity.blockEventCount_add_compl
statement:
theorem blockEventCount_add_compl {k T : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool))
    (w : Fin (k * T) → Bool) :
    blockEventCount E w + blockEventCount Eᶜ w = k

name: Complexity.blockFst_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockFst_append (a b : ℕ) (u : Fin a → Bool) (v : Fin b → Bool) :
    blockFst a b (blockAppend a b u v) = u

name: Complexity.blockMajority_compl_of_odd
statement:
theorem blockMajority_compl_of_odd {k T : ℕ} (hk : Odd k)
    (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) (w : Fin (k * T) → Bool) :
    blockMajority Eᶜ w = !(blockMajority E w)

name: Complexity.blockMajority_eq_false_iff
statement:
theorem blockMajority_eq_false_iff {k T : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool))
    (w : Fin (k * T) → Bool) :
    blockMajority E w = false ↔ blockEventCount E w ≤ k / 2

name: Complexity.blockMajority_eq_false_iff_mem_range
Complexity.blockSnd_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockSnd_append (a b : ℕ) (u : Fin a → Bool) (v : Fin b → Bool) :

name: Complexity.blockSnd_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockSnd_apply (a b : ℕ) (w : Fin (a + b) → Bool) (i : Fin b) :
    blockSnd a b w i = w (Fin.natAdd a i)

name: Complexity.blocksEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem blocksEquiv_apply (k T : ℕ) (w : Fin (k * T) → Bool)
    (i : Fin k) (t : Fin T) :
    blocksEquiv k T w i t = w (finProdFinEquiv (i, t))

name: Complexity.blocksEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem blocksEquiv_symm_apply (k T : ℕ) (f : Fin k → Fin T → Bool)
    (p : Fin (k * T)) :
    (blocksEquiv k T).symm f p =
      f (finProdFinEquiv.symm p).1 (finProdFinEquiv.symm p).2

name: Complexity.boolFunEquivFinset_card
statement:
@[simp] theorem boolFunEquivFinset_card {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :
    (boolFunEquivFinset (Fin k) f).card = popCount f

name: Complexity.card_adjMatrix
statement:
theorem card_adjMatrix (n : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Fin n → Fin n → Bool) = 2 ^ (n * n)

name: Complexity.card_blockEventCount_eq
statement:
theorem card_blockEventCount_eq {T : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) (k j : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin (k * T) → Bool => blockEventCount E w = j)).card =
      k.choose j * E.card ^ j * (2 ^ T - E.card) ^ (k - j)

name: Complexity.card_blockMajority_eq_false
statement:
theorem card_blockMajority_eq_false (T r : ℕ) (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin ((2 * r + 1) * T) → Bool =>
      blockMajority E w = false)).card =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
        (2 * r + 1).choose j * E.card ^ j *
          (2 ^ T - E.card) ^ (2 * r + 1 - j)

name: Complexity.card_boolFunc
statement:
theorem card_boolFunc (n : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card ((Fin n → Bool) → Bool) = 2 ^ (2 ^ n)

name: Complexity.card_filter_block
statement:
theorem card_filter_block {a b : ℕ}
    (P : (Fin a → Bool) → Prop) (Q : (Fin b → Bool) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q] :
    (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun w : Fin (a + b) → Bool => P (blockFst a b w) ∧ Q (blockSnd a b w))).card
      = (Finset.univ.filter P).card * (Finset.univ.filter Q).card

name: Complexity.card_filter_exists_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_exists_le {ι α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → α → Prop) [∀ i, DecidablePred (p i)] :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => ∃ i ∈ s, p i x)).card
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (Finset.univ.filter (p i)).card

name: Complexity.card_filter_of_constant_fibers
statement:
theorem card_filter_of_constant_fibers
    {total compact ignored : ℕ}
    (randomSeed : (Fin total → Bool) → (Fin compact → Bool))
    (Accept : (Fin total → Bool) → Prop)
    (Good : (Fin compact → Bool) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred Accept] [DecidablePred Good]
    (hfactor : ∀ w, Accept w ↔ Good (randomSeed w))
    (hfiber : ∀ seed,
      (Finset.univ.filter fun w => randomSeed w = seed).card = 2 ^ ignored) :
    (Finset.univ.filter Accept).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter Good).card * 2 ^ ignored

name: Complexity.card_filter_popCount_eq
statement:
theorem card_filter_popCount_eq (k r : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin k → Bool => popCount f = r)).card =
      k.choose r

name: Complexity.card_filter_popCount_mem
statement:
theorem card_filter_popCount_mem (k : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin k → Bool => popCount f ∈ s)).card =
      ∑ r ∈ s, k.choose r

name: Complexity.card_filter_repeatRandomSeed
statement:
theorem card_filter_repeatRandomSeed (k T : ℕ)
    (P : (Fin (k * T) → Bool) → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin (2 + k * (2 * T + 2)) → Bool =>
      P (repeatRandomSeed k T w))).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter P).card * 2 ^ (2 + k * (T + 2))

name: Complexity.card_finArrowBool
statement: theorem card_finArrowBool (T : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Fin T → Bool) = 2 ^ T

name: Complexity.card_finArrowBool_add
statement:
theorem card_finArrowBool_add (a b : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Fin (a + b) → Bool) = 2 ^ a * 2 ^ b

name: Complexity.card_majority_eq_false
statement:
theorem card_majority_eq_false (k : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin k → Bool => majority f = false)).card =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (k / 2 + 1), k.choose r

name: Complexity.card_majority_eq_true
statement:
theorem card_majority_eq_true (k : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin k → Bool => majority f = true)).card =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc (k / 2 + 1) k, k.choose r

name: Complexity.card_majority_ne_true
statement:
theorem card_majority_ne_true (k : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin k → Bool => majority f ≠ true)).card =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (k / 2 + 1), k.choose r

name: Complexity.card_repeatRandomSeed_fiber
statement:
theorem card_repeatRandomSeed_fiber (k T : ℕ) (seed : Fin (k * T) → Bool) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin (2 + k * (2 * T + 2)) → Bool =>
      repeatRandomSeed k T w = seed)).card = 2 ^ (2 + k * (T + 2))

name: Complexity.card_tupleEventCount_eq
statement:
theorem card_tupleEventCount_eq {k : ℕ} {α : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (E : Finset α) (j : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun f : Fin k → α => tupleEventCount E f = j)).card =
        k.choose j * E.card ^ j *
          (Fintype.card α - E.card) ^ (k - j)

name: Complexity.card_tupleEventCount_mem
statement:
theorem card_tupleEventCount_mem {k : ℕ} {α : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (E : Finset α) (counts : Finset ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun f : Fin k → α => tupleEventCount E f ∈ counts)).card =
        ∑ j ∈ counts,
          k.choose j * E.card ^ j *
            (Fintype.card α - E.card) ^ (k - j)

name: Complexity.exists_good_seed
statement:
theorem exists_good_seed {S ι : Type*} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]

name: Complexity.finCountP_eq_popCount
statement:
theorem finCountP_eq_popCount {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :

name: Complexity.majority_eq_false_iff
statement:
theorem majority_eq_false_iff {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :

name: Complexity.majority_eq_false_iff_mem_range
statement:
theorem majority_eq_false_iff_mem_range {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :

name: Complexity.majority_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem majority_eq_true_iff {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :

name: Complexity.majority_eq_true_iff_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem majority_eq_true_iff_mem_Icc {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :

name: Complexity.majority_not_of_odd
statement:
theorem majority_not_of_odd {k : ℕ} (hk : Odd k) (f : Fin k → Bool) :

name: Complexity.mem_boolFunEquivFinset

@[simp] theorem mem_boolFunEquivFinset {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]

name: Complexity.popCount_add_popCount_not
statement:
theorem popCount_add_popCount_not {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :

name: Complexity.popCount_le
statement: theorem popCount_le {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) : popCount f ≤ k

name: Complexity.popCount_not
statement:
theorem popCount_not {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :

name: Complexity.repeatRandomSeed_apply
statement:
theorem repeatRandomSeed_apply (k T : ℕ)
    (w : Fin (2 + k * (2 * T + 2)) → Bool) (i : Fin k) (t : Fin T) :
    repeatRandomSeed k T w (finProdFinEquiv (i, t)) =
      w (Fin.natAdd 2
        (finProdFinEquiv (i, Fin.castLE (by omega : T ≤ 2 * T + 2) t)))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.majorityDeficitBound_eventually_le_internal
statement:
theorem majorityDeficitBound_eventually_le_internal {r c : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hc : 0 < c) :

name: Complexity.KarchmerWigderson.finite_budget_with_deficit_of_cost_internal
statement:
theorem finite_budget_with_deficit_of_cost_internal {n d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) {m k : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (hcost : m ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ)⁻¹) / (128 * (32768 * (194 : ℝ) ^ d)))
    (hkcost : k ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ)⁻¹) / (128 * (32768 * (194 : ℝ) ^ d))) :
    64 * (32768 * (194 : ℝ) ^ d * (m + k)) ^ d ≤ (n : ℝ)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.le_majorityDeficitBound_internal
statement: theorem le_majorityDeficitBound_internal (n : ℕ) : 128 ≤ majorityDeficitBound n

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.majority_layers_deficit_internal
statement:
theorem majority_layers_deficit_internal {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ((weightLayer n (n / 2)).Nonempty ∧
      uniformDeficit (weightLayer n (n / 2)) ≤ majorityDeficitBound n) ∧
    ((weightLayer n (n / 2 + 1)).Nonempty ∧
      uniformDeficit (weightLayer n (n / 2 + 1)) ≤ majorityDeficitBound n)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.middle_choose_bound_internal
statement: theorem middle_choose_bound_internal (n : ℕ) : 2 ^ n ≤ (n + 1) * n.choose (n / 2)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.next_middle_choose_bound_internal
statement:
theorem next_middle_choose_bound_internal {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.popCount_update_false_internal
statement:
theorem popCount_update_false_internal {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → Bool) (i : Fin n) (hi : x i = true) :
    popCount (Function.update x i false) + 1 = popCount x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.popCount_update_true_internal
statement:
theorem popCount_update_true_internal {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → Bool) (i : Fin n) (hi : x i = false) :
    popCount (Function.update x i true) = popCount x + 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.weightLayer_deficit_internal
statement:
theorem weightLayer_deficit_internal {n r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ n)
    (hcard : 2 ^ n ≤ (2 * (n + 1)) * n.choose r) :
    (weightLayer n r).Nonempty ∧ uniformDeficit (weightLayer n r) ≤ majorityDeficitBound n

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_hits_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_hits_internal {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ) (s : Fin n → Bool) :
    bernoulliAverage p (fun P : Fin n → Bool =>
      if ∃ i, s i = true ∧ P i = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
        1 - (1 - p) ^ popCount s

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_popCount_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_popCount_internal {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ) :
    bernoulliAverage p (fun P : Fin n → Bool => (popCount P : ℝ)) = n * p

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.coordinateDensity_of_neighbor_internal
statement:
theorem coordinateDensity_of_neighbor_internal {n : ℕ} (X : Finset (Fin n → Bool))
    (P x : Fin n → Bool) (i : Fin n) (hi : P i = true)
    (hx : Function.update x i (!x i) ∈ X) (hsmall : popCount P ≤ 128) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.isDensityLimit_of_many_neighbors_internal
statement:
theorem isDensityLimit_of_many_neighbors_internal {n : ℕ} (hn : 16 ≤ n)
    (X : Finset (Fin n → Bool)) (x s : Fin n → Bool) (hs : n ≤ 2 * popCount s)
    (hneighbor : ∀ i, s i = true → Function.update x i (!x i) ∈ X) :
    IsDensityLimit X (16 / n) 128 x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.majority_layers_limits_internal
statement:
theorem majority_layers_limits_internal {n : ℕ} (hn : 16 ≤ n) :
    (∀ x ∈ weightLayer n (n / 2),
      IsDensityLimit (weightLayer n (n / 2 + 1)) (16 / n) (majorityDeficitBound n) x) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ weightLayer n (n / 2 + 1),
      IsDensityLimit (weightLayer n (n / 2)) (16 / n) (majorityDeficitBound n) y)

name: Complexity.mle₁_bool
statement:
theorem mle₁_bool {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : Bool → R) (b : Bool) :

name: Complexity.mle₁_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem mle₁_one {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : Bool → R) :
    mle₁ f 1 = f true

name: Complexity.mle₁_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem mle₁_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : Bool → R) :

name: Complexity.Shallow.construction_size_bound
statement:
theorem construction_size_bound {k n U V B N A D E : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hn : n ≤ 2 ^ (N * k)) (hu : U ≤ A * k)
    (hv : V ≤ 2 ^ (D * k)) (hb : B ≤ 2 ^ (E * k)) :
    1 + (n + 1) * (1 + (3 ^ U * (n + 1)) * (2 + V * (B + 2))) ≤
      2 ^ ((2 * A + 2 * N + D + E + 8) * k)

name: Complexity.Shallow.exp_add_bound
statement:
theorem exp_add_bound {k a b x y : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hx : x ≤ 2 ^ (a * k))
    (hy : y ≤ 2 ^ (b * k)) : x + y ≤ 2 ^ ((a + b + 1) * k)

name: Complexity.Shallow.exp_const_bound
statement: theorem exp_const_bound (c k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : c ≤ 2 ^ (c * k)

name: Complexity.Shallow.exp_mul_bound
statement:
theorem exp_mul_bound {k a b x y : ℕ} (hx : x ≤ 2 ^ (a * k))
    (hy : y ≤ 2 ^ (b * k)) : x * y ≤ 2 ^ ((a + b) * k)

name: Complexity.Shallow.pair_size_bound
statement:
theorem pair_size_bound {n d k m : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hn : n ≤ k ^ (d + 2))
    (hm : k ≤ m) : 2 * (n / m + 1) ≤ (4 * k) ^ (d + 1)

name: Complexity.Shallow.sum_sq_moduli_bound
statement:
theorem sum_sq_moduli_bound {r C k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (m : Fin r → ℕ) (hm : ∀ i, m i ≤ C * k) :
    ∑ i, (m i) ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ ((r + 2 * C + 2) * k)

name: Complexity.Shallow.ShiftTest.sound
statement:
theorem ShiftTest.sound {t : G} {w s : G → G} (h : ShiftTest t w s) :

name: Complexity.Shallow.card_acceptingShifts
statement:
theorem card_acceptingShifts {t : G} (w : G → G) (hw : ∑ i, w i = t) :

name: Complexity.Shallow.exists_shiftTest_iff
statement:

name: Complexity.Shallow.shiftTest_iff_pairwise
statement:
theorem shiftTest_iff_pairwise (t : G) (w s : G → G) :
    ShiftTest t w s ↔ (∑ i, s i) = residueSum G - t ∧
      ∀ i j, i ≠ j → w i + s i ≠ w j + s j

name: Complexity.Shallow.shiftTest_perm
statement:

name: Complexity.Shallow.exists_cover
statement:
theorem exists_cover {S W : Type*} [Fintype S] [Nonempty S] [Fintype W]
    (hit : S → W → Prop) [DecidableRel hit] (q n : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hw : Fintype.card W ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (density : ∀ w, Fintype.card S ≤ q * Fintype.card {s : S // hit s w}) :
    ∃ tests : Fin (q * (n + 1)) → S, ∀ w, ∃ i, hit (tests i) w

name: Complexity.Shallow.exists_shiftTest_cover
statement:
theorem exists_shiftTest_cover {G W : Type*} [Fintype G] [AddCommGroup G]
    [Fintype W] (t : G) (w : W → G → G) (n : ℕ)
    (hcard : Fintype.card W ≤ 2 ^ n) (hw : ∀ x, ∑ i, w x i = t) :
    ∃ tests : Fin (3 ^ Fintype.card G * (n + 1)) → (G → G),
      ∀ x, ∃ j, ShiftTest t (w x) (tests j)

name: Complexity.Shallow.pow_self_le_three_pow_mul_factorial
statement:
theorem pow_self_le_three_pow_mul_factorial (k : ℕ) :
    k ^ k ≤ 3 ^ k * k.factorial

name: Complexity.Shallow.exists_moduli
statement:
theorem exists_moduli (r : ℕ) : ∃ C : ℕ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k →
    ∃ m : Fin r → ℕ,
      Pairwise (fun i j => (m i).Coprime (m j)) ∧
      (∀ i, k < m i) ∧ (∀ i, m i ≤ C * k)

name: Complexity.Smolensky.card_middle_le
statement:
theorem card_middle_le (n t : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter fun S : Finset (Fin n) =>
      n ≤ 2 * S.card ∧ S.card ≤ n / 2 + t).card ≤ (t + 1) * n.choose (n / 2)

name: Complexity.Smolensky.centralBinom_sq_mul_le
statement:

name: Complexity.Smolensky.choose_half_sq_mul_le
statement:

name: Complexity.Smolensky.ten_mul_card_le_internal
