name: Complexity.Smolensky.two_mul_card_small_le
statement:
theorem two_mul_card_small_le (n : ℕ) :
    2 * (univ.filter fun S : Finset (Fin n) => 2 * S.card < n).card ≤ 2 ^ n

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.mem_chunkTuple_iff
statement:
theorem mem_chunkTuple_iff (s : Finset α) (K : ℕ) (positive : 0 < K) (a : α) :
    (∃ block : Fin (s.card / K + 1), a ∈ tupleSupport (chunkTuple s K block.val)) ↔
      a ∈ s

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.mem_tupleSupport
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_tupleSupport {K : ℕ} (v : Fin K → Option α) (a : α) :
    a ∈ tupleSupport v ↔ ∃ i, v i = some a

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.sum_div_le_div_sum
statement:
theorem sum_div_le_div_sum {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℕ) (K : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, f i / K ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, f i) / K

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.tupleSupport_card
statement: theorem tupleSupport_card {K : ℕ} (v : Fin K → Option α) : (tupleSupport v).card ≤ K

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.exists_cover
statement:
theorem exists_cover (s : Finset β) (r : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [Nonempty α] [DecidableEq α] (a length : ℕ) (positive : 0 < a)
    (size : s.card ≤ 4 ^ length)
    (dense : ∀ b ∈ s, Fintype.card α ≤
      a * (Finset.univ.filter fun x => r x b).card) :
    ∃ chosen : Finset α, chosen.card ≤ (4 * length + 1) * a ∧
      ∀ b ∈ s, ∃ x ∈ chosen, r x b

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.exists_dense_row
statement:
theorem exists_dense_row (s : Finset β) (r : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [Nonempty α]
    (a : ℕ) (dense : ∀ b ∈ s, Fintype.card α ≤
      a * (Finset.univ.filter fun x => r x b).card) :
    ∃ x, s.card ≤ a * (s.filter (r x)).card

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.exists_partial_cover
statement:
theorem exists_partial_cover (s : Finset β) (r : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [Nonempty α] [DecidableEq α]
    (a : ℕ) (positive : 0 < a)
    (dense : ∀ b ∈ s, Fintype.card α ≤
      a * (Finset.univ.filter fun x => r x b).card) (steps : ℕ) :
    ∃ chosen : Finset α, chosen.card ≤ steps ∧
      ((s.filter fun b => ∀ x ∈ chosen, ¬ r x b).card : ℝ) ≤
        s.card * (1 - 1 / (a : ℝ)) ^ steps

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.sum_card_filter_comm
statement:
theorem sum_card_filter_comm (s : Finset β) (r : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel r] :
    ∑ a : α, (s.filter (r a)).card =
      ∑ b ∈ s, (Finset.univ.filter fun a => r a b).card

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.card_extensions
statement:
theorem card_extensions (length specified : ℕ) (domain : Finset (Fin length))
    (small : domain.card ≤ specified) (values : Fin length → Bool) :
    2 ^ length ≤ 2 ^ specified *
      (Finset.univ.filter fun extension : Fin length → Bool =>
        ∀ i ∈ domain, extension i = values i).card

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.exists_extension_bank
statement:
theorem exists_extension_bank (length specified : ℕ) :
    ∃ bank : Finset (Fin length → Bool), bank.card ≤ (4 * length + 1) * 2 ^ specified ∧
      ∀ (domain : Finset (Fin length)), domain.card ≤ specified →
        ∀ values : Fin length → Bool, ∃ extension ∈ bank,
          ∀ i ∈ domain, extension i = values i

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.exists_intervalChunk
statement:
theorem exists_intervalChunk {L : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin L)) (K : ℕ) (positive : 0 < K)
    (i : Fin L) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    ∃ block : Fin (s.card / K + 1), i ∈ intervalChunk s K block.val

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.intervalChunk_card
statement:
theorem intervalChunk_card {L : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin L)) (K block : ℕ) :
    (intervalChunk s K block).card ≤ K

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.lt_supportCut_iff
statement:
theorem lt_supportCut_iff {L : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin L)) (rank : ℕ)
    (i : Fin L) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    i.val < (supportCut s rank).val ↔ ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨i, hi⟩).val < rank

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.mem_intervalChunk_iff
statement:
theorem mem_intervalChunk_iff {L : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin L)) (K block : ℕ)
    (i : Fin L) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    i ∈ intervalChunk s K block ↔ block * K ≤ ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨i, hi⟩).val ∧
      ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨i, hi⟩).val < (block + 1) * K

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.supportCut_le_iff
statement:
theorem supportCut_le_iff {L : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin L)) (rank : ℕ)
    (i : Fin L) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    (supportCut s rank).val ≤ i.val ↔ rank ≤ ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨i, hi⟩).val

name: Complexity.BoolFormula.exists_spira_balanced
statement:
theorem exists_spira_balanced (formula : BoolFormula) :
    ∃ balanced : BoolFormula,
      (∀ assignment, eval assignment balanced = eval assignment formula) ∧
      balanced.depth ≤ 15 + 12 * Nat.clog 2 formula.size ∧
      balanced.size + 4 ≤ 80 * formula.size ^ 8

name: Complexity.Valiant.depth_reduction
statement:
theorem depth_reduction
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : Digraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {k r : Nat} (hrk : r ≤ k)
    (hac : IsAcyclic G)
    (hd : G.depth ≤ 2 ^ k) :
    ∃ F : Finset (V × V),
      F ⊆ G.edgeFinset ∧
      k * F.card ≤ r * G.edgeFinset.card ∧
      (G.deleteEdges F).depth ≤ 2 ^ k / 2 ^ r

name: Complexity.NTM.acceptProb_eq_eventProb
statement:
theorem NTM.acceptProb_eq_eventProb {n : ℕ} (tm : NTM n) (x : List Bool) (T : ℕ) :
    tm.acceptProb x T =
      eventProb (Finset.univ.filter fun choices : Fin T → Bool =>
        let c' := tm.trace T choices (tm.initCfg x)
        c'.state = tm.qhalt ∧ c'.output.cells 1 = Γ.one)

name: Complexity.NTM.acceptProb_eq_eventProb_repeatRandomSeed
statement:
theorem NTM.acceptProb_eq_eventProb_repeatRandomSeed
    {n : ℕ} (tm : NTM n) (x : List Bool) (k T : ℕ)
    (P : (Fin (k * T) → Bool) → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (hfactor : ∀ choices : Fin (2 + k * (2 * T + 2)) → Bool,
      (let c' := tm.trace (2 + k * (2 * T + 2)) choices (tm.initCfg x)
       c'.state = tm.qhalt ∧ c'.output.cells 1 = Γ.one) ↔
        P (repeatRandomSeed k T choices)) :
    tm.acceptProb x (2 + k * (2 * T + 2)) =
      eventProb (Finset.univ.filter P)

name: Complexity.NTM.acceptProb_eq_of_le_of_allChoicesHalt
statement:
theorem NTM.acceptProb_eq_of_le_of_allChoicesHalt {n T T' : ℕ}
    (tm : NTM n) (x : List Bool) (hle : T ≤ T')
    (hhalt : ∀ choices : Fin T → Bool,
      tm.halted (tm.trace T choices (tm.initCfg x))) :
    tm.acceptProb x T' = tm.acceptProb x T

name: Complexity.NTM.acceptProb_eq_of_le_of_allPathsHaltIn
statement:
theorem NTM.acceptProb_eq_of_le_of_allPathsHaltIn {n : ℕ} {T T' : ℕ → ℕ}
    (tm : NTM n) (hle : ∀ m, T m ≤ T' m) (hhalt : tm.AllPathsHaltIn T)
    (x : List Bool) :
    tm.acceptProb x (T' x.length) = tm.acceptProb x (T x.length)

name: Complexity.NTM.outputProb_eq_eventProb
statement:
theorem NTM.outputProb_eq_eventProb {n : ℕ} (tm : NTM n) (x : List Bool)
    (T : ℕ) (y : List Bool) :
    tm.outputProb x T y =
      eventProb (Finset.univ.filter fun choices : Fin T → Bool =>
        let c := tm.trace T choices (tm.initCfg x)
        c.state = tm.qhalt ∧ c.output.HasOutput y)

name: Complexity.NTM.outputProb_eq_of_le_of_allChoicesHalt
statement:
theorem NTM.outputProb_eq_of_le_of_allChoicesHalt {n T T' : ℕ}
    (tm : NTM n) (x : List Bool) (y : List Bool) (hle : T ≤ T')
    (hhalt : ∀ choices : Fin T → Bool,
      tm.halted (tm.trace T choices (tm.initCfg x))) :
    tm.outputProb x T' y = tm.outputProb x T y

name: Complexity.NTM.outputProb_eq_of_le_of_allPathsHaltIn
statement:
theorem NTM.outputProb_eq_of_le_of_allPathsHaltIn {n : ℕ} {T T' : ℕ → ℕ}
    (tm : NTM n) (hle : ∀ m, T m ≤ T' m) (hhalt : tm.AllPathsHaltIn T)
    (x y : List Bool) :
    tm.outputProb x (T' x.length) y = tm.outputProb x (T x.length) y

name: Complexity.NTM.traceEventProb_eq_of_le_of_allChoicesHalt
statement:
theorem NTM.traceEventProb_eq_of_le_of_allChoicesHalt {n T T' : ℕ}
    (tm : NTM n) (c : Cfg n tm.Q)
    (event : Cfg n tm.Q → Prop) [DecidablePred event] (hle : T ≤ T')
    (hhalt : ∀ choices : Fin T → Bool,
      tm.halted (tm.trace T choices c)) :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter fun choices : Fin T' → Bool =>
      event (tm.trace T' choices c)) =
      eventProb (Finset.univ.filter fun choices : Fin T → Bool =>
        event (tm.trace T choices c))

name: Complexity.binomial_lower_tail_le
statement:
theorem binomial_lower_tail_le (r : ℕ) (p : ℚ)
    (hp_lower : 2 / 3 ≤ p) (hp_upper : p ≤ 1) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
        ((2 * r + 1).choose j : ℚ) * p ^ j *
          (1 - p) ^ (2 * r + 1 - j)) ≤
      (1 / 3) * (8 / 9) ^ r

name: Complexity.card_le_pow
statement: theorem card_le_pow {T : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) : E.card ≤ 2 ^ T

name: Complexity.eventProb_biUnion
statement:
theorem eventProb_biUnion {T : ℕ} {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (E : ι → Finset (Fin T → Bool))
    (h : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint E) :
    eventProb (s.biUnion E) = ∑ i ∈ s, eventProb (E i)

name: Complexity.eventProb_biUnion_le
statement:
theorem eventProb_biUnion_le {T : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι)
    (E : ι → Finset (Fin T → Bool)) :
    eventProb (s.biUnion E) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, eventProb (E i)

name: Complexity.eventProb_block
statement:
theorem eventProb_block {a b : ℕ}
    (P : (Fin a → Bool) → Prop) (Q : (Fin b → Bool) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q] :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun w : Fin (a + b) → Bool => P (blockFst a b w) ∧ Q (blockSnd a b w)))
      = eventProb (Finset.univ.filter P) * eventProb (Finset.univ.filter Q)

name: Complexity.eventProb_blockMajority_eq_false
statement:
theorem eventProb_blockMajority_eq_false
    (T r : ℕ) (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin ((2 * r + 1) * T) → Bool =>
      blockMajority E w = false)) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
        ((2 * r + 1).choose j : ℚ) * eventProb E ^ j *
          (1 - eventProb E) ^ (2 * r + 1 - j)

name: Complexity.eventProb_blockMajority_false_le_two_pow
statement:
theorem eventProb_blockMajority_false_le_two_pow
    (T k : ℕ) (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) (hE : 2 / 3 ≤ eventProb E) :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin ((12 * k + 1) * T) → Bool =>
      blockMajority E w = false)) ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ k

name: Complexity.eventProb_blockMajority_true_ge_one_sub_two_pow
statement:
theorem eventProb_blockMajority_true_ge_one_sub_two_pow
    (T k : ℕ) (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) (hE : 2 / 3 ≤ eventProb E) :
    1 - 1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ k ≤
      eventProb (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun w : Fin ((12 * k + 1) * T) → Bool => blockMajority E w = true))

name: Complexity.eventProb_blockMajority_true_le_two_pow
statement:
theorem eventProb_blockMajority_true_le_two_pow
    (T k : ℕ) (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) (hE : eventProb E ≤ 1 / 3) :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun w : Fin ((12 * k + 1) * T) → Bool => blockMajority E w = true))
      ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ k

name: Complexity.eventProb_compl
statement:
theorem eventProb_compl {T : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) :
    eventProb Eᶜ = 1 - eventProb E

name: Complexity.eventProb_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem eventProb_empty {T : ℕ} : eventProb (∅ : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) = 0

name: Complexity.eventProb_eq_sum_fiberwise
statement:
theorem eventProb_eq_sum_fiberwise {T : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) (s : Finset ι) (f : (Fin T → Bool) → ι)
    (h : (E : Set (Fin T → Bool)).MapsTo f s) :
    eventProb E = ∑ i ∈ s, eventProb (E.filter fun w => f w = i)

name: Complexity.eventProb_filter_bool_true
statement:
theorem eventProb_filter_bool_true (T : ℕ)
    (f : (Fin T → Bool) → Bool) :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => f w = true)) =
      1 - eventProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => f w = false))

name: Complexity.eventProb_filter_of_constant_fibers
statement:
theorem eventProb_filter_of_constant_fibers
    {total compact ignored : ℕ} (htotal : total = compact + ignored)
    (randomSeed : (Fin total → Bool) → (Fin compact → Bool))
    (Accept : (Fin total → Bool) → Prop)
    (Good : (Fin compact → Bool) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred Accept] [DecidablePred Good]
    (hfactor : ∀ w, Accept w ↔ Good (randomSeed w))
    (hfiber : ∀ seed,
      (Finset.univ.filter fun w => randomSeed w = seed).card = 2 ^ ignored) :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter Accept) =
      eventProb (Finset.univ.filter Good)

name: Complexity.eventProb_le_one
statement: theorem eventProb_le_one {T : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) : eventProb E ≤ 1

name: Complexity.eventProb_le_uniformAverage_div
statement:
theorem eventProb_le_uniformAverage_div {T : ℕ}
    (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) (weight : (Fin T → Bool) → ℚ)
    (threshold : ℚ) (hthreshold : 0 < threshold)
    (hweight : ∀ seed, 0 ≤ weight seed)
    (hlarge : ∀ seed ∈ E, threshold ≤ weight seed) :
    eventProb E ≤
      ((∑ seed : Fin T → Bool, weight seed) / (2 : ℚ) ^ T) / threshold

name: Complexity.eventProb_map
statement:
theorem eventProb_map {T : ℕ} (e : (Fin T → Bool) ≃ (Fin T → Bool))
    (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) :
    eventProb (E.map e.toEmbedding) = eventProb E

name: Complexity.eventProb_mono
statement:
theorem eventProb_mono {T : ℕ} {E F : Finset (Fin T → Bool)} (h : E ⊆ F) :
    eventProb E ≤ eventProb F

name: Complexity.eventProb_nonneg
statement: theorem eventProb_nonneg {T : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) : 0 ≤ eventProb E

name: Complexity.eventProb_repeatRandomSeed
statement:
theorem eventProb_repeatRandomSeed (k T : ℕ)
    (P : (Fin (k * T) → Bool) → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin (2 + k * (2 * T + 2)) → Bool =>
      P (repeatRandomSeed k T w))) =
      eventProb (Finset.univ.filter P)

name: Complexity.eventProb_union_le
statement:
theorem eventProb_union_le {T : ℕ} (E F : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) :
    eventProb (E ∪ F) ≤ eventProb E + eventProb F

name: Complexity.eventProb_univ
statement:
@[simp] theorem eventProb_univ {T : ℕ} :
    eventProb (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) = 1

name: Complexity.exists_good_seed_of_eventProb_le_two_pow_succ
statement:
theorem exists_good_seed_of_eventProb_le_two_pow_succ (n S : ℕ)
    (bad : (Fin n → Bool) → Finset (Fin S → Bool))
    (hbad : ∀ x, eventProb (bad x) ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ (n + 1)) :
    ∃ seed : Fin S → Bool, ∀ x, seed ∉ bad x

name: Complexity.exists_good_seed_of_sum_eventProb_lt_one
statement:
theorem exists_good_seed_of_sum_eventProb_lt_one {S : ℕ} {ι : Type*}
    (inputs : Finset ι) (bad : ι → Finset (Fin S → Bool))
    (h : ∑ i ∈ inputs, eventProb (bad i) < 1) :
    ∃ seed : Fin S → Bool, ∀ i ∈ inputs, seed ∉ bad i

name: Complexity.delimit_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem delimit_cons (b : Bool) (l : List Bool) :
    delimit (b :: l) = b :: b :: delimit l

name: Complexity.delimit_length
statement: @[simp] theorem delimit_length (l : List Bool) : (delimit l).length = 2 * l.length + 2

name: Complexity.delimit_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem delimit_nil : delimit [] = [false, true]

name: Complexity.eq_delimit_append_of_unpair?_eq_some
statement:
theorem eq_delimit_append_of_unpair?_eq_some :
    ∀ {z x y : List Bool}, unpair? z = some (x, y) → z = delimit x ++ y
  | [], _, _, h => by simp [unpair?] at h
  | [b], _, _, h => by cases b <;> simp [unpair?] at h
  | false :: true :: rest, x, y, h => by
    simp only [unpair?, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: Complexity.hasBlock_eq_isSome_unpair?
statement:
theorem hasBlock_eq_isSome_unpair? :
    ∀ l : List Bool, hasBlock l = (unpair? l).isSome
  | [] => rfl
  | [b] => by cases b <;> rfl
  | false :: true :: _ => rfl
  | false :: false :: rest => by
    simp only [hasBlock, unpair?, hasBlock_eq_isSome_unpair? rest]
    cases unpair? rest <;> rfl
  | true :: true :: rest => by
    simp only [hasBlock, unpair?, hasBlock_eq_isSome_unpair? rest]
    cases unpair? rest <;> rfl
  | true :: false :: _ => rfl

name: Complexity.length_le_length_flatten_delimit
statement:
theorem length_le_length_flatten_delimit (l : List (List Bool)) :
    l.length ≤ ((l.map delimit).flatten).length

name: Complexity.takeFirstBlock_delimit_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem takeFirstBlock_delimit_append (P Q : List Bool) :
    takeFirstBlock (delimit P ++ Q) = delimit P

name: Complexity.takeFirstBlock_eq_nil_of_unpair?_eq_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem takeFirstBlock_eq_nil_of_unpair?_eq_none {input : List Bool}
    (h : unpair? input = none) :
    takeFirstBlock input = []

name: Complexity.undelimitBlock_delimit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem undelimitBlock_delimit (P : List Bool) :
    undelimitBlock (delimit P) = P

name: Complexity.undelimitBlock_delimit_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem undelimitBlock_delimit_append (P Q : List Bool) :
    undelimitBlock (delimit P ++ Q) = P

name: Complexity.undelimitBlock_eq_nil_of_unpair?_eq_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem undelimitBlock_eq_nil_of_unpair?_eq_none {input : List Bool}
    (h : unpair? input = none) :
    undelimitBlock input = []

name: Complexity.undelimitBlocks_flatten_delimit
statement:
theorem undelimitBlocks_flatten_delimit (l : List (List Bool)) :
    undelimitBlocks ((l.map delimit).flatten) = some l

name: Complexity.unpair?_delimit_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem unpair?_delimit_append (x y : List Bool) :
    unpair? (delimit x ++ y) = some (x, y)

name: Complexity.eq_pair_of_unpair?_eq_some
statement:
theorem eq_pair_of_unpair?_eq_some {z x y : List Bool} (h : unpair? z = some (x, y)) :
    z = pair x y

name: Complexity.pairFst_length_le
statement: theorem pairFst_length_le (z : List Bool) : (pairFst z).length ≤ z.length

name: Complexity.pairFst_pair
statement: @[simp] theorem pairFst_pair (x y : List Bool) : pairFst (pair x y) = x

name: Complexity.pairSnd_eq_unpair?
statement:
theorem pairSnd_eq_unpair? (z : List Bool) :
    pairSnd z = ((unpair? z).map Prod.snd).getD []

name: Complexity.pairSnd_length_le
statement: theorem pairSnd_length_le (z : List Bool) : (pairSnd z).length ≤ z.length

name: Complexity.pairSnd_pair
statement: @[simp] theorem pairSnd_pair (x y : List Bool) : pairSnd (pair x y) = y

name: Complexity.pair_cons_eq
statement:
theorem pair_cons_eq (b : Bool) (x y : List Bool) :
    pair (b :: x) y = b :: b :: pair x y

name: Complexity.pair_getElem_left_first
statement:
theorem pair_getElem_left_first (x y : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length) :
    (pair x y)[2 * i]'(by rw [pair_length]; omega) = x[i]'hi

name: Complexity.pair_getElem_left_second
statement:
theorem pair_getElem_left_second (x y : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length) :
    (pair x y)[2 * i + 1]'(by rw [pair_length]; omega) = x[i]'hi

name: Complexity.pair_getElem_right
statement:
theorem pair_getElem_right (x y : List Bool) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < y.length) :
    (pair x y)[2 * x.length + 2 + j]'(by rw [pair_length]; omega) = y[j]'hj

name: Complexity.pair_getElem_sep_one
statement:
theorem pair_getElem_sep_one (x y : List Bool) :
    (pair x y)[2 * x.length + 1]'(by rw [pair_length]; omega) = true

name: Complexity.pair_getElem_sep_zero
statement:
theorem pair_getElem_sep_zero (x y : List Bool) :
    (pair x y)[2 * x.length]'(by rw [pair_length]; omega) = false

name: Complexity.pair_inj
statement:
theorem pair_inj {x₁ x₂ : List Bool} {y₁ y₂ : List Bool}
    (h : pair x₁ y₁ = pair x₂ y₂) : x₁ = x₂ ∧ y₁ = y₂

name: Complexity.pair_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem pair_length (x y : List Bool) :
    (pair x y).length = 2 * x.length + 2 + y.length

name: Complexity.unpair?_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem unpair?_eq_some_iff {z x y : List Bool} :
    unpair? z = some (x, y) ↔ z = pair x y

name: Complexity.unpair?_pair
statement:
@[simp] theorem unpair?_pair (x y : List Bool) :
    unpair? (pair x y) = some (x, y)

name: Complexity.AuxiliaryUnarySeed.splitLe
statement: theorem splitLe {m : ℕ} (seed : AuxiliaryUnarySeed m) : seed.split ≤ m

name: Complexity.DyadicEnsemble.probability_congr_internal

    [∀ fixed, DecidablePred (event fixed)] :

    [Nonempty sample] (value : sample → ℚ) (epsilon : ℚ)
    (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon) (hupper : ∀ input, value input ≤ 1)
    (hmean : 1 / 2 + epsilon ≤ uniformMean value) :
    epsilon / 2 ≤
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun input =>
        1 / 2 + epsilon / 2 ≤ value input)

    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (event : Finset Ω) (trials : ℕ) (singleDrawLower : ℚ)
    (hlower : singleDrawLower ≤ uniformProbability event)
    (htrials : 1 ≤ (trials : ℚ) * singleDrawLower) :
    1 / 2 ≤ uniformAtLeastOneProbability event trials

name: Complexity.one_sub_pow_le_uniformAtLeastOneProbability_internal

    (event : Finset Ω) (trials : ℕ) (singleDrawLower : ℚ)
    (hlower : singleDrawLower ≤ uniformProbability event) :
    1 - (1 - singleDrawLower) ^ trials ≤
      uniformAtLeastOneProbability event trials

    (event : Finset Ω) (trials : ℕ) :
    (trials : ℚ) * uniformProbability event /
        (1 + (trials : ℚ) * uniformProbability event) ≤
      uniformAtLeastOneProbability event trials

    (hupper : ∀ input, value input ≤ 1) :
    uniformMean value ≤ threshold +

        threshold ≤ value input) * (1 - threshold)

name: Complexity.uniformMean_sub_div_le_probability_ge_internal

    (hupper : ∀ input, value input ≤ 1)
    (hlower : lower ≤ uniformMean value) (hthreshold : threshold < 1) :
    (lower - threshold) / (1 - threshold) ≤
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun input =>
        threshold ≤ value input)

statement:

    {advice : Type u} {challenge : Type v}
    [Fintype advice] [Nonempty advice]
    [Fintype challenge] [Nonempty challenge]
    (event : advice → challenge → Prop)
    [∀ fixed, DecidablePred (event fixed)] :
    ∃ fixed : advice,
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun sample : advice × challenge =>
          event sample.1 sample.2) ≤
        uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter (event fixed))

name: Complexity.half_epsilon_le_probability_ge_of_le_uniformMean
statement:
theorem half_epsilon_le_probability_ge_of_le_uniformMean
    {sample : Type u} [Fintype sample]
    [Nonempty sample] (value : sample → ℚ) (epsilon : ℚ)
    (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon) (hupper : ∀ input, value input ≤ 1)
    (hmean : 1 / 2 + epsilon ≤ uniformMean value) :
    epsilon / 2 ≤
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun input =>
        1 / 2 + epsilon / 2 ≤ value input)

name: Complexity.half_le_uniformAtLeastOneProbability_of_singleDrawLower
statement:
theorem half_le_uniformAtLeastOneProbability_of_singleDrawLower
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (event : Finset Ω) (trials : ℕ) (singleDrawLower : ℚ)
    (hlower : singleDrawLower ≤ uniformProbability event)
    (htrials : 1 ≤ (trials : ℚ) * singleDrawLower) :
    1 / 2 ≤ uniformAtLeastOneProbability event trials

name: Complexity.one_sub_pow_le_uniformAtLeastOneProbability
statement:
theorem one_sub_pow_le_uniformAtLeastOneProbability
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (event : Finset Ω) (trials : ℕ) (singleDrawLower : ℚ)
    (hlower : singleDrawLower ≤ uniformProbability event) :
    1 - (1 - singleDrawLower) ^ trials ≤
      uniformAtLeastOneProbability event trials

name: Complexity.trials_mul_div_one_add_le_uniformAtLeastOneProbability
statement:
theorem trials_mul_div_one_add_le_uniformAtLeastOneProbability
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (event : Finset Ω) (trials : ℕ) :
    (trials : ℚ) * uniformProbability event /
        (1 + (trials : ℚ) * uniformProbability event) ≤
      uniformAtLeastOneProbability event trials

name: Complexity.uniformAtLeastOneProbability_eq_one_sub_pow
statement:
theorem uniformAtLeastOneProbability_eq_one_sub_pow
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (event : Finset Ω) (trials : ℕ) :
    uniformAtLeastOneProbability event trials =
      1 - (1 - uniformProbability event) ^ trials

name: Complexity.uniformMean_le_threshold_add_probability
statement:
theorem uniformMean_le_threshold_add_probability
    {sample : Type u} [Fintype sample]
    [Nonempty sample] (value : sample → ℚ) (threshold : ℚ)
    (hupper : ∀ input, value input ≤ 1) :
    uniformMean value ≤ threshold +
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun input =>
        threshold ≤ value input) * (1 - threshold)

name: Complexity.uniformMean_sub_div_le_probability_ge
statement:
theorem uniformMean_sub_div_le_probability_ge
    {sample : Type u} [Fintype sample]
    [Nonempty sample] (value : sample → ℚ) (lower threshold : ℚ)
    (hupper : ∀ input, value input ≤ 1)
    (hlower : lower ≤ uniformMean value) (hthreshold : threshold < 1) :
    (lower - threshold) / (1 - threshold) ≤
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun input =>
        threshold ≤ value input)

name: Complexity.uniformProbability_eq_sum_fiberwise
statement:
theorem uniformProbability_eq_sum_fiberwise
    {Ω : Type u} {ι : Type v} [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq ι] (event : Finset Ω) (indices : Finset ι) (f : Ω → ι)
    (hmaps : (event : Set Ω).MapsTo f indices) :
    uniformProbability event =
      ∑ i ∈ indices,
        uniformProbability (event.filter fun seed => f seed = i)

name: Complexity.uniformProbability_equiv

    uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun x : Ω => P (e x)) =
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter P)

name: Complexity.uniformProbability_product
statement:
theorem uniformProbability_product
    {Ω : Type u} {Ξ : Type v} [Fintype Ω]
    [Fintype Ξ] (P : Ω → Prop) (Q : Ξ → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q] :
    uniformProbability
        (Finset.univ.filter fun seed : Ω × Ξ => P seed.1 ∧ Q seed.2) =
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter P) *
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter Q)

name: Complexity.uniformProbability_product_eq_average_fibers
statement:
theorem uniformProbability_product_eq_average_fibers
    {advice : Type u} {challenge : Type v}
    [Fintype advice] [Nonempty advice]
    [Fintype challenge] [Nonempty challenge]
    (event : advice → challenge → Prop)
    [∀ fixed, DecidablePred (event fixed)] :
    uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun sample : advice × challenge =>
        event sample.1 sample.2) =
      (∑ fixed : advice,
        uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter (event fixed))) /
        Fintype.card advice

    (hhead : 1 ≤ (c.work (Fin.last k)).head) :

      (choiceTM tm).reachesIn t c c' ∧

statement:
theorem reachesCfg_trace (tm : NTM k) :
    ∀ (T : ℕ) (choices : Fin T → Bool) (c : Cfg k tm.Q),
      tm.ReachesCfg c (tm.trace T choices c)
  | 0, _, c => reachesCfg_refl tm c
  | T + 1, choices, c => by
      rw [NTM.trace]
      by_cases h : c.state = tm.qhalt
      · simp only [h, ite_eq_left]
        exact reachesCfg_refl tm c
      · simp only [h, ite_eq_right, not_false_iff]
        refine reachesCfg_head ⟨h, choices ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ T⟩, rfl⟩ ?_
        exact reachesCfg_trace tm T _ _

  | t + 1 => by
      refine (reachSet_finite tm c₀ t).union (Set.Finite.subset
        (((reachSet_finite tm c₀ t).image (tm.stepCfg false)).union

name: Complexity.NPSPACE_bounded_reachability_internal
statement:
theorem NPSPACE_bounded_reachability_internal {L : Language} (hL : L ∈ NPSPACE) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (tm : NTM k) (q : Polynomial ℕ),
      ∀ x : List Bool, x ∈ L ↔
        ∃ c, tm.ReachesCfgLe (2 ^ q.eval x.length) (tm.initCfg x) c ∧
          tm.halted c ∧ c.output.cells 1 = Γ.one

name: Complexity.NPSPACE_subset_PSPACE_of_recursion_internal
statement:
theorem NPSPACE_subset_PSPACE_of_recursion_internal
    (h : ∀ (k : ℕ) (tm : NTM k) (S : ℕ → ℕ) (L₀ : Language) (m : ℕ) (q : Polynomial ℕ),
      tm.DecidesInSpace L₀ S → S =O (· ^ m) →
      ∃ (k' : ℕ) (M : TM k') (r : Polynomial ℕ),
        (∀ (x : List Bool) (c' : Cfg k' M.Q), M.reaches (M.initCfg x) c' →
          c'.WithinDecisionSpace x.length (r.eval x.length)) ∧
        (∀ x : List Bool, ∃ c', M.reaches (M.initCfg x) c' ∧ M.halted c' ∧
          ((∃ c, tm.ReachesCfgLe (2 ^ q.eval x.length) (tm.initCfg x) c ∧ tm.halted c ∧
            c.output.cells 1 = Γ.one) → c'.output.cells 1 = Γ.one) ∧
          ((¬ ∃ c, tm.ReachesCfgLe (2 ^ q.eval x.length) (tm.initCfg x) c ∧ tm.halted c ∧
            c.output.cells 1 = Γ.one) → c'.output.cells 1 = Γ.zero))) :
    NPSPACE ⊆ PSPACE

    (initial : invariant 0 c)
    (step : ∀ (time : ℕ) (htime : time < T) (current : Cfg n tm.Q),
      invariant time current →
        invariant (time + 1)
          (tm.trace 1 (fun _ => choices ⟨time, htime⟩) current)) :
    invariant T (tm.trace T choices c)

    (step : ∀ (choice : Bool) (c : Cfg n source.Q), c.state ≠ source.qhalt →
      target.trace 1 (fun _ => choice) (wrap c) =
        wrap (source.trace 1 (fun _ => choice) c))
    (T : ℕ) (choices : Fin T → Bool) (c : Cfg n source.Q)
    (running : ∀ t (ht : t < T),
      (source.trace t (fun i => choices ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_trans i.isLt ht⟩) c).state ≠
        source.qhalt) :
    target.trace T choices (wrap c) = wrap (source.trace T choices c)

theorem pairBuildTM_hoareTime
    {k : ℕ} (yIdx pIdx : Fin k) (hne : yIdx ≠ pIdx)
    (x y : List Bool) :
    (pairBuildTM yIdx pIdx).HoareTime
      (fun inp work _ =>
        inp = Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool) ∧
        work yIdx = Tape.init (y.map Γ.ofBool) ∧
        work pIdx = Tape.init [])
      (fun _ work _ =>
        (work pIdx).head = 1 ∧
        (work pIdx).cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
        (∀ i : ℕ, (h : i < (pair x y).length) →
          (work pIdx).cells (i + 1) = Γ.ofBool ((pair x y)[i]'h)) ∧
        (∀ i : ℕ, (pair x y).length ≤ i →
          (work pIdx).cells (i + 1) = Γ.blank))
      (pairBuildTime x.length y.length)

    (x y : List Bool) :
    ((pairBuildTM yIdx pIdx).toNTM).HoareTime
      (fun inp work _ =>
        inp = (Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool)).move Dir3.right ∧
        work yIdx = (Tape.init (y.map Γ.ofBool)).move Dir3.right ∧
        work pIdx = (Tape.init []).move Dir3.right)
      (fun _ work _ =>
        work pIdx = (Tape.init ((pair x y).map Γ.ofBool)).move Dir3.right)
      (pairBuildTime x.length y.length)

name: Complexity.TM.blankWorkTM_hoareTime_frame_of_binaryString
statement:
theorem blankWorkTM_hoareTime_frame_of_binaryString {n : ℕ}
    (idx : Fin n) (x : List Bool)
    {P : Tape → (Fin n → Tape) → Tape → Prop}
    (hP_preserved : ∀ (inp : Tape) (work : Fin n → Tape) (out : Tape)
      (inp' : Tape) (work' : Fin n → Tape) (out' : Tape),
      P inp work out →
      (work' idx).head = x.length + 1 →
      (work' idx).cells 0 = Γ.start →
      (∀ i, (work' idx).cells (i + 1) = Γ.blank) →
      inp' = inp →
      out' = out →
      (∀ i, i ≠ idx → work' i = work i) →
      P inp' work' out') :
    (blankWorkTM idx).HoareTime
      (fun inp work out =>
        work idx = (Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool)).move Dir3.right ∧
        inp.read ≠ Γ.start ∧
        out.read ≠ Γ.start ∧ out.head ≥ 1 ∧
        (∀ i, i ≠ idx → (work i).read ≠ Γ.start ∧ (work i).head ≥ 1) ∧
        P inp work out)
      (fun inp work out =>
        (work idx).head = x.length + 1 ∧
        (work idx).cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
        (∀ i, (work idx).cells (i + 1) = Γ.blank) ∧
        P inp work out)
      (x.length + 1)

        (work idx).cells 0 = Γ.start ∧

name: Complexity.TM.copyWorkToWorkTM_hoareTime_frame_of_binaryString
statement:
theorem copyWorkToWorkTM_hoareTime_frame_of_binaryString {n : ℕ}
    (src dst : Fin n) (hne : src ≠ dst) (x : List Bool)
    {P : Tape → (Fin n → Tape) → Tape → Prop}
    (hP_preserved : ∀ (inp : Tape) (work : Fin n → Tape) (out : Tape)
      (inp' : Tape) (work' : Fin n → Tape) (out' : Tape),
      P inp work out →
      (work' src).cells = (Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool)).cells →
      (work' src).head = x.length + 1 →
      (work' dst).HasBinaryPrefix x →
      (work' dst).cells 0 = Γ.start →
      inp' = inp →
      out' = out →
      (∀ i, i ≠ src → i ≠ dst → work' i = work i) →
      P inp' work' out') :
    (copyWorkToWorkTM src dst).HoareTime
      (fun inp work out =>
        work src = (Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool)).move Dir3.right ∧
        work dst = (Tape.init []).move Dir3.right ∧
        inp.read ≠ Γ.start ∧
        out.read ≠ Γ.start ∧ out.head ≥ 1 ∧
        (∀ i, i ≠ src → i ≠ dst → (work i).read ≠ Γ.start ∧ (work i).head ≥ 1) ∧
        P inp work out)
      (fun inp work out =>
        (work src).cells = (Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool)).cells ∧
        (work src).head = x.length + 1 ∧
        (work dst).HasBinaryPrefix x ∧
        (work dst).cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
        P inp work out)
      (x.length + 1)

      P inp work out →

statement:
theorem rewindWorkTM_hoareTime_frame {n : ℕ} (idx : Fin n) (B_tape : ℕ)

    (hP_preserved : ∀ (inp : Tape) (work : Fin n → Tape) (out : Tape)

    ∃ c' t, t + 1 ≤ T z.length ∧
      (retargetInput M).reachesIn t
        (retargetWrap M realInput (startedCfg M z (qstart_ne_qhalt_of_decidesInTime M hM))) c' ∧
      (retargetInput M).halted c' ∧
      (z ∈ L → c'.output.cells 1 = Γ.one) ∧
      (z ∉ L → c'.output.cells 1 = Γ.zero)

name: Complexity.TM.retargetInput_hoareTime
statement:
theorem retargetInput_hoareTime (M : TM k)
    {pre post : TapePred k} {b : ℕ}
    (hM : M.HoareTime pre post b)
    (hpre_inp : ∀ inp work out, pre inp work out → Tape.StartInvariant inp)
    (hpre_work : ∀ inp work out, pre inp work out → ∀ i, Tape.StartInvariant (work i))
    (hpre_out : ∀ inp work out, pre inp work out → Tape.StartInvariant out) :
    (retargetInput M).HoareTime
      (fun _inp work out =>
        pre (work ⟨k, by omega⟩) (fun i => work ⟨i.val, by omega⟩) out)
      (fun _inp work out =>
        ∃ vin : Tape, ∃ innerWork : Fin k → Tape,
          post vin innerWork out ∧
          (∀ i : Fin k, work ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = innerWork i) ∧
          work ⟨k, by omega⟩ = vin)
      b

statement:
theorem copyWorkToWorkTM_hoareTime_frame_of_hasOutput_internal {n : ℕ}
    (src dst : Fin n) (hne : src ≠ dst) (x : List Bool) (source : Tape)
    {P : Tape → (Fin n → Tape) → Tape → Prop}
    (hP : ∀ (inp : Tape) (work : Fin n → Tape) (out : Tape)
      (inp' : Tape) (work' : Fin n → Tape) (out' : Tape),
      P inp work out →
      (work' src).cells = source.cells →
      (work' src).head = x.length + 1 →
      (work' src).HasOutput x →
      (work' dst).HasBinaryPrefix x →
      (work' dst).cells 0 = Γ.start →
      inp' = inp → out' = out →
      (∀ i, i ≠ src → i ≠ dst → work' i = work i) →
      P inp' work' out') :
    (copyWorkToWorkTM src dst).HoareTime
      (fun inp work out =>
        work src = source ∧ source.head = 1 ∧ source.HasOutput x ∧
        work dst = (Tape.init []).move Dir3.right ∧
        inp.read ≠ Γ.start ∧ out.read ≠ Γ.start ∧ 1 ≤ out.head ∧
        (∀ i, i ≠ src → i ≠ dst →
          (work i).read ≠ Γ.start ∧ 1 ≤ (work i).head) ∧
        P inp work out)
      (fun inp work out =>
        (work src).cells = source.cells ∧
        (work src).head = x.length + 1 ∧
        (work src).HasOutput x ∧
        (work dst).HasBinaryPrefix x ∧
        (work dst).cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
        P inp work out)
      (x.length + 1)

    (copyWorkToWorkTM src dst).HoareTime
      (fun _inp work _out =>
        work src = source ∧ source.head = 1 ∧ source.HasOutput x ∧
          (work dst).HasBinaryPrefix [])
      (fun _inp work _out =>
        (work src).cells = source.cells ∧
        (work src).head = x.length + 1 ∧
        (work src).HasOutput x ∧
        (work dst).HasBinaryPrefix x)
      (x.length + 1)

    (src dst : Fin n) (hne : src ≠ dst) (x : List Bool)

    ∃ c',

          input := inp, work := work, output := out } c' ∧
      (copyWorkToWorkTM src dst).halted c' ∧
      (c'.work src).cells = (work src).cells ∧
      (c'.work src).head = x.length + 1 ∧
      (c'.work src).HasOutput x ∧
      (c'.work dst).HasBinaryPrefix x ∧
      (c'.work dst).cells 0 = (work dst).cells 0

        (work src).head = x.length + 1 ∧
        (work src).HasOutput x ∧
        (work dst).HasBinaryPrefix x ∧
        (work dst).cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
        P inp work out)
      (x.length + 1)

theorem copyWorkToWorkTM_hoareTime_of_hasOutput {n : ℕ}
    (src dst : Fin n) (hne : src ≠ dst) (x : List Bool) (source : Tape) :
    (copyWorkToWorkTM src dst).HoareTime
      (fun _inp work _out =>
        work src = source ∧ source.head = 1 ∧ source.HasOutput x ∧
          (work dst).HasBinaryPrefix [])
      (fun _inp work _out =>
        (work src).cells = source.cells ∧
        (work src).head = x.length + 1 ∧
        (work src).HasOutput x ∧
        (work dst).HasBinaryPrefix x)
      (x.length + 1)

    {inp out : Tape} {work : Fin n → Tape}
    (hsrcHead : (work src).head = 1)
    (hsrcOutput : (work src).HasOutput x)
    (hdst : (work dst).HasBinaryPrefix []) :
    ∃ c',
      (copyWorkToWorkTM src dst).reachesIn (x.length + 1)
        { state := (copyWorkToWorkTM src dst).qstart,
          input := inp, work := work, output := out } c' ∧
      (copyWorkToWorkTM src dst).halted c' ∧
      (c'.work src).cells = (work src).cells ∧
      (c'.work src).head = x.length + 1 ∧
      (c'.work src).HasOutput x ∧
      (c'.work dst).HasBinaryPrefix x ∧

name: Complexity.TM.compositionTailTM_decides_hoareTime_internal
statement:
theorem compositionTailTM_decides_hoareTime_internal {nf ng : ℕ} (tmG : TM ng)
    {L : Language} {G : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hG : tmG.DecidesInTime L G) (y : List Bool) (B : ℕ) :
    (compositionTailTM nf ng tmG).HoareTime
      (CompositionTailPre nf ng y B)
      (fun _inp _work out =>
        (y ∈ L → out.cells 1 = Γ.one) ∧
        (y ∉ L → out.cells 1 = Γ.zero))
      ((B + 2) + 1 + ((y.length + 1) + 1 +
        ((y.length + 1 + 2) + 1 + G y.length)))

name: Complexity.TM.compositionTailTM_hoareTime_internal
statement:
theorem compositionTailTM_hoareTime_internal {nf ng : ℕ} (tmG : TM ng)

    (compositionTailTM nf ng tmG).HoareTime
      (CompositionTailPre nf ng y B)
      (fun _inp _work out => out.HasOutput (g y))

statement:
theorem cfgBlocks_step {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) {c c' : Cfg k tm.Q} {W : ℕ}
    (h : tm.step c = some c') (hout : c.output.StartInvariant)
    (hwork : ∀ i, (c.work i).StartInvariant)
    (hgood : List.Forall₂ (fun (a : Γ × Dir3) (t : Tape) =>
      (t.head = 0 → a.1 = t.cells t.head) ∧
      (a.2 ≠ Dir3.right → t.head ≠ 0) ∧ t.head ≤ W) (stepActs tm c) (cfgTapes c)) :
    cfgBlocks W c' =
      padTo (blockRuler W) (stateCode c'.state) ::
        (List.zipWith (fun a t =>
          [(tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
              (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).1,
           (tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
              (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).2])
          (stepActs tm c) (cfgTapes c)).flatten

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapeBlocks_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem tapeBlocks_length (W : ℕ) (t : Tape) :

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapeBlocks_step
statement:
theorem tapeBlocks_step {W : ℕ} (a : Γ × Dir3) (t : Tape)
    (hs : t.head = 0 → a.1 = t.cells t.head)
    (hne : a.2 ≠ Dir3.right → t.head ≠ 0) (hW : t.head ≤ W) :
    tapeBlocks W ((t.write a.1).move a.2) =
      [(tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
          (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).1,
       (tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
          (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).2]

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapeBlocks_width
statement:
theorem tapeBlocks_width (W : ℕ) (t : Tape) :

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapeCode_length

@[simp] theorem tapeCode_length (W : ℕ) (t : Tape) :

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapeStepBlocks_eq
statement:
theorem tapeStepBlocks_eq {W : ℕ} (t : Tape) (s : Γ) (d : Dir3)
    (hs : t.head = 0 → s = t.cells t.head)
    (hne : d ≠ Dir3.right → t.head ≠ 0) (hW : t.head ≤ W) :
    tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) s d
        (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t)) (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))
      = (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode ((t.write s).move d)),
          padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode ((t.write s).move d) W))

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapesBlocks_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem tapesBlocks_length (W : ℕ) (ts : List Tape) :

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapesBlocks_tapesStep
statement:
theorem tapesBlocks_tapesStep {W : ℕ} :
    ∀ (acts : List (Γ × Dir3)) (ts : List Tape),
      List.Forall₂ (fun (a : Γ × Dir3) (t : Tape) =>
        (t.head = 0 → a.1 = t.cells t.head) ∧
        (a.2 ≠ Dir3.right → t.head ≠ 0) ∧ t.head ≤ W) acts ts →
      tapesBlocks W (tapesStep acts ts) =
        (List.zipWith (fun a t =>
          [(tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
              (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).1,
           (tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
              (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).2]) acts ts).flatten

name: Complexity.Cobham.worksCode_length

@[simp] theorem worksCode_length {k : ℕ} (W : ℕ) (work : Fin k → Tape) :

name: Complexity.Cobham.blockAt_cfgCode_tape
statement:
theorem blockAt_cfgCode_tape {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q]
    (W : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Q) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < (cfgTapes c).length) :
    blockAt (blockRuler W) (cfgCode W c) (2 * j + 1)
        = padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode (cfgTapes c)[j]) ∧
      blockAt (blockRuler W) (cfgCode W c) (2 * j + 2)
        = padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode (cfgTapes c)[j] W)

name: Complexity.Cobham.branchFn_eq
statement:
theorem branchFn_eq {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) {c c' : Cfg k tm.Q} {W : ℕ}
    (h : tm.step c = some c') (hout : c.output.StartInvariant)
    (hwork : ∀ i, (c.work i).StartInvariant)
    (hgood : List.Forall₂ (fun (a : Γ × Dir3) (t : Tape) =>
      (t.head = 0 → a.1 = t.cells t.head) ∧
      (a.2 ≠ Dir3.right → t.head ≠ 0) ∧ t.head ≤ W) (stepActs tm c) (cfgTapes c)) :
    branchFn (blockRuler W) (stateCode c'.state) (stepActs tm c) (cfgCode W c)
      = cfgCode W c'

statement:
theorem readsFn_eq {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q]

theorem stepBranch_step {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) (R : List Bool)

name: Complexity.Cobham.stepFn_apply

theorem stepFn_apply {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) (c : Cfg k tm.Q) {W : ℕ}

    stepFn tm (blockRuler W) (cfgCode W c)
      = stepBranch tm (blockRuler W) (c.state, cfgReads c) (cfgCode W c)

theorem stepFn_eq {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) {c c' : Cfg k tm.Q} {W : ℕ}

    (hW : ∀ t ∈ cfgTapes c, t.head ≤ W)
    (hout : c.output.StartInvariant) (hwork : ∀ i, (c.work i).StartInvariant)
    (hgood : List.Forall₂ (fun (a : Γ × Dir3) (t : Tape) =>
      (t.head = 0 → a.1 = t.cells t.head) ∧
      (a.2 ≠ Dir3.right → t.head ≠ 0) ∧ t.head ≤ W) (stepActs tm c) (cfgTapes c)) :
    stepFn tm (blockRuler W) (cfgCode W c) = cfgCode W c'

statement:
theorem tapesStepFn_eq {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q]
    (W : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Q) :
    ∀ (acts : List (Γ × Dir3)) (j : ℕ), j + acts.length ≤ (cfgTapes c).length →
      tapesStepFn (blockRuler W) acts j (cfgCode W c)
        = ((List.zipWith (fun a t =>
            [(tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
                (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).1,
             (tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
                (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).2])
            acts ((cfgTapes c).drop j)).flatten).flatten

name: Complexity.min_mul_iterate
statement:
theorem min_mul_iterate (b c : ℕ) :
    ∀ j, (fun x => min (b * x) c)^[j] (min 1 c) = min (b ^ j) c
  | 0 => by rw [Function.iterate_zero_apply, pow_zero]
  | j + 1 => by
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', min_mul_iterate b c j, pow_succ]
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos b with rfl | hb
      · simp
      · rw [mul_comm (b ^ j) b]
        rcases le_total (b ^ j) c with h | h
        · rw [min_eq_left h]
        · have hc : c ≤ b * c

name: Complexity.chi_sum
statement:
theorem chi_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ZMod 2) :
    chi (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∏ i ∈ s, chi (f i)

name: Complexity.eq_tensorAssign_of_consistent
statement:
theorem eq_tensorAssign_of_consistent (a : Cube n) (b : Cube (n * n))
    (h : ∀ x y : Cube n, hadamard b (tensor x y) = hadamard a x * hadamard a y) :
    b = tensorAssign a

name: Complexity.eq_tensorAssign_of_prob_consistent
statement:
theorem eq_tensorAssign_of_prob_consistent (a : Cube n) (b : Cube (n * n))
    (h : 3 / 4 < Pr₂[fun y x =>
      hadamard b (tensor x y) = hadamard a x * hadamard a y]) :
    b = tensorAssign a

name: Complexity.expect_add
statement:
theorem expect_add (f g : BooleanFunction n) :
    𝔼[fun x => f x + g x] = 𝔼[f] + 𝔼[g]

name: Complexity.expect_const_mul
statement:
theorem expect_const_mul (c : ℝ) (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    𝔼[fun x => c * f x] = c * 𝔼[f]

name: Complexity.expect_mono
statement: theorem expect_mono {f g : BooleanFunction n} (h : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) : 𝔼[f] ≤ 𝔼[g]

name: Complexity.expect_one
statement: theorem expect_one : 𝔼[fun _ : Cube n => (1 : ℝ)] = 1

name: Complexity.expect_signOf
statement:
theorem expect_signOf (F : BitFun n) :
    𝔼[signOf F] = 1 - 2 * Pr[fun x => F x ≠ 0]

name: Complexity.hadamard_add
statement:
theorem hadamard_add {m : ℕ} (b c z : Cube m) :
    hadamard (b + c) z = hadamard b z + hadamard c z

name: Complexity.hadamard_basisVec
statement: theorem hadamard_basisVec (a : Cube n) (i : Fin n) : hadamard a (basisVec i) = a i

name: Complexity.hadamard_tensor
statement:
theorem hadamard_tensor (a x y : Cube n) :
    hadamard (tensorAssign a) (tensor x y) = hadamard a x * hadamard a y

name: Complexity.hadamard_tensor_row
statement:
theorem hadamard_tensor_row (c : Cube (n * n)) (x y : Cube n) :
    hadamard c (tensor x y) = hadamard (tensorRow c y) x

name: Complexity.isLinear_signOf_hadamard
statement: theorem isLinear_signOf_hadamard (a : Cube n) : IsLinear (signOf (hadamard a))

name: Complexity.parityFun_basis
statement:
theorem parityFun_basis (S : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) :
    (χ S) (basisVec i) = if i ∈ S then -1 else 1

name: Complexity.parity_eq_signOf_hadamard
statement:
theorem parity_eq_signOf_hadamard (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (χ S) = signOf (hadamard (indicatorAssign S))

name: Complexity.prob_all_reads
statement:
theorem prob_all_reads {m k : ℕ} (f : BooleanFunction n) (_hf : IsBooleanValued f)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) {ε : ℝ} (hclose : IsClose f (χ S) ε)
    (blk : Fin k → Cube m → Cube n)
    (hblk : ∀ (i : Fin k) (P : Cube n → Prop),
      Pr[fun z : Cube m => P (blk i z)] = Pr[P])
    (pts : Fin k → Cube n) :
    1 - k * (2 * ε) ≤ Pr[fun z : Cube m =>
      ∀ i, f (blk i z) * f (pts i + blk i z) = (χ S) (pts i)]

name: Complexity.prob_consistency_of_honest
statement:
theorem prob_consistency_of_honest (a : Cube n) :
    Pr₂[fun y x =>
      hadamard (tensorAssign a) (tensor x y) = hadamard a x * hadamard a y] = 1

name: Complexity.prob_corrected_read_left
statement:
theorem prob_corrected_read_left (f : BooleanFunction n) (_hf : IsBooleanValued f)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) {ε : ℝ} (hclose : IsClose f (χ S) ε) (x : Cube n) :
    1 - 2 * ε ≤ Pr[fun z : Cube (n + n) =>
      f (leftBlock z) * f (x + leftBlock z) = (χ S) x]

name: Complexity.prob_corrected_read_right
statement:
theorem prob_corrected_read_right (f : BooleanFunction n) (_hf : IsBooleanValued f)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) {ε : ℝ} (hclose : IsClose f (χ S) ε) (x : Cube n) :
    1 - 2 * ε ≤ Pr[fun z : Cube (n + n) =>
      f (rightBlock z) * f (x + rightBlock z) = (χ S) x]

name: Complexity.prob_hadamard_ne_zero
statement:
theorem prob_hadamard_ne_zero (a : Cube n) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Pr[fun x => hadamard a x ≠ 0] = 1 / 2

name: Complexity.prob_mono
statement: theorem prob_mono {P Q : Cube n → Prop} (h : ∀ x, P x → Q x) : Pr[P] ≤ Pr[Q]

name: Complexity.prob_tensorRow_ne_zero
statement:
theorem prob_tensorRow_ne_zero (c : Cube (n * n)) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    1 / 2 ≤ Pr[fun y => tensorRow c y ≠ 0]

name: Complexity.prob_two_corrected_reads
statement:
theorem prob_two_corrected_reads (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) {ε : ℝ} (hclose : IsClose f (χ S) ε) (x x' : Cube n) :
    1 - 4 * ε ≤ Pr[fun z : Cube (n + n) =>
      f (leftBlock z) * f (x + leftBlock z) = (χ S) x
        ∧ f (rightBlock z) * f (x' + rightBlock z) = (χ S) x']

name: Complexity.prob₂_compl
statement:
theorem prob₂_compl (P : Cube n → Cube n → Prop) :
    Pr₂[P] + Pr₂[fun x y => ¬ P x y] = 1

name: Complexity.prob₂_of_forall
statement: theorem prob₂_of_forall {P : Cube n → Cube n → Prop} (h : ∀ x y, P x y) : Pr₂[P] = 1

name: Complexity.prob₂_tensor_ne_zero
statement:
theorem prob₂_tensor_ne_zero (c : Cube (n * n)) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    1 / 4 ≤ Pr₂[fun y x => hadamard c (tensor x y) ≠ 0]

name: Complexity.sat_of_checks
statement:
theorem sat_of_checks (a : Cube n) (b : Cube (n * n)) (C : QuadConstraint n)
    (hcons : ∀ x y : Cube n, hadamard b (tensor x y) = hadamard a x * hadamard a y)
    (hcheck : checkValue (hadamard b) (hadamard a) C = 0) :
    C.Sat a

name: Complexity.sat_of_prob_checks
statement:
theorem sat_of_prob_checks (a : Cube n) (b : Cube (n * n)) (C : QuadConstraint n)
    (hcons : 3 / 4 < Pr₂[fun y x =>
      hadamard b (tensor x y) = hadamard a x * hadamard a y])
    (hcheck : checkValue (hadamard b) (hadamard a) C = 0) :
    C.Sat a

name: Complexity.signOf_hadamard
statement:
theorem signOf_hadamard (a : Cube n) :
    signOf (hadamard a) = χ (Finset.univ.filter fun i => a i = 1)

name: Complexity.tensor_basisVec
statement:
theorem tensor_basisVec (i j : Fin n) :
    tensor (basisVec i) (basisVec j) = basisVec (finProdFinEquiv (i, j))

name: Complexity.QuadConstraint.sat_combine
statement:
theorem QuadConstraint.sat_combine {J : ℕ} (C : Fin J → QuadConstraint n) (a : Cube n)
    (h : ∀ j, (C j).Sat a) (c : Cube J) : (QuadConstraint.combine C c).Sat a

name: Complexity.QuadConstraint.sat_trivial
statement: theorem QuadConstraint.sat_trivial (a : Cube n) : (QuadConstraint.trivial n).Sat a

name: Complexity.checkValue_combine
statement:
theorem checkValue_combine {J : ℕ} (a : Cube n) (b : Cube (n * n))
    (C : Fin J → QuadConstraint n) (c : Cube J) :
    checkValue (hadamard b) (hadamard a) (QuadConstraint.combine C c)
      = hadamard (fun j => checkValue (hadamard b) (hadamard a) (C j)) c

name: Complexity.eq_basis_of_sum_one
statement:
theorem eq_basis_of_sum_one {T : ℕ} (y : Fin T → ZMod 2) (hsum : ∑ m, y m = 1)
    (hpair : ∀ m m', m ≠ m' → y m * y m' = 0) :
    ∃ m₀, y m₀ = 1 ∧ ∀ m, m ≠ m₀ → y m = 0

name: Complexity.exists_sat_oneHotSystem_iff
statement:
theorem exists_sat_oneHotSystem_iff {k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Cube k)) (w : Cube k) :
    (∃ a : Cube (k + 2 ^ k), leftBlock a = w ∧ ∀ j, (oneHotSystem S j).Sat a) ↔ w ∈ S

name: Complexity.forall_checkValue_of_prob
statement:
theorem forall_checkValue_of_prob {J : ℕ} (a : Cube n) (b : Cube (n * n))
    (C : Fin J → QuadConstraint n)
    (h : 1 / 2 < Pr[fun c : Cube J =>
      checkValue (hadamard b) (hadamard a) (QuadConstraint.combine C c) = 0]) :
    ∀ j, checkValue (hadamard b) (hadamard a) (C j) = 0

name: Complexity.forall_oneHotSystem_iff
statement:
theorem forall_oneHotSystem_iff {k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Cube k)) (a : Cube (k + 2 ^ k)) :
    (∀ j, (oneHotSystem S j).Sat a) ↔ ∀ x, (oneHotOf S x).Sat a

name: Complexity.hadamard_add_arg
statement:
theorem hadamard_add_arg (a x y : Cube n) :
    hadamard a (x + y) = hadamard a x + hadamard a y

name: Complexity.hadamard_append
statement:
theorem hadamard_append {k t : ℕ} (a : Cube (k + t)) (u : Cube k) (v : Cube t) :
    hadamard a (Fin.append u v) = hadamard (leftBlock a) u + hadamard (rightBlock a) v

name: Complexity.hadamard_smul_arg
statement:
theorem hadamard_smul_arg (a : Cube n) (c : ZMod 2) (x : Cube n) :
    hadamard a (fun i => c * x i) = c * hadamard a x

name: Complexity.hadamard_sum_smul
statement:
theorem hadamard_sum_smul {J : ℕ} (a : Cube n) (c : Cube J) (v : Fin J → Cube n) :
    hadamard a (fun i => ∑ j, c j * v j i) = ∑ j, c j * hadamard a (v j)

name: Complexity.hadamard_tensorAssign_basisVec
statement:
theorem hadamard_tensorAssign_basisVec (a : Cube n) (u v : Fin n) :
    hadamard (tensorAssign a) (basisVec (finProdFinEquiv (u, v))) = a u * a v

name: Complexity.hadamard_zero_arg
statement: theorem hadamard_zero_arg (a : Cube n) : hadamard a 0 = 0

name: Complexity.leftBlock_oneHotExtend
statement: theorem leftBlock_oneHotExtend {k : ℕ} (w : Cube k) : leftBlock (oneHotExtend w) = w

name: Complexity.mem_of_sat_oneHotSystem
statement:
theorem mem_of_sat_oneHotSystem {k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Cube k)) (a : Cube (k + 2 ^ k))
    (h : ∀ j, (oneHotSystem S j).Sat a) : leftBlock a ∈ S

name: Complexity.rightBlock_oneHotExtend
statement:
theorem rightBlock_oneHotExtend {k : ℕ} (w : Cube k) (m : Fin (2 ^ k)) :
    rightBlock (oneHotExtend w) m = if m = candIdx k w then 1 else 0

name: Complexity.sat_oneHotSystem_extend
statement:
theorem sat_oneHotSystem_extend {k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Cube k)) (w : Cube k) (hw : w ∈ S) :
    ∀ j, (oneHotSystem S j).Sat (oneHotExtend w)

name: Complexity.sat_oneHot_allowed_iff
statement:
theorem sat_oneHot_allowed_iff {k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Cube k)) (a : Cube (k + 2 ^ k))
    (m : Fin (2 ^ k)) (hm : (candIdx k).symm m ∉ S) :
    (oneHotOf S (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl m)))).Sat a ↔ rightBlock a m = 0

name: Complexity.sat_oneHot_coord_iff
statement:
theorem sat_oneHot_coord_iff {k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Cube k)) (a : Cube (k + 2 ^ k)) (i : Fin k) :
    (oneHotOf S (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i)))).Sat a
      ↔ leftBlock a i + ∑ m, rightBlock a m * ((candIdx k).symm m) i = 0

name: Complexity.sat_oneHot_pair_iff
statement:
theorem sat_oneHot_pair_iff {k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Cube k)) (a : Cube (k + 2 ^ k))
    (m m' : Fin (2 ^ k)) (hne : m ≠ m') :
    (oneHotOf S (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (m, m')))).Sat a ↔ rightBlock a m * rightBlock a m' = 0

name: Complexity.sat_oneHot_sum_iff
statement:
theorem sat_oneHot_sum_iff {k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Cube k)) (a : Cube (k + 2 ^ k)) :
    (oneHotOf S (Sum.inl ())).Sat a ↔ ∑ m, rightBlock a m = 1

name: Complexity.checkValue_eq_zero_of_prob
statement:
theorem checkValue_eq_zero_of_prob (a : Cube n) (b : Cube (n * n)) (C : QuadConstraint n)
    (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) {ε : ℝ}
    (hfc : IsClose f (signOf (hadamard a)) ε)
    (g : BooleanFunction (n * n)) (hg : IsBooleanValued g) {ε' : ℝ}
    (hgc : IsClose g (signOf (hadamard b)) ε')
    (hprob : 2 * ε + 2 * ε' < Pr[ConstraintAccepts f g C]) :
    checkValue (hadamard b) (hadamard a) C = 0

name: Complexity.corrected_read_honest
statement:
theorem corrected_read_honest {m : ℕ} (a x r : Cube m) :
    signOf (hadamard a) r * signOf (hadamard a) (x + r) = chi (hadamard a x)

name: Complexity.eq_tensorAssign_of_prob_tester
statement:
theorem eq_tensorAssign_of_prob_tester (a : Cube n) (b : Cube (n * n))
    (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) {ε : ℝ}
    (hfc : IsClose f (signOf (hadamard a)) ε)
    (g : BooleanFunction (n * n)) (hg : IsBooleanValued g) {ε' : ℝ}
    (hgc : IsClose g (signOf (hadamard b)) ε')
    (haccept : 3 / 4 + (4 * ε + 2 * ε') < Pr[TesterAccepts f g]) :
    b = tensorAssign a

name: Complexity.hadamard_add_right
statement:
theorem hadamard_add_right {m : ℕ} (a x r : Cube m) :
    hadamard a (x + r) = hadamard a x + hadamard a r

name: Complexity.prob_constraint_reads
statement:
theorem prob_constraint_reads (a : Cube n) (b : Cube (n * n)) (C : QuadConstraint n)
    (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) {ε : ℝ}
    (hfc : IsClose f (signOf (hadamard a)) ε)
    (g : BooleanFunction (n * n)) (hg : IsBooleanValued g) {ε' : ℝ}
    (hgc : IsClose g (signOf (hadamard b)) ε') :
    1 - (2 * ε + 2 * ε') ≤ Pr[fun z : Cube (n + n * n) =>
      f (leftBlock z) * f (C.lin + leftBlock z) = chi (hadamard a C.lin)
        ∧ g (rightBlock z) * g (C.quad + rightBlock z) = chi (hadamard b C.quad)]

name: Complexity.prob_read_ge
statement:
theorem prob_read_ge {m : ℕ} (f : BooleanFunction m) (_hf : IsBooleanValued f)
    (a : Cube m) {ε : ℝ} (hc : IsClose f (signOf (hadamard a)) ε) (x : Cube m) :
    1 - 2 * ε ≤ Pr[fun r : Cube m => f r * f (x + r) = chi (hadamard a x)]

name: Complexity.prob_reads_correct
Complexity.prob_testerAccepts_of_honest
statement:
theorem prob_testerAccepts_of_honest (a : Cube n) :
    Pr[TesterAccepts (signOf (hadamard a)) (signOf (hadamard (tensorAssign a)))] = 1

name: Complexity.readsCorrect_of_honest
statement:
theorem readsCorrect_of_honest (a : Cube n) (z : Cube ((n + n) + (n + (n + n * n)))) :
    ReadsCorrect a (tensorAssign a) (signOf (hadamard a))
      (signOf (hadamard (tensorAssign a))) z

name: Complexity.sat_of_prob_tester
statement:
theorem sat_of_prob_tester (a : Cube n) (b : Cube (n * n)) (C : QuadConstraint n)
    (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) {ε : ℝ}
    (hfc : IsClose f (signOf (hadamard a)) ε)
    (g : BooleanFunction (n * n)) (hg : IsBooleanValued g) {ε' : ℝ}
    (hgc : IsClose g (signOf (hadamard b)) ε')
    (haccept : 3 / 4 + (4 * ε + 2 * ε') < Pr[TesterAccepts f g])
    (hcheck : checkValue (hadamard b) (hadamard a) C = 0) :
    C.Sat a

name: Complexity.signBit_chi
statement: theorem signBit_chi (u : ZMod 2) : signBit (chi u) = u

name: Complexity.testerAccepts_of_honest
statement:
theorem testerAccepts_of_honest (a : Cube n) (z : Cube ((n + n) + (n + (n + n * n)))) :
    TesterAccepts (signOf (hadamard a)) (signOf (hadamard (tensorAssign a))) z

name: Complexity.bitDist_eq_one_sub
statement:
theorem bitDist_eq_one_sub {m : ℕ} (s t : Cube m → ZMod 2) :
    bitDist s t = 1 - Pr[fun r => s r = t r]

name: Complexity.bitDist_hadamard
statement:
theorem bitDist_hadamard {m : ℕ} (u v : Cube m) (h : u ≠ v) :
    bitDist (hadamard u) (hadamard v) = 1 / 2

name: Complexity.coordAccepts_of_honest
statement:
theorem coordAccepts_of_honest {m : ℕ} (a : Cube n) (idx : Cube m → Fin n) (z : Cube (m + n)) :
    CoordAccepts (signOf (hadamard a)) (fun r => a (idx r)) idx z

name: Complexity.forall_checkValue_of_prob_combined
statement:
theorem forall_checkValue_of_prob_combined {J : ℕ} (a : Cube n) (b : Cube (n * n))
    (C : Fin J → QuadConstraint n)
    (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) {ε : ℝ}
    (hfc : IsClose f (signOf (hadamard a)) ε)
    (g : BooleanFunction (n * n)) (hg : IsBooleanValued g) {ε' : ℝ}
    (hgc : IsClose g (signOf (hadamard b)) ε')
    (haccept : 1 / 2 + (2 * ε + 2 * ε') < Pr[fun z : Cube (J + (n + n * n)) =>
      ConstraintAccepts f g (QuadConstraint.combine C (leftBlock z)) (rightBlock z)]) :
    ∀ j, checkValue (hadamard b) (hadamard a) (C j) = 0

name: Complexity.prob_coord_eq_ge
statement:
theorem prob_coord_eq_ge {m : ℕ} (a : Cube n) (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f)
    {ε : ℝ} (hfc : IsClose f (signOf (hadamard a)) ε)
    (w : Cube m → ZMod 2) (idx : Cube m → Fin n) :
    Pr[CoordAccepts f w idx] - 2 * ε ≤ Pr[fun r : Cube m => a (idx r) = w r]

name: Complexity.Tester.complete
statement:
theorem complete (S : Finset (Cube (kOf B))) (a : Cube (nOf B))
    (ha : ∀ j, (oneHotSystem S j).Sat a) (z : Cube (ROf B)) :
    AllChecks S (tailPart a) (headPart a) (hadamard a) (hadamard (tensorAssign a)) z

name: Complexity.Tester.constraintAccepts_of_honest
statement:
theorem constraintAccepts_of_honest {m : ℕ} (a : Cube m) (C : QuadConstraint m) (hC : C.Sat a)
    (z : Cube (m + m * m)) :
    ConstraintAccepts (signOf (hadamard a)) (signOf (hadamard (tensorAssign a))) C z

name: Complexity.Tester.isBooleanValued_signOf
statement: theorem isBooleanValued_signOf {m : ℕ} (F : Cube m → ZMod 2) : IsBooleanValued (signOf F)

name: Complexity.Tester.linCheck_hadamard
statement:
theorem linCheck_hadamard {m : ℕ} (a : Cube m) (x : Cube (m + m)) :
    LinCheck (signOf (hadamard a)) x

name: Complexity.Tester.prob_blk1
statement: theorem prob_blk1 (P : Cube (R1 B) → Prop) : Pr[fun z : Cube (ROf B) => P (blk1 z)] = Pr[P]

name: Complexity.Tester.prob_blk2
statement: theorem prob_blk2 (P : Cube (R2 B) → Prop) : Pr[fun z : Cube (ROf B) => P (blk2 z)] = Pr[P]

name: Complexity.Tester.prob_blk3
statement: theorem prob_blk3 (P : Cube (R3 B) → Prop) : Pr[fun z : Cube (ROf B) => P (blk3 z)] = Pr[P]

name: Complexity.Tester.prob_blk4
statement: theorem prob_blk4 (P : Cube (R4 B) → Prop) : Pr[fun z : Cube (ROf B) => P (blk4 z)] = Pr[P]

name: Complexity.Tester.prob_blk5
statement: theorem prob_blk5 (P : Cube (R5 B) → Prop) : Pr[fun z : Cube (ROf B) => P (blk5 z)] = Pr[P]

name: Complexity.Tester.prob_blk6
statement: theorem prob_blk6 (P : Cube (R5 B) → Prop) : Pr[fun z : Cube (ROf B) => P (blk6 z)] = Pr[P]

name: Complexity.Tester.prob_linCheck
statement:
theorem prob_linCheck {m : ℕ} (f : BooleanFunction m) :
    Pr[LinCheck f] = blrAcceptProb f

name: Complexity.RegCSP.accepts_compose_iff
statement:
theorem accepts_compose_iff (T : MultiTest.Table (R.Pos (B := B))) (p : R.Dart)
    (z : Cube (ROf B)) :
    (R.compose enc).accepts T p z = true
      ↔ AllChecks (R.satSet enc p) (R.tailTable T p) (R.headTable T p) (R.linTable T p)
          (R.quadTable T p) z

name: Complexity.RegCSP.headPart_of_leftBlock
statement:
theorem headPart_of_leftBlock (σ τ : β) (a : Cube (nOf B))
    (h : leftBlock a = inputVec enc σ τ) : headPart a = hadamard (enc τ)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.mem_satSet_iff
statement:
theorem mem_satSet_iff (p : R.Dart) (w : Cube (kOf B)) :
    w ∈ R.satSet enc p ↔ ∃ σ τ, R.rel p.1 p.2 σ τ = true ∧ inputVec enc σ τ = w

name: Complexity.RegCSP.satisfiable_compose
statement: theorem satisfiable_compose (h : R.Satisfiable) : (R.compose enc).toGraph.Satisfiable

name: Complexity.RegCSP.tailPart_of_leftBlock
statement:
theorem tailPart_of_leftBlock (σ τ : β) (a : Cube (nOf B))
    (h : leftBlock a = inputVec enc σ τ) : tailPart a = hadamard (enc σ)

name: Complexity.Tester.allChecks_iff
statement:
theorem allChecks_iff (S : Finset (Cube (kOf B))) (Tt Th : Cube B → ZMod 2)
    (F : Cube (nOf B) → ZMod 2) (G : Cube (nOf B * nOf B) → ZMod 2) (z : Cube (ROf B)) :
    AllChecks S Tt Th F G z ↔ bitFormula S z (readsOf Tt Th F G S z)

name: Complexity.card_readIdx
statement: theorem card_readIdx : Fintype.card ReadIdx = 22

name: Complexity.chi_eq_chi_iff
statement: theorem chi_eq_chi_iff (u v : ZMod 2) : chi u = chi v ↔ u = v

name: Complexity.signBit_signOf_mul
statement:
theorem signBit_signOf_mul {m : ℕ} (F : Cube m → ZMod 2) (u v : Cube m) :
    signBit (signOf F u * signOf F v) = F u + F v

name: Complexity.signOf_mul_eq_iff
statement:
theorem signOf_mul_eq_iff {m : ℕ} (F : Cube m → ZMod 2) (u v w : Cube m) :
    signOf F u * signOf F v = signOf F w ↔ F u + F v = F w

name: Complexity.NumEnc.digit_sum
statement:
theorem digit_sum {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) (g : ℕ → ℕ) :
    ∀ {n j : ℕ}, j < n → (∀ i < n, g i < c) →
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, g i * c ^ i) / c ^ j % c = g j

name: Complexity.NumEnc.encAt_lt
statement:
theorem encAt_lt {n : ℕ} [NumEnc α] (f : Fin n → α) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < n) :
    encAt f i < card α

name: Complexity.NumEnc.get_eq

name: Complexity.NumEnc.sum_digits
statement:
theorem sum_digits {c : ℕ} :
    ∀ {n i : ℕ}, i < c ^ n → ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (i / c ^ j % c) * c ^ j = i

name: Complexity.MultiTest.enc_edge
statement:
theorem enc_edge (x : M.Edge) :
    enc x = enc x.1 * (card (Cube M.R) * card Q) + (enc x.2.1 * card Q + enc x.2.2)

name: Complexity.MultiTest.enc_edgeOf
statement: theorem enc_edgeOf (k : Fin (Fintype.card M.Edge)) : enc (M.edgeOf k) = k.val

name: Complexity.MultiTest.val_head_toGraph
statement:
theorem val_head_toGraph (k : Fin (Fintype.card M.Edge)) :
    (M.toGraph.head k).val
      = enc (M.pos (M.edgeOf k).1 (M.edgeOf k).2.1 (M.edgeOf k).2.2)

name: Complexity.MultiTest.val_tail_toGraph
statement:
theorem val_tail_toGraph (k : Fin (Fintype.card M.Edge)) :
    (M.toGraph.tail k).val

name: Complexity.RegCSP.enc_dart
statement:
theorem enc_dart (p : R.Dart) :

name: Complexity.RegCSP.enc_pos_inl
statement:
theorem enc_pos_inl (v : R.graph.V) (y : Cube B) :
    NumEnc.enc (Sum.inl (v, y) : R.Pos (B := B))
      = NumEnc.enc v * card (Cube B) + NumEnc.enc y

name: Complexity.RegCSP.enc_pos_lin
statement:
theorem enc_pos_lin (p : R.Dart) (y : Cube (nOf B)) :
    NumEnc.enc (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (p, y)) : R.Pos (B := B))
      = card R.graph.V * card (Cube B)
        + (NumEnc.enc p * card (Cube (nOf B)) + NumEnc.enc y)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.enc_pos_quad
statement:
theorem enc_pos_quad (p : R.Dart) (y : Cube (nOf B * nOf B)) :
    NumEnc.enc (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (p, y)) : R.Pos (B := B))
      = card R.graph.V * card (Cube B)
        + (card R.Dart * card (Cube (nOf B))
          + (NumEnc.enc p * card (Cube (nOf B * nOf B)) + NumEnc.enc y))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.spectralBound_union

    (union G H e).SpectralBound
      (((G.deg : ℝ) + (H.deg : ℝ) * lam) / ((G.deg : ℝ) + (H.deg : ℝ)))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.step_union
statement:
theorem step_union (f : G.V → ℝ) (v : G.V) :
    (union G H e).step f v
      = ((G.deg : ℝ) * G.step f v + (H.deg : ℝ) * H.step (fun u => f (e u)) (e.symm v))
        / ((G.deg : ℝ) + (H.deg : ℝ))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_sq_step_union_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_step_union_le {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (hH : H.SpectralBound lam)
    (f : G.V → ℝ) (hf : (∑ v : G.V, f v) = 0) :
    (∑ v : G.V, ((union G H e).step f v) ^ 2)
      ≤ (((G.deg : ℝ) + (H.deg : ℝ) * lam) / ((G.deg : ℝ) + (H.deg : ℝ))) ^ 2
        * ∑ v : G.V, (f v) ^ 2

name: Complexity.idxOf_eq_countP
statement:
theorem idxOf_eq_countP {β : Type} [BEq β] [LawfulBEq β] {key : β → ℕ} :
    ∀ {l : List β}, List.Pairwise (fun p q => key p ≤ key q) l →
      (∀ p ∈ l, ∀ q ∈ l, key p = key q → p = q) →
      ∀ {x : β}, x ∈ l → l.idxOf x = l.countP fun q => decide (key q < key x)
  | [], _, _, _, hx => by simp at hx
  | a :: t, hpair, hinj, x, hx => by
      rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hpair
      by_cases hxa : x = a
      · subst hxa
        have hzero : (t.countP fun q => decide (key q < key x)) = 0

name: Complexity.orderEmbOfFin_eq_of_countBelow
statement:
theorem orderEmbOfFin_eq_of_countBelow {S : Finset ℕ} {k : ℕ} (h : S.card = k) (i : Fin k)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ S) (hcount : countBelow S p = i.val) : S.orderEmbOfFin h i = p

theorem countBelow_cloudCodes (v : Fin G.numVerts) (c : ℕ) :

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.halfCode_getElem_cloudList
statement:
theorem halfCode_getElem_cloudList (v : Fin G.numVerts) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k < (G.cloudList v).length) :
    (G.cloudCodes v).orderEmbOfFin (G.card_cloudCodes_eq_length v) ⟨k, hk⟩

name: Complexity.RegGraph.eq_mean_add_center
statement: theorem eq_mean_add_center (f : G.V → ℝ) : f = fun v => G.mean f + G.center f v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.inner_stepIter_eq
statement:
theorem inner_stepIter_eq (hn : 0 < G.order) (t : ℕ) (f g : G.V → ℝ) :
    ∑ v : G.V, f v * G.stepIter t g v
      = (∑ v : G.V, f v) * (∑ v : G.V, g v) / (G.order : ℝ)
        + ∑ v : G.V, G.center f v * G.stepIter t (G.center g) v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.mixing_sq
statement:
theorem mixing_sq {lam : ℝ} (h : G.SpectralBound lam) (hn : 0 < G.order) (t : ℕ)
    (f g : G.V → ℝ) :
    (∑ v : G.V, f v * G.stepIter t g v
        - (∑ v : G.V, f v) * (∑ v : G.V, g v) / (G.order : ℝ)) ^ 2
      ≤ lam ^ (2 * t) * ((∑ v : G.V, (f v) ^ 2) - (∑ v : G.V, f v) ^ 2 / (G.order : ℝ))
          * ((∑ v : G.V, (g v) ^ 2) - (∑ v : G.V, g v) ^ 2 / (G.order : ℝ))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.stepIter_add
statement:
theorem stepIter_add (t : ℕ) (f g : G.V → ℝ) :
    G.stepIter t (fun w => f w + g w) = fun v => G.stepIter t f v + G.stepIter t g v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.stepIter_const
statement: theorem stepIter_const (t : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : G.stepIter t (fun _ => c) = fun _ => c

name: Complexity.RegGraph.step_add
statement:
theorem step_add (f g : G.V → ℝ) (v : G.V) :
    G.step (fun w => f w + g w) v = G.step f v + G.step g v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.step_const
statement: @[simp] theorem step_const (c : ℝ) (v : G.V) : G.step (fun _ => c) v = c

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_center
statement: theorem sum_center (hn : 0 < G.order) (f : G.V → ℝ) : ∑ v : G.V, G.center f v = 0

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_sq_center
statement:
theorem sum_sq_center (hn : 0 < G.order) (f : G.V → ℝ) :
    ∑ v : G.V, (G.center f v) ^ 2
      = (∑ v : G.V, (f v) ^ 2) - (∑ v : G.V, f v) ^ 2 / (G.order : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_sq_center_nonneg
statement: theorem sum_sq_center_nonneg (f : G.V → ℝ) : 0 ≤ ∑ v : G.V, (G.center f v) ^ 2

name: Complexity.RegGraph.card_dartsBetween_compl_ge
statement:
theorem card_dartsBetween_compl_ge {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (h : G.SpectralBound lam)
    (hn : 0 < G.order) (S : Finset G.V) :
    (1 - lam) * (G.deg : ℝ) * ((S.card : ℝ) * (Sᶜ.card : ℝ) / (G.order : ℝ))
      ≤ ((G.dartsBetween S Sᶜ).card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.mixing_sq_indicator
statement:
theorem mixing_sq_indicator {lam : ℝ} (h : G.SpectralBound lam) (hn : 0 < G.order)
    (S T : Finset G.V) :
    (((G.dartsBetween S T).card : ℝ) / (G.deg : ℝ)
        - (S.card : ℝ) * (T.card : ℝ) / (G.order : ℝ)) ^ 2
      ≤ lam ^ 2 * ((S.card : ℝ) - (S.card : ℝ) ^ 2 / (G.order : ℝ))
        * ((T.card : ℝ) - (T.card : ℝ) ^ 2 / (G.order : ℝ))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_indicator
statement:
@[simp] theorem sum_indicator (S : Finset G.V) :
    ∑ v : G.V, G.indicator S v = (S.card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_indicator_mul_step
statement:
theorem sum_indicator_mul_step (S T : Finset G.V) :
    ∑ v : G.V, G.indicator S v * G.step (G.indicator T) v
      = ((G.dartsBetween S T).card : ℝ) / (G.deg : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_sq_indicator
statement:
@[simp] theorem sum_sq_indicator (S : Finset G.V) :
    ∑ v : G.V, (G.indicator S v) ^ 2 = (S.card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.exists_plurality
statement:
theorem exists_plurality {β α : Type} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.cloud_disagreement_bound
statement:
theorem cloud_disagreement_bound (A : (G.reduce E).Assignment) (v : Fin G.numVerts) :
    (1 - E.lam) * (E.degree : ℝ) * ((G.devIdx A v).card : ℝ) / (Fintype.card α : ℝ)

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.cloud_filter_eq_image

theorem cloud_filter_eq_image (v : Fin G.numVerts) (P : G.HalfEdge → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    (G.cloud v).filter P

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.card_unsatDarts_ge
statement:
theorem card_unsatDarts_ge (A : (G.reduce E).Assignment) :
    min 1 ((1 - E.lam) * (E.degree : ℝ) / (Fintype.card α : ℝ))
        * ((G.unsatEdges (G.decode A)).card : ℝ)
      ≤ (((G.reduce E).unsatDarts A).card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.cloud_charge_le_card_cloudDarts

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_unsatDarts_addTrivial
statement:
theorem card_unsatDarts_addTrivial (a : R.Assignment) :
    ((R.addTrivial H e).unsatDarts a).card = (R.unsatDarts a).card

name: Complexity.RegCSP.graph_addTrivial
statement: @[simp] theorem graph_addTrivial : (R.addTrivial H e).graph = RegGraph.union R.graph H e

name: Complexity.RegCSP.graph_expanderize
statement:
@[simp] theorem graph_expanderize [NumEnc R.graph.V] (E : ExpanderFamily) :
    (R.expanderize E).graph = E.expanderize R.graph

name: Complexity.RegCSP.satisfiable_addTrivial_iff
statement: theorem satisfiable_addTrivial_iff : (R.addTrivial H e).Satisfiable ↔ R.Satisfiable

name: Complexity.RegCSP.satisfiable_expanderize_iff
statement:
theorem satisfiable_expanderize_iff [NumEnc R.graph.V] (E : ExpanderFamily) :

name: Complexity.RegCSP.spectralBound_expanderize
statement:
theorem spectralBound_expanderize [NumEnc R.graph.V] (E : ExpanderFamily) :
    (R.expanderize E).graph.SpectralBound
      (((R.graph.deg : ℝ) + (E.degree : ℝ) * E.lam)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.unsatFrac_addTrivial

theorem unsatFrac_addTrivial (a : R.Assignment) :
