name: Complexity.RegCSP.unsatFrac_expanderize
statement:
theorem unsatFrac_expanderize [NumEnc R.graph.V] (E : ExpanderFamily) (a : R.Assignment) :
    (R.expanderize E).unsatFrac a
      = R.unsatFrac a * (R.graph.deg : ℚ) / ((R.graph.deg : ℚ) + (E.degree : ℚ))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.unsatVal_addTrivial
statement:
theorem unsatVal_addTrivial [Fintype α] [Nonempty α] :
    (R.addTrivial H e).unsatVal
      = R.unsatVal * (R.graph.deg : ℚ) / ((R.graph.deg : ℚ) + (H.deg : ℚ))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.unsatVal_expanderize
statement:
theorem unsatVal_expanderize [Fintype α] [Nonempty α] [NumEnc R.graph.V] (E : ExpanderFamily) :
    (R.expanderize E).unsatVal
      = R.unsatVal * (R.graph.deg : ℚ) / ((R.graph.deg : ℚ) + (E.degree : ℚ))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.card_walks
statement: theorem card_walks (t : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Fin t → G.D) = G.deg ^ t

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_mul_walkEnd
statement:
theorem sum_mul_walkEnd (f g : G.V → ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    ∑ v : G.V, ∑ s : Fin t → G.D, f v * g (G.walkEnd t v s)
      = (G.deg : ℝ) ^ t * ∑ v : G.V, f v * G.stepIter t g v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_walkEnd
statement:
theorem sum_walkEnd (f : G.V → ℝ) (t : ℕ) (v : G.V) :
    ∑ s : Fin t → G.D, f (G.walkEnd t v s) = (G.deg : ℝ) ^ t * G.stepIter t f v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkEnd_cons
statement:
theorem walkEnd_cons (t : ℕ) (v : G.V) (i : G.D) (s : Fin t → G.D) :
    G.walkEnd (t + 1) v (Fin.cons i s) = G.walkEnd t (G.nbr v i) s

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkEnd_succ
statement:
theorem walkEnd_succ (t : ℕ) (v : G.V) (s : Fin (t + 1) → G.D) :
    G.walkEnd (t + 1) v s = G.walkEnd t (G.nbr v (s 0)) (fun j => s j.succ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkEnd_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem walkEnd_zero (v : G.V) (s : Fin 0 → G.D) : G.walkEnd 0 v s = v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.Loops.nbr_loop
statement: @[simp] theorem nbr_loop (v : G.V) : G.nbr v (L.loop v) = v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.Loops.padWalk_of_ge
statement:
theorem padWalk_of_ge {t : ℕ} (v : G.V) (s : Fin t → G.D) {k h : ℕ} (j : Fin h)
    (hj : ¬ j.val < min k t) :
    L.padWalk v s k h j = L.loop (G.walkAt t v s k)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.Loops.padWalk_of_lt
statement:
theorem padWalk_of_lt {t : ℕ} (v : G.V) (s : Fin t → G.D) {k h : ℕ} (j : Fin h)
    (hj : j.val < min k t) :
    L.padWalk v s k h j = s ⟨j.val, lt_of_lt_of_le hj (min_le_right k t)⟩

name: Complexity.RegGraph.Loops.walkAt_padWalk_of_ge
Complexity.RegGraph.Loops.walkAt_padWalk_of_le
Complexity.RegGraph.Loops.walkEnd_padWalk
Complexity.RegGraph.walkAt_eq_walkEnd_prefix
statement:
theorem walkAt_eq_walkEnd_prefix {t : ℕ} (v : G.V) (s : Fin t → G.D) :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ t),
      G.walkAt t v s k = G.walkEnd k v (fun j : Fin k => s (Fin.castLE hk j))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkAt_of_le
statement:
theorem walkAt_of_le {t : ℕ} (v : G.V) (s : Fin t → G.D) :
    ∀ {k : ℕ}, t ≤ k → G.walkAt t v s k = G.walkAt t v s t

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkAt_self_eq_walkEnd
statement:
theorem walkAt_self_eq_walkEnd {t : ℕ} (v : G.V) (s : Fin t → G.D) :
    G.walkAt t v s t = G.walkEnd t v s

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkAt_succ_of_ge
statement:
theorem walkAt_succ_of_ge {t : ℕ} (v : G.V) (s : Fin t → G.D) {k : ℕ} (h : t ≤ k) :
    G.walkAt t v s (k + 1) = G.walkAt t v s k

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkAt_succ_of_lt
statement:
theorem walkAt_succ_of_lt {t : ℕ} (v : G.V) (s : Fin t → G.D) {k : ℕ} (h : k < t) :
    G.walkAt t v s (k + 1) = G.nbr (G.walkAt t v s k) (s ⟨k, h⟩)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkAt_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem walkAt_zero (t : ℕ) (v : G.V) (s : Fin t → G.D) :
    G.walkAt t v s 0 = v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkEnd_snoc
statement:
theorem walkEnd_snoc : ∀ (t : ℕ) (v : G.V) (s : Fin t → G.D) (i : G.D),
    G.walkEnd (t + 1) v (Fin.snoc s i) = G.nbr (G.walkEnd t v s) i

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_unsatDarts_addLoops
statement:
theorem card_unsatDarts_addLoops (a : R.Assignment) :
    (R.addLoops.unsatDarts a).card = (R.unsatDarts a).card

name: Complexity.RegCSP.graph_addLoops
statement: @[simp] theorem graph_addLoops : R.addLoops.graph = R.graph.addLoops

name: Complexity.RegCSP.satisfiable_addLoops_iff
statement: theorem satisfiable_addLoops_iff : R.addLoops.Satisfiable ↔ R.Satisfiable

name: Complexity.RegCSP.unsatFrac_addLoops
statement:
theorem unsatFrac_addLoops (a : R.Assignment) :
    R.addLoops.unsatFrac a
      = R.unsatFrac a * (R.graph.deg : ℚ) / ((R.graph.deg : ℚ) + 1)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.unsatVal_addLoops
statement:
theorem unsatVal_addLoops [Fintype α] [Nonempty α] :
    R.addLoops.unsatVal = R.unsatVal * (R.graph.deg : ℚ) / ((R.graph.deg : ℚ) + 1)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.V_addLoops
statement: @[simp] theorem V_addLoops : G.addLoops.V = G.V

name: Complexity.RegGraph.V_loopGraph
statement:
@[simp] theorem V_loopGraph (V : Type) [DecidableEq V] [Fintype V] :
    (loopGraph V).V = V

name: Complexity.RegGraph.addLoops_bound_lt_one
statement:
theorem addLoops_bound_lt_one {lam : ℝ} (hlam1 : lam < 1) :
    (1 + (G.deg : ℝ) * lam) / (1 + (G.deg : ℝ)) < 1

name: Complexity.RegGraph.deg_addLoops
statement: @[simp] theorem deg_addLoops : G.addLoops.deg = 1 + G.deg

name: Complexity.RegGraph.deg_loopGraph
statement:
@[simp] theorem deg_loopGraph (V : Type) [DecidableEq V] [Fintype V] :
    (loopGraph V).deg = 1

name: Complexity.RegGraph.order_addLoops
statement: @[simp] theorem order_addLoops : G.addLoops.order = G.order

name: Complexity.RegGraph.spectralBound_addLoops
statement:
theorem spectralBound_addLoops {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (h : G.SpectralBound lam) :
    G.addLoops.SpectralBound ((1 + (G.deg : ℝ) * lam) / (1 + (G.deg : ℝ)))

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.deg_preprocess
statement: @[simp] theorem deg_preprocess : (G.preprocess E).graph.deg = 2 + 2 * E.degree

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.le_unsatVal_preprocess
statement:
theorem le_unsatVal_preprocess :
    preprocessConst E α * ((G.unsatVal : ℚ) : ℝ)
      ≤ (((G.preprocess E).unsatVal : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.order_preprocess
statement: @[simp] theorem order_preprocess : (G.preprocess E).graph.order = 2 * G.numEdges

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.preprocessLam_lt_one
statement: theorem preprocessLam_lt_one : preprocessLam E < 1

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.preprocess_eq
statement: theorem preprocess_eq : G.preprocess E = ((G.reduce E).expanderize E).addLoops

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.satisfiable_preprocess_of_satisfiable
statement:
theorem satisfiable_preprocess_of_satisfiable (h : G.Satisfiable) :
    (G.preprocess E).Satisfiable

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.spectralBound_preprocess
statement:
theorem spectralBound_preprocess :
    (G.preprocess E).graph.SpectralBound (preprocessLam E)

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.unsatVal_preprocess_eq
statement:
theorem unsatVal_preprocess_eq :
    ((G.preprocess E).unsatVal : ℚ)
      = (G.reduce E).unsatVal
        * ((1 + E.degree : ℕ) : ℚ) / (((1 + E.degree : ℕ) : ℚ) + (E.degree : ℚ))
        * ((1 + 2 * E.degree : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((((1 + 2 * E.degree : ℕ) : ℚ)) + 1)

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.cloudStepNum_eq
statement:
theorem cloudStepNum_eq (p : G.HalfEdge) (j : Fin E.degree) :
    G.cloudStepNum E (G.owner p) (enc p) j
      = (enc (G.cloudRot E p j).1, (G.cloudRot E p j).2.val)

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.enc_flipHalf
statement:
theorem enc_flipHalf (p : G.HalfEdge) :
    enc (G.flipHalf p) = if enc p % 2 = 0 then enc p + 1 else enc p - 1

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.enc_halfEdge
statement: theorem enc_halfEdge (p : G.HalfEdge) : enc p = G.halfCode p

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.enc_preCloud
statement: theorem enc_preCloud (j : Fin E.degree) : enc (G.preCloud E j) = 2 + j.val

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.enc_preEdge
statement: theorem enc_preEdge : enc (G.preEdge E) = 1

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.enc_preExp
statement: theorem enc_preExp (j : Fin E.degree) : enc (G.preExp E j) = 2 + E.degree + j.val

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.enc_preLoop
statement: theorem enc_preLoop : enc (G.preLoop E) = 0

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.enc_vertexEquiv
statement:
theorem enc_vertexEquiv (x : Fin (G.reduce E).graph.order) :
    enc (E.vertexEquiv (G.reduce E).graph x) = x.val

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.ownerNum_enc
statement: theorem ownerNum_enc (p : G.HalfEdge) : G.ownerNum (enc p) = (G.owner p).val

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.preDart_cases
statement:
theorem preDart_cases (d : (G.preprocess E).graph.D) :
    d = G.preLoop E ∨ d = G.preEdge E ∨ (∃ j, d = G.preCloud E j) ∨ ∃ j, d = G.preExp E j

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.preRotNum_eq
statement:
theorem preRotNum_eq (v : G.HalfEdge) (d : (G.preprocess E).graph.D) :
    G.preRotNum E (enc v) (enc d)
      = (enc (((G.preprocess E).graph.rot (v, d)).1 : G.HalfEdge),
        enc ((G.preprocess E).graph.rot (v, d)).2)

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.rot_preCloud
statement:
theorem rot_preCloud (v : G.HalfEdge) (j : Fin E.degree) :
    (G.preprocess E).graph.rot (v, G.preCloud E j)
      = ((G.cloudRot E v j).1, G.preCloud E (G.cloudRot E v j).2)

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.rot_preEdge
statement:
theorem rot_preEdge (v : G.HalfEdge) :
    (G.preprocess E).graph.rot (v, G.preEdge E) = (G.flipHalf v, G.preEdge E)

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.rot_preExp
statement:
theorem rot_preExp (v : G.HalfEdge) (j : Fin E.degree) :
    (G.preprocess E).graph.rot (v, G.preExp E j)
      = (E.vertexEquiv (G.reduce E).graph
            (E.rot (G.reduce E).graph.order
              ((E.vertexEquiv (G.reduce E).graph).symm v, j)).1,
          G.preExp E (E.rot (G.reduce E).graph.order
            ((E.vertexEquiv (G.reduce E).graph).symm v, j)).2)

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.rot_preLoop
statement:
theorem rot_preLoop (v : (G.preprocess E).graph.V) :
    (G.preprocess E).graph.rot (v, G.preLoop E) = (v, G.preLoop E)

name: Complexity.ConstraintGraph.val_vertexEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem val_vertexEquiv_symm (v : (G.reduce E).graph.V) :
    ((E.vertexEquiv (G.reduce E).graph).symm v).val = enc v

name: Complexity.Amplifier.dichotomy
statement:
theorem dichotomy (G : ConstraintGraph α) {k : ℕ} (hk : G.numEdges ≤ 2 ^ k) :
    (G.Satisfiable → (A.iter k G).Satisfiable) ∧
      (¬ G.Satisfiable → A.gap ≤ (A.iter k G).unsatVal)

name: Complexity.Amplifier.gap_le_unsatVal_iter
statement:
theorem gap_le_unsatVal_iter {G : ConstraintGraph α} (h : ¬ G.Satisfiable) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : G.numEdges ≤ 2 ^ k) : A.gap ≤ (A.iter k G).unsatVal

name: Complexity.Amplifier.iter_succ
statement:
theorem iter_succ (k : ℕ) (G : ConstraintGraph α) :
    A.iter (k + 1) G = A.transform (A.iter k G)

name: Complexity.Amplifier.iter_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem iter_zero (G : ConstraintGraph α) : A.iter 0 G = G

name: Complexity.Amplifier.numEdges_iter_le
statement:
theorem numEdges_iter_le (k : ℕ) (G : ConstraintGraph α) :
    (A.iter k G).numEdges ≤ A.edgeFactor ^ k * G.numEdges

name: Complexity.Amplifier.satisfiable_iter
statement:
theorem satisfiable_iter {G : ConstraintGraph α} (h : G.Satisfiable) (k : ℕ) :
    (A.iter k G).Satisfiable

name: Complexity.Amplifier.unsatVal_iter_eq_zero_of_satisfiable
statement:
theorem unsatVal_iter_eq_zero_of_satisfiable {G : ConstraintGraph α}
    (h : G.Satisfiable) (k : ℕ) : (A.iter k G).unsatVal = 0

name: Complexity.Amplifier.unsatVal_iter_ge
statement:
theorem unsatVal_iter_ge (k : ℕ) (G : ConstraintGraph α) :
    min A.gap (2 ^ k * G.unsatVal) ≤ (A.iter k G).unsatVal

name: Complexity.RegGraph.card_walks_stepDart_mem
statement:
theorem card_walks_stepDart_mem {t : ℕ} {k : ℕ} (hk : k < t) (S : Finset (G.V × G.D)) :
    ∑ v : G.V, (Finset.univ.filter fun s : Fin t → G.D =>
        (G.walkAt t v s k, s ⟨k, hk⟩) ∈ S).card
      = G.deg ^ (t - 1) * S.card

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_cons_split
statement:
theorem sum_cons_split {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (m : ℕ) (F : (Fin (m + 1) → G.D) → M) :
    (∑ r : Fin (m + 1) → G.D, F r)
      = ∑ i : G.D, ∑ r : Fin m → G.D, F (Fin.cons i r)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_stepDart
statement:
theorem sum_stepDart {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] :
    ∀ (k t : ℕ) (hk : k < t) (f : G.V × G.D → M),
      (∑ v : G.V, ∑ s : Fin t → G.D, f (G.walkAt t v s k, s ⟨k, hk⟩))
        = (G.deg ^ (t - 1)) • ∑ p : G.V × G.D, f p

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_stepDart_fixed
statement:
theorem sum_stepDart_fixed (h : G.V → G.D → ℝ) :
    ∀ (k m : ℕ) (hk : k < m) (x : G.V),
      (∑ r : Fin m → G.D, h (G.walkAt m x r k) (r ⟨k, hk⟩))
        = (G.deg : ℝ) ^ (m - 1) * ∑ a : G.D, G.stepIter k (fun y => h y a) x

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_two_darts_fixed
statement:
theorem sum_two_darts_fixed (h₁ h₂ : G.V → G.D → ℝ) :
    ∀ (k l m : ℕ) (hkl : k < l) (hl : l < m) (x : G.V),
      (∑ r : Fin m → G.D, h₁ (G.walkAt m x r k) (r ⟨k, by omega⟩)
          * h₂ (G.walkAt m x r l) (r ⟨l, by omega⟩))
        = (G.deg : ℝ) ^ (m - 2) * ∑ a : G.D, ∑ b : G.D,
            G.stepIter k
              (fun y => h₁ y a * G.stepIter (l - k - 1) (fun z => h₂ z b) (G.nbr y a)) x

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkAt_cons
statement:
theorem walkAt_cons {t : ℕ} (v : G.V) (i : G.D) (s : Fin t → G.D) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, G.walkAt (t + 1) v (Fin.cons i s) (m + 1) = G.walkAt t (G.nbr v i) s m

name: Complexity.RegGraph.dartCount_le
statement: theorem dartCount_le (F : Finset (G.V × G.D)) (v : G.V) : G.dartCount F v ≤ G.deg

name: Complexity.RegGraph.headCount_le
statement: theorem headCount_le (F : Finset (G.V × G.D)) (z : G.V) : G.headCount F z ≤ G.deg

name: Complexity.RegGraph.stepIter_sum
statement:
theorem stepIter_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → G.V → ℝ) (t : ℕ) (v : G.V) :
    G.stepIter t (fun w => ∑ i ∈ s, f i w) v = ∑ i ∈ s, G.stepIter t (f i) v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.step_sum
statement:
theorem step_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → G.V → ℝ) (v : G.V) :
    G.step (fun w => ∑ i ∈ s, f i w) v = ∑ i ∈ s, G.step (f i) v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_dartCount
statement:
theorem sum_dartCount (F : Finset (G.V × G.D)) :
    ∑ v : G.V, G.dartCount F v = F.card

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_headCount
statement:
theorem sum_headCount (F : Finset (G.V × G.D)) :
    ∑ z : G.V, G.headCount F z = F.card

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_headCount_stepIter_le
statement:
theorem sum_headCount_stepIter_le (F : Finset (G.V × G.D)) {lam : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (hspec : G.SpectralBound lam) (hn : 0 < G.order) (t : ℕ) :
    ∑ z : G.V, (G.headCount F z : ℝ)
        * G.stepIter t (fun w => (G.dartCount F w : ℝ)) z
      ≤ (F.card : ℝ) * (F.card : ℝ) / (G.order : ℝ)
        + lam ^ t * ((G.deg : ℝ) * (F.card : ℝ))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_indicator_dartCount
statement:
theorem sum_indicator_dartCount (F : Finset (G.V × G.D)) (z : G.V) :
    ∑ b : G.D, (if (z, b) ∈ F then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = (G.dartCount F z : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_indicator_mul
statement:
theorem sum_indicator_mul (F : Finset (G.V × G.D)) (φ : G.V → ℝ) :
    ∑ a : G.D, ∑ y : G.V, (if (y, a) ∈ F then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * φ (G.nbr y a)
      = ∑ p ∈ F, φ (G.nbr p.1 p.2)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_indicator_nbr
statement:
theorem sum_indicator_nbr (F : Finset (G.V × G.D)) (h : G.V → ℝ) :
    ∑ p ∈ F, h (G.nbr p.1 p.2) = ∑ z : G.V, (G.headCount F z : ℝ) * h z

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_pairs_le
statement:
theorem sum_pairs_le (F : Finset (G.V × G.D)) {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam)
    (hlam1 : lam < 1) (hspec : G.SpectralBound lam) (hn : 0 < G.order) (m : ℕ)
    (C : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ l ∈ Finset.Ico (k + 1) m,
      C k l = ∑ z : G.V, (G.headCount F z : ℝ)
        * G.stepIter (l - k - 1) (fun w => (G.dartCount F w : ℝ)) z) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∑ l ∈ Finset.Ico (k + 1) m, C k l
      ≤ (m : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) * ((F.card : ℝ) * (F.card : ℝ) / (G.order : ℝ))
        + (m : ℝ) * (1 / (1 - lam)) * ((G.deg : ℝ) * (F.card : ℝ))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_sq_dartCount_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_dartCount_le (F : Finset (G.V × G.D)) :
    ∑ v : G.V, ((G.dartCount F v : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ (G.deg : ℝ) * (F.card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_sq_headCount_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_headCount_le (F : Finset (G.V × G.D)) :
    ∑ z : G.V, ((G.headCount F z : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ (G.deg : ℝ) * (F.card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_two_crossings
statement:
theorem sum_two_crossings (F : Finset (G.V × G.D)) {k l m : ℕ} (hkl : k < l) (hl : l < m) :
    (∑ x : G.V, ∑ r : Fin m → G.D,
        (if (G.walkAt m x r k, r ⟨k, by omega⟩) ∈ F then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
          * (if (G.walkAt m x r l, r ⟨l, by omega⟩) ∈ F then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
      = (G.deg : ℝ) ^ (m - 2)
        * ∑ z : G.V, (G.headCount F z : ℝ)
          * G.stepIter (l - k - 1) (fun w => (G.dartCount F w : ℝ)) z

name: Complexity.card_filter_eq_sum_prod
statement:
theorem card_filter_eq_sum_prod {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (P Q : ι → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q] :
    (((Finset.univ.filter fun i => P i ∧ Q i).card : ℕ) : ℝ)
      = ∑ i, (if P i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * (if Q i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

name: Complexity.card_sq_eq_add_two_mul_pairs
statement:
theorem card_sq_eq_add_two_mul_pairs {ι : Type*} [LinearOrder ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (S : Finset ι) :
    S.card ^ 2 = S.card + 2 * ((S ×ˢ S).filter fun p => p.1 < p.2).card

name: Complexity.geom_sum_le_inv
statement:
theorem geom_sum_le_inv {lam : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ lam) (h1 : lam < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, lam ^ i ≤ 1 / (1 - lam)

name: Complexity.sum_pairs_eq_sum_Ico
statement:
theorem sum_pairs_eq_sum_Ico {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (T : ℕ) (f : ℕ × ℕ → M) :
    ∑ p ∈ ((Finset.range T) ×ˢ (Finset.range T)).filter fun p => p.1 < p.2, f p
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range T, ∑ l ∈ Finset.Ico (k + 1) T, f (k, l)

name: Complexity.sum_pairs_geom_le
statement:
theorem sum_pairs_geom_le {lam : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ lam) (h1 : lam < 1) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∑ l ∈ Finset.Ico (k + 1) m, lam ^ (l - k - 1)
      ≤ (m : ℝ) * (1 / (1 - lam))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.D_power
statement: @[simp] theorem D_power (t : ℕ) : (G.power t).D = (Fin t → G.D)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.V_power
statement: @[simp] theorem V_power (t : ℕ) : (G.power t).V = G.V

name: Complexity.RegGraph.deg_power
statement: @[simp] theorem deg_power (t : ℕ) : (G.power t).deg = G.deg ^ t

name: Complexity.RegGraph.nbr_power
statement:
theorem nbr_power (t : ℕ) (v : G.V) (s : Fin t → G.D) :
    (G.power t).nbr v s = G.walkEnd t v s

name: Complexity.RegGraph.order_power
statement: @[simp] theorem order_power (t : ℕ) : (G.power t).order = G.order

name: Complexity.RegGraph.revWalk_revWalk
statement:
theorem revWalk_revWalk {t : ℕ} (v : G.V) (s : Fin t → G.D) :
    G.revWalk (G.walkEnd t v s) (G.revWalk v s) = s

name: Complexity.RegGraph.rot_dart
statement:
theorem rot_dart {t : ℕ} (v : G.V) (s : Fin t → G.D) (k : Fin t) :
    G.rot (G.walkAt t v s k.val, s k)
      = (G.walkAt t v s (k.val + 1), G.backLabel v s k)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.spectralBound_power
statement:
theorem spectralBound_power {lam : ℝ} (h : G.SpectralBound lam) (t : ℕ) :
    (G.power t).SpectralBound (lam ^ t)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.step_power
statement:
theorem step_power (t : ℕ) (f : G.V → ℝ) (v : G.V) :
    (G.power t).step f v = G.stepIter t f v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkAt_revWalk
statement:
theorem walkAt_revWalk {t : ℕ} (v : G.V) (s : Fin t → G.D) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ t →
      G.walkAt t (G.walkEnd t v s) (G.revWalk v s) k = G.walkAt t v s (t - k)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkEnd_revWalk
statement:
theorem walkEnd_revWalk {t : ℕ} (v : G.V) (s : Fin t → G.D) :
    G.walkEnd t (G.walkEnd t v s) (G.revWalk v s) = v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.V_killedPower
statement: @[simp] theorem V_killedPower (q T : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) : (G.killedPower q T hq).V = G.V

name: Complexity.RegGraph.card_killed_fibre
statement:
theorem card_killed_fibre {T q m : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hm : m < T) (w : Fin m → G.D) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun x : (Fin T → G.D) × (Fin T → Fin q) =>
        G.preWalk x.1 (le_of_lt hm) = w ∧ stopAt x.2 = m).card
      = G.deg ^ (T - m) * ((q - 1) ^ m * q ^ (T - m - 1))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.card_preWalk_eq
statement:
theorem card_preWalk_eq {T m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ T) (w : Fin m → G.D) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun s : Fin T → G.D => G.preWalk s hm = w).card
      = G.deg ^ (T - m)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.deg_killedPower
statement:
theorem deg_killedPower (q T : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (G.killedPower q T hq).deg = G.deg ^ T * q ^ T

name: Complexity.RegGraph.extWalk_extWalk
statement:
theorem extWalk_extWalk {T ℓ : ℕ} (r r' : Fin ℓ → G.D) (s : Fin T → G.D) :
    G.extWalk r' (G.extWalk r s) = G.extWalk r' s

name: Complexity.RegGraph.extWalk_preWalk
statement:
theorem extWalk_preWalk {T ℓ : ℕ} (h : ℓ ≤ T) (s : Fin T → G.D) :
    G.extWalk (G.preWalk s h) s = s

name: Complexity.RegGraph.killedEnd_killedRev
statement:
theorem killedEnd_killedRev {T q : ℕ} (v : G.V) (s : Fin T → G.D) (c : Fin T → Fin q) :
    G.killedEnd (G.killedEnd v s c) (G.killedRev v s c) c = v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.killedRev_killedRev
statement:
theorem killedRev_killedRev {T q : ℕ} (v : G.V) (s : Fin T → G.D) (c : Fin T → Fin q) :
    G.killedRev (G.killedEnd v s c) (G.killedRev v s c) c = s

name: Complexity.RegGraph.nbr_killedPower
statement:
theorem nbr_killedPower (q T : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (v : G.V)
    (x : (Fin T → G.D) × (Fin T → Fin q)) :
    (G.killedPower q T hq).nbr v x = G.killedEnd v x.1 x.2

name: Complexity.RegGraph.order_killedPower
statement:
@[simp] theorem order_killedPower (q T : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (G.killedPower q T hq).order = G.order

name: Complexity.RegGraph.preWalk_extWalk
statement:
theorem preWalk_extWalk {T ℓ : ℕ} (h : ℓ ≤ T) (r : Fin ℓ → G.D) (s : Fin T → G.D) :
    G.preWalk (G.extWalk r s) h = r

name: Complexity.card_le_stopAt
statement:
theorem card_le_stopAt {T q : ℕ} {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ T) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun c : Fin T → Fin q => m ≤ stopAt c).card
      = (q - 1) ^ m * q ^ (T - m)

name: Complexity.card_lt_stopAt
statement:
theorem card_lt_stopAt {T q : ℕ} {i : ℕ} (hi : i < T) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun c : Fin T → Fin q => i < stopAt c).card
      = (q - 1) ^ (i + 1) * q ^ (T - i - 1)

name: Complexity.card_stopAt_eq
statement:
theorem card_stopAt_eq {T q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) {m : ℕ} (hm : m < T) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun c : Fin T → Fin q => stopAt c = m).card
      = (q - 1) ^ m * q ^ (T - m - 1)

name: Complexity.lt_stopAt_iff
statement:
theorem lt_stopAt_iff {T q : ℕ} (c : Fin T → Fin q) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < T) :
    i < stopAt c ↔ ∀ (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ i), (c ⟨j, lt_of_le_of_lt hj hi⟩).val ≠ 0

name: Complexity.signal_eq_zero_of_stopAt_lt
statement:
theorem signal_eq_zero_of_stopAt_lt {T q : ℕ} (c : Fin T → Fin q) (h : stopAt c < T) :
    (c ⟨stopAt c, h⟩).val = 0

name: Complexity.signal_ne_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem signal_ne_zero_of_lt {T q : ℕ} (c : Fin T → Fin q) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < stopAt c) :
    (c ⟨j, lt_of_lt_of_le hj (stopAt_le c)⟩).val ≠ 0

name: Complexity.stopAt_eq_of
statement:
theorem stopAt_eq_of {T q : ℕ} (c : Fin T → Fin q) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ T)
    (hlt : ∀ (j : ℕ) (hj : j < m), (c ⟨j, lt_of_lt_of_le hj hm⟩).val ≠ 0)
    (hat : ∀ h : m < T, (c ⟨m, h⟩).val = 0) : stopAt c = m

name: Complexity.stopAt_le
statement: theorem stopAt_le {T q : ℕ} (c : Fin T → Fin q) : stopAt c ≤ T

name: Complexity.RegCSP.graph_killedPow
statement:
@[simp] theorem graph_killedPow :
    (R.killedPow q T hq).graph = R.graph.killedPower q T hq

name: Complexity.RegCSP.not_satisfies_killedPow_of_faulty
statement:
theorem not_satisfies_killedPow_of_faulty {σ : R.Assignment}
    (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (v : R.graph.V)
    (y : (Fin T → R.graph.D) × (Fin T → Fin q)) (i : Fin (R.graph.kLen y))
    (hfault : ¬ R.Satisfies σ
      (R.graph.walkAt (R.graph.kLen y) v (R.graph.kWalk y) i.val, R.graph.kWalk y i))
    (htruth₁ : A v (R.graph.startIdx (R.graph.kLen_le y) (R.graph.kWalk y) i)
      = σ (R.graph.walkAt (R.graph.kLen y) v (R.graph.kWalk y) i.val))
    (htruth₂ : A (R.graph.killedEnd v y.1 y.2)
        (R.graph.endIdx (R.graph.kLen_le y) v (R.graph.kWalk y) i)
      = σ (R.graph.walkAt (R.graph.kLen y) v (R.graph.kWalk y) (i.val + 1))) :
    ¬ (R.killedPow q T hq).Satisfies A (v, y)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.rel_killedPow_iff
statement:
theorem rel_killedPow_iff (v : R.graph.V) (x : (Fin T → R.graph.D) × (Fin T → Fin q))
    (a b : KOpinion R.graph T α) :
    (R.killedPow q T hq).rel v x a b = true
      ↔ ∀ i : Fin (R.graph.kLen x),
          R.rel (R.graph.walkAt (R.graph.kLen x) v (R.graph.kWalk x) i.val) (R.graph.kWalk x i)
            (a (R.graph.startIdx (R.graph.kLen_le x) (R.graph.kWalk x) i))
            (b (R.graph.endIdx (R.graph.kLen_le x) v (R.graph.kWalk x) i)) = true

name: Complexity.RegCSP.satisfiable_killedPow_of_satisfiable
statement:
theorem satisfiable_killedPow_of_satisfiable (hR : R.Satisfiable) :
    (R.killedPow q T hq).Satisfiable

name: Complexity.RegCSP.satisfies_killedPow_truthful
statement:
theorem satisfies_killedPow_truthful {σ : R.Assignment} (hσ : ∀ p, R.Satisfies σ p)
    (x : (R.killedPow q T hq).Dart) :
    (R.killedPow q T hq).Satisfies (R.kTruthful q T hq σ) x

name: Complexity.RegGraph.kLen_le
statement: theorem kLen_le {T q : ℕ} (x : (Fin T → G.D) × (Fin T → Fin q)) : G.kLen x ≤ T

name: Complexity.RegGraph.killedEnd_eq
statement:
theorem killedEnd_eq {T q : ℕ} (v : G.V) (x : (Fin T → G.D) × (Fin T → Fin q)) :
    G.killedEnd v x.1 x.2 = G.walkEnd (G.kLen x) v (G.kWalk x)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkEnd_endIdx
statement:
theorem walkEnd_endIdx {T ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : ℓ ≤ T) (v : G.V) (w : Fin ℓ → G.D) (i : Fin ℓ) :
    G.walkEnd (G.endIdx hℓ v w i).1.val (G.walkEnd ℓ v w) (G.endIdx hℓ v w i).2
      = G.walkAt ℓ v w (i.val + 1)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkEnd_startIdx
statement:
theorem walkEnd_startIdx {T ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : ℓ ≤ T) (v : G.V) (w : Fin ℓ → G.D) (i : Fin ℓ) :
    G.walkEnd (G.startIdx hℓ w i).1.val v (G.startIdx hℓ w i).2 = G.walkAt ℓ v w i.val

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_KLabels
statement: theorem card_KLabels : Fintype.card (R.KLabels q T) = R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_fibre_opinion
statement:
theorem card_fibre_opinion (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (v : R.graph.V)
    (val : α) {m : ℕ} (hm : m < T) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun x : R.KLabels q T =>
        stopAt x.2 = m ∧ R.kOpinionAbout q T hq A v x = val).card
      = (Finset.univ.filter fun w : Fin m → R.graph.D =>
          R.opinionOf q T hq A v (le_of_lt hm) w = val).card
        * (R.graph.deg ^ (T - m) * ((q - 1) ^ m * q ^ (T - m - 1)))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_fibre_truth
statement:
theorem card_fibre_truth (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (v : R.graph.V)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : m < T) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun x : R.KLabels q T =>
        stopAt x.2 = m ∧ R.kOpinionAbout q T hq A v x = R.kPlurality q T hq A v).card
      = R.truthCount q T hq A v m
        * (R.graph.deg ^ (T - m) * ((q - 1) ^ m * q ^ (T - m - 1)))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_le_card_mul_kOpinionCount
statement:
theorem card_le_card_mul_kOpinionCount (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment)
    (v : R.graph.V) :
    Fintype.card (R.KLabels q T)
      ≤ Fintype.card α * R.kOpinionCount q T hq A v (R.kPlurality q T hq A v)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_le_mul_sum_truthCount
statement:
theorem card_le_mul_sum_truthCount (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment)
    (v : R.graph.V) :
    R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T
      ≤ Fintype.card α * ((∑ m ∈ Finset.range T,
          R.truthCount q T hq A v m
            * (R.graph.deg ^ (T - m) * ((q - 1) ^ m * q ^ (T - m - 1))))
        + R.graph.deg ^ T * (q - 1) ^ T)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_stopAt_eq_top
statement:
theorem card_stopAt_eq_top :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun x : R.KLabels q T => stopAt x.2 = T).card
      = R.graph.deg ^ T * (q - 1) ^ T

name: Complexity.RegCSP.kOpinionAbout_eq_of_stopAt
statement:
theorem kOpinionAbout_eq_of_stopAt (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (v : R.graph.V)
    (x : R.KLabels q T) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ T) (h : stopAt x.2 = m) :
    R.kOpinionAbout q T hq A v x
      = R.opinionOf q T hq A v hm (R.graph.preWalk x.1 hm)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.kOpinionAbout_eq_opinionOf
statement:
theorem kOpinionAbout_eq_opinionOf (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (v : R.graph.V)
    (x : R.KLabels q T) :
    R.kOpinionAbout q T hq A v x
      = R.opinionOf q T hq A v (stopAt_le x.2) (R.graph.preWalk x.1 (stopAt_le x.2))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.kOpinionCount_eq_sum
statement:
theorem kOpinionCount_eq_sum (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (v : R.graph.V)
    (val : α) :
    R.kOpinionCount q T hq A v val
      = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (T + 1),
          (Finset.univ.filter fun x : R.KLabels q T =>
            stopAt x.2 = m ∧ R.kOpinionAbout q T hq A v x = val).card

name: Complexity.RegCSP.opinionOf_congr
statement:
theorem opinionOf_congr (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (v : R.graph.V)
    {m m' : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ T) (hm' : m' ≤ T) (hmm : m = m')
    (w : Fin m → R.graph.D) (w' : Fin m' → R.graph.D)
    (hw : ∀ (j : ℕ) (hj : j < m) (hj' : j < m'), w ⟨j, hj⟩ = w' ⟨j, hj'⟩) :
    R.opinionOf q T hq A v hm w = R.opinionOf q T hq A v hm' w'

name: Complexity.card_ge_of_moments
statement:
theorem card_ge_of_moments {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (N : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι)
    (hsupp : ∀ i, N i ≠ 0 → i ∈ S) {A B : ℝ} (hA0 : 0 ≤ A) (hA : A ≤ ∑ i, N i)
    (hB : ∑ i, (N i) ^ 2 ≤ B) (hB0 : 0 < B) :
    A ^ 2 / B ≤ (S.card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.sq_sum_div_sum_sq_le_card_support
statement:
theorem sq_sum_div_sum_sq_le_card_support {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (N : ι → ℝ)
    (h : 0 < ∑ i, (N i) ^ 2) :
    (∑ i, N i) ^ 2 / (∑ i, (N i) ^ 2)
      ≤ ((Finset.univ.filter fun i => N i ≠ 0).card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.sq_sum_le_card_support_mul_sum_sq
statement:
theorem sq_sum_le_card_support_mul_sum_sq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (N : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, N i) ^ 2 ≤ ((Finset.univ.filter fun i => N i ≠ 0).card : ℝ) * ∑ i, (N i) ^ 2

name: Complexity.RegGraph.card_crossing_eq
statement:
theorem card_crossing_eq {ℓ i : ℕ} (hi : i < ℓ) (a : G.V) (d : G.D)
    (Pre : (Fin i → G.D) → Prop) [DecidablePred Pre]
    (Suf : (Fin (ℓ - (i + 1)) → G.D) → Prop) [DecidablePred Suf] :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun x : G.V × (Fin ℓ → G.D) =>
        G.walkAt ℓ x.1 x.2 i = a ∧ x.2 ⟨i, hi⟩ = d
          ∧ Pre (G.revWalk x.1 (G.segPre x.2 (le_of_lt hi))) ∧ Suf (G.segSuf x.2 i)).card
      = (Finset.univ.filter Pre).card * (Finset.univ.filter Suf).card

name: Complexity.RegGraph.card_label_crossing
statement:
theorem card_label_crossing {T q ℓ i : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hℓ : ℓ < T) (hi : i < ℓ)
    (a : G.V) (d : G.D)
    (Pre : (Fin i → G.D) → Prop) [DecidablePred Pre]
    (Suf : (Fin (ℓ - (i + 1)) → G.D) → Prop) [DecidablePred Suf] :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun z : G.V × ((Fin T → G.D) × (Fin T → Fin q)) =>
        stopAt z.2.2 = ℓ ∧
          (G.walkAt ℓ z.1 (G.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hℓ)) i = a
            ∧ (G.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hℓ)) ⟨i, hi⟩ = d
            ∧ Pre (G.revWalk z.1 (G.segPre (G.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hℓ)) (le_of_lt hi)))
            ∧ Suf (G.segSuf (G.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hℓ)) i))).card
      = (Finset.univ.filter Pre).card * (Finset.univ.filter Suf).card
        * (G.deg ^ (T - ℓ) * ((q - 1) ^ ℓ * q ^ (T - ℓ - 1)))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.card_label_fibre
statement:
theorem card_label_fibre {T q ℓ : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hℓ : ℓ < T)
    (P : G.V × (Fin ℓ → G.D) → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun z : G.V × ((Fin T → G.D) × (Fin T → Fin q)) =>
        stopAt z.2.2 = ℓ ∧ P (z.1, G.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hℓ))).card
      = (Finset.univ.filter P).card
        * (G.deg ^ (T - ℓ) * ((q - 1) ^ ℓ * q ^ (T - ℓ - 1)))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.revWalk_segSuf
statement:
theorem revWalk_segSuf {ℓ : ℕ} (v : G.V) (W : Fin ℓ → G.D) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < ℓ) :
    G.revWalk (G.walkAt ℓ v W (i + 1)) (G.segSuf W i)
      = G.segPre (G.revWalk v W) (show ℓ - (i + 1) ≤ ℓ by omega)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.segGlue_split
statement:
theorem segGlue_split {ℓ i : ℕ} (hi : i < ℓ) (W : Fin ℓ → G.D) :
    G.segGlue (G.segPre W (le_of_lt hi)) (W ⟨i, hi⟩) (G.segSuf W i) = W

name: Complexity.RegGraph.segMid_segGlue
statement:
@[simp] theorem segMid_segGlue {ℓ i : ℕ} (hi : i < ℓ) (p : Fin i → G.D) (d : G.D)
    (s : Fin (ℓ - (i + 1)) → G.D) :
    G.segGlue p d s ⟨i, hi⟩ = d

name: Complexity.RegGraph.segPre_segGlue
statement:
@[simp] theorem segPre_segGlue {ℓ i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ ℓ) (p : Fin i → G.D) (d : G.D)
    (s : Fin (ℓ - (i + 1)) → G.D) :
    G.segPre (G.segGlue p d s) hi = p

name: Complexity.RegGraph.segSuf_segGlue
statement:
@[simp] theorem segSuf_segGlue {ℓ i : ℕ} (p : Fin i → G.D) (d : G.D)
    (s : Fin (ℓ - (i + 1)) → G.D) :
    G.segSuf (G.segGlue p d s) i = s

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkAt_preWalk
statement:
theorem walkAt_preWalk {T ℓ : ℕ} (h : ℓ ≤ T) (x : G.V) (s : Fin T → G.D) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ ℓ → G.walkAt ℓ x (G.preWalk s h) k = G.walkAt T x s k

name: Complexity.RegGraph.walkAt_segSuf
statement:
theorem walkAt_segSuf {ℓ : ℕ} (v : G.V) (W : Fin ℓ → G.D) (i : ℕ) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ ℓ - (i + 1) →
      G.walkAt (ℓ - (i + 1)) (G.walkAt ℓ v W (i + 1)) (G.segSuf W i) m
        = G.walkAt ℓ v W (i + 1 + m)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_both_good_le
statement:
theorem card_both_good_le (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) {k l : ℕ}
    (hk : k < T) (hl : l < T) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T =>
        k ∈ R.goodPos q T hq A z ∧ l ∈ R.goodPos q T hq A z).card
      ≤ q ^ T * (Finset.univ.filter fun w : R.graph.V × (Fin T → R.graph.D) =>
          (R.graph.walkAt T w.1 w.2 k, w.2 ⟨k, hk⟩) ∈ R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)
            ∧ (R.graph.walkAt T w.1 w.2 l, w.2 ⟨l, hl⟩)
              ∈ R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)).card

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_crossingSet
statement:
theorem card_crossingSet (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (a : R.graph.V)
    (d : R.graph.D) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i + j + 1 < T) (hiT : i ≤ T)
    (hjT : (i + j + 1) - (i + 1) ≤ T) :
    (R.crossingSet q T hq A a d hij hiT hjT).card
      = R.truthCount q T hq A a i * R.truthCount q T hq A (R.graph.nbr a d) j
        * (R.graph.deg ^ (T - (i + j + 1))
          * ((q - 1) ^ (i + j + 1) * q ^ (T - (i + j + 1) - 1)))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_dart_killedPow
statement:
theorem card_dart_killedPow :
    ((R.killedPow q T hq).graph.order * (R.killedPow q T hq).graph.deg : ℕ)
      = R.graph.order * (R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_goodPos
statement:
theorem card_goodPos (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment)
    (z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T) :
    (R.goodPos q T hq A z).card = (R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).card

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_good_crossing
statement:
theorem card_good_crossing (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (a : R.graph.V)
    (d : R.graph.D) {ℓ i : ℕ} (hℓ : ℓ < T) (hi : i < ℓ) (hiT : i ≤ T)
    (hjT : ℓ - (i + 1) ≤ T) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun z : R.graph.V × ((Fin T → R.graph.D) × (Fin T → Fin q)) =>
        stopAt z.2.2 = ℓ ∧
          (R.graph.walkAt ℓ z.1 (R.graph.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hℓ)) i = a
            ∧ (R.graph.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hℓ)) ⟨i, hi⟩ = d
            ∧ R.opinionOf q T hq A a hiT (R.graph.revWalk z.1
                (R.graph.segPre (R.graph.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hℓ)) (le_of_lt hi)))
              = R.kPlurality q T hq A a
            ∧ R.opinionOf q T hq A (R.graph.nbr a d) hjT
                (R.graph.segSuf (R.graph.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hℓ)) i)
              = R.kPlurality q T hq A (R.graph.nbr a d))).card
      = R.truthCount q T hq A a i
        * R.truthCount q T hq A (R.graph.nbr a d) (ℓ - (i + 1))
        * (R.graph.deg ^ (T - ℓ) * ((q - 1) ^ ℓ * q ^ (T - ℓ - 1)))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_good_crossing_sq
statement:
theorem card_good_crossing_sq (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (a : R.graph.V)
    (d : R.graph.D) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i + j + 1 < T) (hiT : i ≤ T)
    (hjT : (i + j + 1) - (i + 1) ≤ T) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun z : R.graph.V × ((Fin T → R.graph.D) × (Fin T → Fin q)) =>
        stopAt z.2.2 = i + j + 1 ∧
          (R.graph.walkAt (i + j + 1) z.1 (R.graph.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hij)) i = a
            ∧ (R.graph.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hij)) ⟨i, by omega⟩ = d
            ∧ R.opinionOf q T hq A a hiT (R.graph.revWalk z.1
                (R.graph.segPre (R.graph.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hij)) (by omega)))
              = R.kPlurality q T hq A a
            ∧ R.opinionOf q T hq A (R.graph.nbr a d) hjT
                (R.graph.segSuf (R.graph.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hij)) i)
              = R.kPlurality q T hq A (R.graph.nbr a d))).card
      = R.truthCount q T hq A a i * R.truthCount q T hq A (R.graph.nbr a d) j
        * (R.graph.deg ^ (T - (i + j + 1))
          * ((q - 1) ^ (i + j + 1) * q ^ (T - (i + j + 1) - 1)))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_le_mul_halfSum_add_loss
statement:
theorem card_le_mul_halfSum_add_loss (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment)
    (v : R.graph.V) {H : ℕ} (hH : H + 1 ≤ T) :
    R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T
      ≤ Fintype.card α * R.halfSum q T hq A v H
        + Fintype.card α * pluralityLoss R.graph.deg q T H

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_le_mul_sum_truthCount_half
statement:
theorem card_le_mul_sum_truthCount_half (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment)
    (v : R.graph.V) {H : ℕ} (hH : H + 1 ≤ T) :
    R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T
      ≤ Fintype.card α * ((∑ m ∈ Finset.range (H + 1),
            R.truthCount q T hq A v m
              * (R.graph.deg ^ (T - m) * ((q - 1) ^ m * q ^ (T - m - 1))))
          + R.graph.deg ^ T * (q - 1) ^ T
          + R.graph.deg ^ T * ((q - 1) ^ (H + 1) * q ^ (T - (H + 1))))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_pairs_goodPos
statement:
theorem card_pairs_goodPos (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment)
    (z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T) :
    (((R.goodPos q T hq A z) ×ˢ (R.goodPos q T hq A z)).filter fun p => p.1 < p.2).card
      = (((R.goodCrossings q T hq A z) ×ˢ (R.goodCrossings q T hq A z)).filter
          fun p => p.1 < p.2).card

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_unsatDarts_ge
statement:
theorem card_unsatDarts_ge (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) {Alb Bub : ℝ}
    (hA0 : 0 ≤ Alb)
    (hA : Alb ≤ ∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T, ((R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).card : ℝ))
    (hB : ∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T, ((R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).card : ℝ) ^ 2
      ≤ Bub) (hB0 : 0 < Bub) :
    Alb ^ 2 / Bub ≤ (((R.killedPow q T hq).unsatDarts A).card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.crossCount_eq_card
statement:
theorem crossCount_eq_card (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (p : R.Dart)
    {i j : ℕ} (hij : i + j + 1 < T) (hiT : i ≤ T) (hjT : (i + j + 1) - (i + 1) ≤ T) :
    R.crossCount q T hq A p i j = (R.crossingSet q T hq A p.1 p.2 hij hiT hjT).card

name: Complexity.RegCSP.crossCount_eq_prod
statement:
theorem crossCount_eq_prod (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (p : R.Dart)
    {i j : ℕ} (hij : i + j + 1 < T) :
    R.crossCount q T hq A p i j
      = R.truthCount q T hq A p.1 i * R.truthCount q T hq A (R.graph.nbr p.1 p.2) j
        * (R.graph.deg ^ (T - (i + j + 1))
          * ((q - 1) ^ (i + j + 1) * q ^ (T - (i + j + 1) - 1)))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.le_unsatVal_killedPow
statement:
theorem le_unsatVal_killedPow {LB : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment,
      LB ≤ (((R.killedPow q T hq).unsatFrac A : ℚ) : ℝ)) :
    LB ≤ (((R.killedPow q T hq).unsatVal : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.lt_T_of_mem_goodPos
statement:
theorem lt_T_of_mem_goodPos {A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment}
    {z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T} {k : ℕ} (h : k ∈ R.goodPos q T hq A z) : k < T

name: Complexity.RegCSP.mem_goodPos
statement:
theorem mem_goodPos {A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment}
    {z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T} {k : ℕ} :
    k ∈ R.goodPos q T hq A z
      ↔ ∃ h : k < R.graph.kLen z.2, (⟨k, h⟩ : Fin (R.graph.kLen z.2))
          ∈ R.goodCrossings q T hq A z

name: Complexity.RegCSP.mem_goodPos_of_crossing
statement:
theorem mem_goodPos_of_crossing (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (a : R.graph.V)
    (d : R.graph.D) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i + j + 1 < T) (hiT : i ≤ T)
    (hjT : (i + j + 1) - (i + 1) ≤ T)
    (hfault : ¬ R.Satisfies (R.kDecode q T hq A) (a, d))
    (z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T) (hlen : stopAt z.2.2 = i + j + 1)
    (hwalk : R.graph.walkAt (i + j + 1) z.1 (R.graph.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hij)) i = a)
    (hlab : R.graph.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hij) ⟨i, by omega⟩ = d)
    (hpre : R.opinionOf q T hq A a hiT (R.graph.revWalk z.1
        (R.graph.segPre (R.graph.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hij)) (by omega)))
      = R.kPlurality q T hq A a)
    (hsuf : R.opinionOf q T hq A (R.graph.nbr a d) hjT
        (R.graph.segSuf (R.graph.preWalk z.2.1 (le_of_lt hij)) i)
      = R.kPlurality q T hq A (R.graph.nbr a d)) :
    i ∈ R.goodPos q T hq A z

name: Complexity.RegCSP.mem_unsatDarts_of_goodCrossings_nonempty
statement:
theorem mem_unsatDarts_of_goodCrossings_nonempty (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment)
    (z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T) (h : (R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).Nonempty) :
    z ∈ (R.killedPow q T hq).unsatDarts A

name: Complexity.RegCSP.not_satisfies_of_good_crossing
statement:
theorem not_satisfies_of_good_crossing (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment)
    (z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T) (i : Fin (R.graph.kLen z.2))
    (hiT : i.val ≤ T) (hjT : R.graph.kLen z.2 - (i.val + 1) ≤ T)
    (hfault : ¬ R.Satisfies (R.kDecode q T hq A)
      (R.graph.walkAt (R.graph.kLen z.2) z.1 (R.graph.kWalk z.2) i.val,
        R.graph.kWalk z.2 i))
    (hpre : R.opinionOf q T hq A
        (R.graph.walkAt (R.graph.kLen z.2) z.1 (R.graph.kWalk z.2) i.val) hiT
        (R.graph.revWalk z.1 (R.graph.segPre (R.graph.kWalk z.2) (le_of_lt i.isLt)))
      = R.kDecode q T hq A
        (R.graph.walkAt (R.graph.kLen z.2) z.1 (R.graph.kWalk z.2) i.val))
    (hsuf : R.opinionOf q T hq A
        (R.graph.walkAt (R.graph.kLen z.2) z.1 (R.graph.kWalk z.2) (i.val + 1)) hjT
        (R.graph.segSuf (R.graph.kWalk z.2) i.val)
      = R.kDecode q T hq A
        (R.graph.walkAt (R.graph.kLen z.2) z.1 (R.graph.kWalk z.2) (i.val + 1))) :
    ¬ (R.killedPow q T hq).Satisfies A z

name: Complexity.RegCSP.opinionOf_eq_endIdx
statement:
theorem opinionOf_eq_endIdx (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) {ℓ : ℕ}
    (hℓ : ℓ ≤ T) (v : R.graph.V) (W : Fin ℓ → R.graph.D) (i : Fin ℓ)
    (hjT : ℓ - (i.val + 1) ≤ T) :
    R.opinionOf q T hq A (R.graph.walkAt ℓ v W (i.val + 1)) hjT
        (R.graph.segSuf W i.val)
      = A (R.graph.walkEnd ℓ v W) (R.graph.endIdx hℓ v W i)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.opinionOf_eq_startIdx
statement:
theorem opinionOf_eq_startIdx (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) {ℓ : ℕ}
    (hℓ : ℓ ≤ T) (v : R.graph.V) (W : Fin ℓ → R.graph.D) (i : Fin ℓ)
    (hiT : i.val ≤ T) :
    R.opinionOf q T hq A (R.graph.walkAt ℓ v W i.val) hiT
        (R.graph.revWalk v (R.graph.segPre W (le_of_lt i.isLt)))
      = A v (R.graph.startIdx hℓ W i)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.per_dart_lower
statement:
theorem per_dart_lower (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (a : R.graph.V)
    (d : R.graph.D) {H : ℕ} (hH : 2 * H + 1 < T) (hHT : H + 1 ≤ T)
    (C : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hC : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1),
      C i j = R.truthCount q T hq A a i * R.truthCount q T hq A (R.graph.nbr a d) j
        * (R.graph.deg ^ (T - (i + j + 1))
          * ((q - 1) ^ (i + j + 1) * q ^ (T - (i + j + 1) - 1)))) :
    (q - 1) * ((R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T
          - Fintype.card α * pluralityLoss R.graph.deg q T H)
        * (R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T
          - Fintype.card α * pluralityLoss R.graph.deg q T H))
      ≤ Fintype.card α ^ 2
        * ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), C i j)
          * (R.graph.deg ^ (T + 1) * q ^ T))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.powering_soundness
statement:
theorem powering_soundness (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) {H : ℕ}
    (hH : 2 * H + 1 < T) (hHT : H + 1 ≤ T)
    (hsq : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), i + j + 1 < T)
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam < 1) (hspec : R.graph.SpectralBound lam)
    (hn : 0 < R.graph.order)
    (hBub : 0 < (∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T, ((R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).card : ℝ))
      + 2 * ((q : ℝ) ^ T * ((R.graph.deg : ℝ) ^ (T - 2)
        * ((T : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) * (((R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)).card : ℝ)
              * ((R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)).card : ℝ) / (R.graph.order : ℝ))
          + (T : ℝ) * (1 / (1 - lam)) * ((R.graph.deg : ℝ)
              * ((R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)).card : ℝ)))))) :
    ((((R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)).card
          * ((q - 1) * ((R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T
                - Fintype.card α * pluralityLoss R.graph.deg q T H)
              * (R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T
                - Fintype.card α * pluralityLoss R.graph.deg q T H))) : ℕ) : ℝ)
        / ((Fintype.card α ^ 2 * (R.graph.deg ^ (T + 1) * q ^ T) : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ 2
      / ((∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T, ((R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).card : ℝ))
        + 2 * ((q : ℝ) ^ T * ((R.graph.deg : ℝ) ^ (T - 2)
          * ((T : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) * (((R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)).card : ℝ)
                * ((R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)).card : ℝ) / (R.graph.order : ℝ))
            + (T : ℝ) * (1 / (1 - lam)) * ((R.graph.deg : ℝ)
                * ((R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)).card : ℝ))))))
      ≤ (((R.killedPow q T hq).unsatDarts A).card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.sum_Cd_le_sum_goodCrossings
statement:
theorem sum_Cd_le_sum_goodCrossings (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) {H : ℕ}
    (hHT : H + 1 ≤ T) (Cd : R.Dart → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hCd : ∀ p ∈ R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A), ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1),
      ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), ∀ (hij : i + j + 1 < T) (hiT : i ≤ T)
        (hjT : (i + j + 1) - (i + 1) ≤ T),
      Cd p i j = (R.crossingSet q T hq A p.1 p.2 hij hiT hjT).card)
    (hsq : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), i + j + 1 < T) :
    ∑ p ∈ R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1),
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), Cd p i j
      ≤ ∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T, (R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).card

name: Complexity.RegCSP.sum_card_goodPos_eq
statement:
theorem sum_card_goodPos_eq (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) :
    ∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T, (R.goodPos q T hq A z).card
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range T,
        (Finset.univ.filter fun z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T =>
          k ∈ R.goodPos q T hq A z).card

name: Complexity.RegCSP.sum_card_pairs_eq
statement:
theorem sum_card_pairs_eq (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) :
    ∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T,
        (((R.goodPos q T hq A z) ×ˢ (R.goodPos q T hq A z)).filter fun p => p.1 < p.2).card
      = ∑ p ∈ ((Finset.range T) ×ˢ (Finset.range T)).filter fun p => p.1 < p.2,
        (Finset.univ.filter fun z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T =>
          p.1 ∈ R.goodPos q T hq A z ∧ p.2 ∈ R.goodPos q T hq A z).card

name: Complexity.RegCSP.sum_crossingSet_le
statement:
theorem sum_crossingSet_le (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) {i j : ℕ}
    (hij : i + j + 1 < T) (hiT : i ≤ T) (hjT : (i + j + 1) - (i + 1) ≤ T) :
    ∑ p ∈ R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A),
        (R.crossingSet q T hq A p.1 p.2 hij hiT hjT).card
      ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T =>
          stopAt z.2.2 = i + j + 1 ∧ i ∈ R.goodPos q T hq A z).card

name: Complexity.RegCSP.sum_dart_lower
statement:
theorem sum_dart_lower (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (F : Finset R.Dart)
    {H : ℕ} (hH : 2 * H + 1 < T) (hHT : H + 1 ≤ T)
    (Cd : R.Dart → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hCd : ∀ p ∈ F, ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1),
      Cd p i j = R.truthCount q T hq A p.1 i
        * R.truthCount q T hq A (R.graph.nbr p.1 p.2) j
        * (R.graph.deg ^ (T - (i + j + 1))
          * ((q - 1) ^ (i + j + 1) * q ^ (T - (i + j + 1) - 1)))) :
    F.card * ((q - 1) * ((R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T
          - Fintype.card α * pluralityLoss R.graph.deg q T H)
        * (R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T
          - Fintype.card α * pluralityLoss R.graph.deg q T H)))
      ≤ Fintype.card α ^ 2
        * ((∑ p ∈ F, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), Cd p i j)
          * (R.graph.deg ^ (T + 1) * q ^ T))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.sum_goodCrossings_ge
statement:
theorem sum_goodCrossings_ge (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) {H : ℕ}
    (hH : 2 * H + 1 < T) (hHT : H + 1 ≤ T)
    (hsq : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), i + j + 1 < T) :
    (((R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)).card
        * ((q - 1) * ((R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T
              - Fintype.card α * pluralityLoss R.graph.deg q T H)
            * (R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T
              - Fintype.card α * pluralityLoss R.graph.deg q T H))) : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ ((Fintype.card α ^ 2 * (R.graph.deg ^ (T + 1) * q ^ T) : ℕ) : ℝ)
        * ∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T, ((R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.sum_len_pos_le
statement:
theorem sum_len_pos_le (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) {H : ℕ} (hHT : H + 1 ≤ T) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1),
        (Finset.univ.filter fun z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T =>
          stopAt z.2.2 = i + j + 1 ∧ i ∈ R.goodPos q T hq A z).card
      ≤ ∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T, (R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).card

name: Complexity.RegCSP.sum_over_len_le
statement:
theorem sum_over_len_le (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (i H : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1),
        (Finset.univ.filter fun z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T =>
          stopAt z.2.2 = i + j + 1 ∧ i ∈ R.goodPos q T hq A z).card
      ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T =>
          i ∈ R.goodPos q T hq A z).card

name: Complexity.RegCSP.sum_pairs_bound
statement:
theorem sum_pairs_bound (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) {lam : ℝ}
    (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam < 1) (hspec : R.graph.SpectralBound lam)
    (hn : 0 < R.graph.order) :
    ∑ p ∈ ((Finset.range T) ×ˢ (Finset.range T)).filter fun p => p.1 < p.2,
        ((Finset.univ.filter fun z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T =>
          p.1 ∈ R.goodPos q T hq A z ∧ p.2 ∈ R.goodPos q T hq A z).card : ℝ)
      ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ T * ((R.graph.deg : ℝ) ^ (T - 2)
        * ((T : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) * (((R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)).card : ℝ)
              * ((R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)).card : ℝ) / (R.graph.order : ℝ))
          + (T : ℝ) * (1 / (1 - lam)) * ((R.graph.deg : ℝ)
              * ((R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)).card : ℝ))))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.sum_sq_goodCrossings
statement:
theorem sum_sq_goodCrossings (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) :
    ∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T, ((R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).card : ℝ) ^ 2
      = (∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T, ((R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).card : ℝ))
        + 2 * ∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T,
          ((((R.goodCrossings q T hq A z) ×ˢ (R.goodCrossings q T hq A z)).filter
            fun p => p.1 < p.2).card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.sum_sq_goodCrossings_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_goodCrossings_le (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) {lam : ℝ}
    (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam < 1) (hspec : R.graph.SpectralBound lam)
    (hn : 0 < R.graph.order) :
    ∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T, ((R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).card : ℝ) ^ 2
      ≤ (∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T, ((R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).card : ℝ))
        + 2 * ((q : ℝ) ^ T * ((R.graph.deg : ℝ) ^ (T - 2)
          * ((T : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) * (((R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)).card : ℝ)
                * ((R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)).card : ℝ) / (R.graph.order : ℝ))
            + (T : ℝ) * (1 / (1 - lam)) * ((R.graph.deg : ℝ)
                * ((R.unsatDarts (R.kDecode q T hq A)).card : ℝ)))))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.truthCount_le
statement:
theorem truthCount_le (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) (v : R.graph.V) (m : ℕ) :

name: Complexity.RegCSP.unsatFrac_killedPow_ge
statement:
theorem unsatFrac_killedPow_ge (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) {LB : ℝ}
    (hLB : LB ≤ (((R.killedPow q T hq).unsatDarts A).card : ℝ)) (hn : 0 < R.graph.order) :
    LB / ((R.graph.order * (R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T) : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ (((R.killedPow q T hq).unsatFrac A : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: Complexity.geom_tail_le
statement:
theorem geom_tail_le {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (T : ℕ) : ∀ (n k : ℕ), T - k = n → k ≤ T →
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico k T, (q - 1) ^ m * q ^ (T - 1 - m) ≤ (q - 1) ^ k * q ^ (T - k)

name: Complexity.sum_crossing_factor
statement:
theorem sum_crossing_factor (deg q T H : ℕ) (hH : 2 * H + 1 < T) (f g : ℕ → ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1),
        f i * g j * (deg ^ (T - (i + j + 1))
          * ((q - 1) ^ (i + j + 1) * q ^ (T - (i + j + 1) - 1))))
        * (deg ^ (T + 1) * q ^ T)
      = (q - 1) * ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1),
            f i * (deg ^ (T - i) * ((q - 1) ^ i * q ^ (T - i - 1))))
          * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1),
            g j * (deg ^ (T - j) * ((q - 1) ^ j * q ^ (T - j - 1)))))

name: Complexity.sum_goodCount_factor
statement:
theorem sum_goodCount_factor (deg q T H : ℕ) (hH : 2 * H + 1 < T) (f g : ℕ → ℕ)
    (C : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hC : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1),
      C i j = f i * g j * (deg ^ (T - (i + j + 1))
        * ((q - 1) ^ (i + j + 1) * q ^ (T - (i + j + 1) - 1)))) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), C i j)
        * (deg ^ (T + 1) * q ^ T)
      = (q - 1) * ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1),
            f i * (deg ^ (T - i) * ((q - 1) ^ i * q ^ (T - i - 1))))
          * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1),
            g j * (deg ^ (T - j) * ((q - 1) ^ j * q ^ (T - j - 1)))))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.card_unsatDarts_ge'
statement:
theorem card_unsatDarts_ge' (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) {Alb P : ℝ}
    (hA0 : 0 ≤ Alb)
    (hA : Alb ≤ ∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T, ((R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).card : ℝ))
    (hB : ∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T, ((R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).card : ℝ) ^ 2
      ≤ (∑ z : R.graph.V × R.KLabels q T, ((R.goodCrossings q T hq A z).card : ℝ)) + P)
    (hP : 0 < P) :
    Alb ^ 2 / (Alb + P) ≤ (((R.killedPow q T hq).unsatDarts A).card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.le_unsatVal_killedPow_min
statement:
theorem le_unsatVal_killedPow_min {H : ℕ}
    (hH : 2 * H + 1 < T) (hHT : H + 1 ≤ T)
    (hsq : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), i + j + 1 < T)
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam < 1) (hspec : R.graph.SpectralBound lam)
    (hn : 0 < R.graph.order) (hq1 : 1 ≤ q)
    (hloss : 2 * (Fintype.card α * pluralityLoss R.graph.deg q T H) ≤ R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T) :
    min (powSlope (powConst q α) T lam * ((R.unsatVal : ℚ) : ℝ)) (powFloor (powConst q α) T lam)
      ≤ (((R.killedPow q T hq).unsatVal : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegCSP.min_le_powBound
statement:
theorem min_le_powBound {c T lam u : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hlam : lam < 1)
    (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1) :
    min (powSlope c T lam * u) (powFloor c T lam)
      ≤ c ^ 2 * u / (c + 2 * T ^ 2 * u + 2 * T / (1 - lam))

name: Complexity.RegCSP.unsatFrac_killedPow_clean
statement:
theorem unsatFrac_killedPow_clean (A : (R.killedPow q T hq).Assignment) {H : ℕ}
    (hH : 2 * H + 1 < T) (hHT : H + 1 ≤ T)
    (hsq : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (H + 1), i + j + 1 < T)
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam < 1) (hspec : R.graph.SpectralBound lam)
    (hn : 0 < R.graph.order) (hq1 : 1 ≤ q)
    (hloss : 2 * (Fintype.card α * pluralityLoss R.graph.deg q T H) ≤ R.graph.deg ^ T * q ^ T) :
    powConst q α ^ 2 * (((R.unsatFrac (R.kDecode q T hq A) : ℚ) : ℝ))
        / (powConst q α + 2 * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 * (((R.unsatFrac (R.kDecode q T hq A) : ℚ) : ℝ))
          + 2 * (T : ℝ) / (1 - lam))
      ≤ (((R.killedPow q T hq).unsatFrac A : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: Complexity.four_mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem four_mul_pow_le {K q : ℕ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    4 * K * (q - 1) ^ (4 * K * (q - 1)) ≤ q ^ (4 * K * (q - 1))

name: Complexity.powering_params_spec
statement:
theorem powering_params_spec {K q : ℕ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (d : ℕ) :
    2 * powH K q + 1 < powT K q ∧ powH K q + 1 ≤ powT K q
      ∧ (∀ i ∈ Finset.range (powH K q + 1), ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (powH K q + 1),
          i + j + 1 < powT K q)
      ∧ 2 * (K * RegCSP.pluralityLoss d q (powT K q) (powH K q))
          ≤ d ^ powT K q * q ^ powT K q

name: Complexity.slopeUnit_mul_le_powSlope
statement:
theorem slopeUnit_mul_le_powSlope {K : ℕ} {q : ℕ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hq : 2 ≤ q) {lam : ℝ}
    (hlam1 : lam < 1) :
    slopeUnit (K : ℝ) lam * ((q : ℝ) - 1)
      ≤ RegCSP.powSlope (((q : ℝ) - 1) / (4 * (K : ℝ) ^ 2)) (powT K q : ℝ) lam

statement:

name: Complexity.Dinur.tail_step
statement:
theorem tail_step (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (G : ConstraintGraph DinurAlpha)
    (k : Fin (Fintype.card (((G.preprocess E).killedPow q (powT K q) hq).compose
      (enc E G (powT K q))).Edge)) :
    ((((G.preprocess E).killedPow q (powT K q) hq).compose
        (enc E G (powT K q))).toGraph.tail k).val
      = posFactor E q * G.numEdges
        + (k.val / (2 ^ (((G.preprocess E).killedPow q (powT K q) hq).compose
                (enc E G (powT K q))).R * 22)
              * 2 ^ (((G.preprocess E).killedPow q (powT K q) hq).compose
                (enc E G (powT K q))).R
            + k.val % (2 ^ (((G.preprocess E).killedPow q (powT K q) hq).compose
                (enc E G (powT K q))).R * 22) / 22)

name: Complexity.MultiTest.enc_edgeOf_split

      ∧ NumEnc.enc (M.edgeOf k).2.1 = k.val % (2 ^ M.R * Fintype.card Q) / Fintype.card Q

name: Complexity.MultiTest.split_mixed

    (a * (C * Q) + (b * Q + c)) / (C * Q) = a
      ∧ (a * (C * Q) + (b * Q + c)) % (C * Q) / Q = b
      ∧ (a * (C * Q) + (b * Q + c)) % Q = c

name: Complexity.RegCSP.edge_data
statement:
theorem edge_data (enc : β → Cube B) (e : ℕ)
    (he : e < (R.compose enc).toGraph.numEdges) :
    ∃ (p : R.Dart) (z : Cube (Tester.ROf B)) (i : ReadIdx),
      p = ((R.compose enc).edgeOf ⟨e, he⟩).1
        ∧ z = ((R.compose enc).edgeOf ⟨e, he⟩).2.1
        ∧ i = ((R.compose enc).edgeOf ⟨e, he⟩).2.2
        ∧ e = ((NumEnc.enc p.1 * NumEnc.card R.graph.D + NumEnc.enc p.2)
              * 2 ^ Tester.ROf B + NumEnc.enc z) * 22 + NumEnc.enc i

name: Complexity.RegCSP.edge_split

          + NumEnc.enc ((R.compose enc).edgeOf k).1.2)
        * 2 ^ Tester.ROf B
        + NumEnc.enc ((R.compose enc).edgeOf k).2.1) * 22
      + NumEnc.enc ((R.compose enc).edgeOf k).2.2
