statement:
theorem order_relabelV {V' : Type} [DecidableEq V'] [Fintype V'] (e : G.V ≃ V') :
    (G.relabelV e).order = G.order

name: Complexity.RegGraph.order_toFinForm
statement: @[simp] theorem order_toFinForm : G.toFinForm.order = G.order

name: Complexity.RegGraph.order_toFinFormOf
statement:
@[simp] theorem order_toFinFormOf (N d : ℕ) (hN : Fintype.card G.V = N)
    (hd : Fintype.card G.D = d) : (G.toFinFormOf N d hN hd).order = N

name: Complexity.RegGraph.spectralBound_padLoops
statement:
theorem spectralBound_padLoops (k : ℕ) {lam : ℝ} (h : G.SpectralBound lam) :
    (G.padLoops k).SpectralBound
      (Real.sqrt (((G.deg : ℝ) * lam ^ 2 + k) / ((G.deg : ℝ) + k)))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.spectralBound_relabel
statement:
theorem spectralBound_relabel {D' : Type} [DecidableEq D'] [Fintype D'] (e : G.D ≃ D')
    {lam : ℝ} (h : G.SpectralBound lam) : (G.relabel e).SpectralBound lam

name: Complexity.RegGraph.spectralBound_relabelV
statement:
theorem spectralBound_relabelV {V' : Type} [DecidableEq V'] [Fintype V'] (e : G.V ≃ V')
    {lam : ℝ} (h : G.SpectralBound lam) : (G.relabelV e).SpectralBound lam

name: Complexity.RegGraph.spectralBound_toFinForm
statement:
theorem spectralBound_toFinForm {lam : ℝ} (h : G.SpectralBound lam) :
    G.toFinForm.SpectralBound lam

name: Complexity.RegGraph.spectralBound_toFinFormOf
statement:
theorem spectralBound_toFinFormOf (N d : ℕ) (hN : Fintype.card G.V = N)
    (hd : Fintype.card G.D = d) {lam : ℝ} (h : G.SpectralBound lam) :
    (G.toFinFormOf N d hN hd).SpectralBound lam

name: Complexity.RegGraph.step_padLoops
statement:
theorem step_padLoops (k : ℕ) (f : G.V → ℝ) (v : G.V) :
    (G.padLoops k).step f v
      = ((G.deg : ℝ) * G.step f v + (k : ℝ) * f v) / ((G.deg : ℝ) + k)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.step_relabel
statement:
theorem step_relabel {D' : Type} [DecidableEq D'] [Fintype D'] (e : G.D ≃ D') (f : G.V → ℝ)
    (v : G.V) : (G.relabel e).step f v = G.step f v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.step_relabelV
statement:
theorem step_relabelV {V' : Type} [DecidableEq V'] [Fintype V'] (e : G.V ≃ V')
    (f : V' → ℝ) (v : V') :
    (G.relabelV e).step f v = G.step (fun w => f (e w)) (e.symm v)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.toFinFormOf_D
statement:
theorem toFinFormOf_D (N d : ℕ) (hN : Fintype.card G.V = N) (hd : Fintype.card G.D = d) :
    (G.toFinFormOf N d hN hd).D = Fin d

name: Complexity.RegGraph.toFinFormOf_V
statement:
theorem toFinFormOf_V (N d : ℕ) (hN : Fintype.card G.V = N) (hd : Fintype.card G.D = d) :
    (G.toFinFormOf N d hN hd).V = Fin N

name: Complexity.RegGraph.toFinForm_D
statement: theorem toFinForm_D : G.toFinForm.D = Fin (Fintype.card G.D)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.toFinForm_V
statement: theorem toFinForm_V : G.toFinForm.V = Fin (Fintype.card G.V)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.coarea
statement:
theorem coarea {h : ℝ} (hexp : G.EdgeExpansion h) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (ψ : G.V → ℝ), (G.support ψ).card = n → (∀ v, 0 ≤ ψ v)
      → 2 * (G.support ψ).card ≤ G.order
      → 2 * h * (G.deg : ℝ) * ∑ v : G.V, ψ v
        ≤ ∑ p : G.V × G.D, |ψ p.1 - ψ (G.nbr p.1 p.2)|

name: Complexity.RegGraph.dirichlet_eq
statement:
theorem dirichlet_eq (f : G.V → ℝ) :
    G.dirichlet f = 2 * (G.deg : ℝ) * ((∑ v : G.V, (f v) ^ 2) - ∑ v : G.V, f v * G.step f v)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.dirichlet_ge_of_edgeExpansion
statement:
theorem dirichlet_ge_of_edgeExpansion {h : ℝ} (hexp : G.EdgeExpansion h) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (f : G.V → ℝ) (hf : ∑ v : G.V, f v = 0) :
    h ^ 2 * (G.deg : ℝ) * ∑ v : G.V, (f v) ^ 2 ≤ G.dirichlet f

name: Complexity.RegGraph.dirichlet_ge_of_support
statement:
theorem dirichlet_ge_of_support {h : ℝ} (hexp : G.EdgeExpansion h) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (φ : G.V → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ v, 0 ≤ φ v) (hhalf : 2 * (G.support φ).card ≤ G.order) :
    h ^ 2 * (G.deg : ℝ) * ∑ v : G.V, (φ v) ^ 2 ≤ G.dirichlet φ

name: Complexity.RegGraph.dirichlet_nonneg
statement: theorem dirichlet_nonneg (f : G.V → ℝ) : 0 ≤ G.dirichlet f

name: Complexity.RegGraph.dirichlet_sub_const
statement:
theorem dirichlet_sub_const (f : G.V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    G.dirichlet (fun v => f v - c) = G.dirichlet f

name: Complexity.RegGraph.eq_zero_of_notMem_support
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_notMem_support (ψ : G.V → ℝ) {v : G.V} (hv : v ∉ G.support ψ) : ψ v = 0

name: Complexity.RegGraph.exists_median
statement:
theorem exists_median (f : G.V → ℝ) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 2 * (Finset.univ.filter fun v => c < f v).card ≤ G.order
      ∧ 2 * (Finset.univ.filter fun v => f v < c).card ≤ G.order

name: Complexity.RegGraph.lazyQ_nonneg
statement: theorem lazyQ_nonneg (f : G.V → ℝ) : 0 ≤ G.lazyQ f f

name: Complexity.RegGraph.lazyQ_self
statement:
theorem lazyQ_self (f : G.V → ℝ) :
    G.lazyQ f f = 4 * (G.deg : ℝ) * ∑ v : G.V, (f v) ^ 2 - G.dirichlet f

name: Complexity.RegGraph.lazyQ_sq_le
statement: theorem lazyQ_sq_le (f g : G.V → ℝ) : (G.lazyQ f g) ^ 2 ≤ G.lazyQ f f * G.lazyQ g g

name: Complexity.RegGraph.mem_support_iff
statement: theorem mem_support_iff (ψ : G.V → ℝ) (v : G.V) : v ∈ G.support ψ ↔ ψ v ≠ 0

name: Complexity.RegGraph.nbr_rot
statement: theorem nbr_rot (p : G.V × G.D) : G.nbr (G.rot p).1 (G.rot p).2 = p.1

name: Complexity.RegGraph.spectralBound_padLoops_of_edgeExpansion
statement:
theorem spectralBound_padLoops_of_edgeExpansion {h : ℝ} (hexp : G.EdgeExpansion h) (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    (G.padLoops G.deg).SpectralBound (1 - h ^ 2 / 4)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.step_lazy
statement:
theorem step_lazy (f : G.V → ℝ) (v : G.V) :
    (G.padLoops G.deg).step f v = (G.step f v + f v) / 2

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_darts_boundary
statement:
theorem sum_darts_boundary (S : Finset G.V) :
    ∑ p : G.V × G.D, (if p.1 ∈ S ∧ G.nbr p.1 p.2 ∉ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      + ∑ p : G.V × G.D, (if p.1 ∉ S ∧ G.nbr p.1 p.2 ∈ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      = 2 * ((G.dartsBetween S Sᶜ).card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_darts_fst
statement:
theorem sum_darts_fst (g : G.V → ℝ) :
    ∑ p : G.V × G.D, g p.1 = (G.deg : ℝ) * ∑ v : G.V, g v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_darts_snd
statement:
theorem sum_darts_snd (g : G.V → ℝ) :
    ∑ p : G.V × G.D, g (G.nbr p.1 p.2) = (G.deg : ℝ) * ∑ v : G.V, g v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_darts_swap
statement:
theorem sum_darts_swap (g : G.V → G.V → ℝ) :
    ∑ p : G.V × G.D, g p.1 (G.nbr p.1 p.2) = ∑ p : G.V × G.D, g (G.nbr p.1 p.2) p.1

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_lazy_mul
statement:
theorem sum_lazy_mul (f g : G.V → ℝ) :
    ∑ v : G.V, (G.padLoops G.deg).step f v * g v = G.lazyQ f g / (4 * (G.deg : ℝ))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_lazy_step
statement:
theorem sum_lazy_step (f : G.V → ℝ) :
    ∑ v : G.V, (G.padLoops G.deg).step f v = ∑ v : G.V, f v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_mul_step
statement:
theorem sum_mul_step (f g : G.V → ℝ) :
    ∑ v : G.V, f v * G.step g v = (∑ p : G.V × G.D, f p.1 * g (G.nbr p.1 p.2)) / (G.deg : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.support_max_subset
statement:
theorem support_max_subset (g : G.V → ℝ) :
    G.support (fun v => max (g v) 0) ⊆ Finset.univ.filter fun v => 0 < g v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.support_sq
statement: theorem support_sq (φ : G.V → ℝ) : G.support (fun v => (φ v) ^ 2) = G.support φ

name: Complexity.RegGraph.D_cliqueLoops
statement: @[simp] theorem D_cliqueLoops (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : (cliqueLoops n hn).D = Fin n

name: Complexity.RegGraph.V_cliqueLoops
statement: @[simp] theorem V_cliqueLoops (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : (cliqueLoops n hn).V = Fin n

name: Complexity.RegGraph.deg_cliqueLoops
statement: @[simp] theorem deg_cliqueLoops (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : (cliqueLoops n hn).deg = n

name: Complexity.RegGraph.nbr_cliqueLoops
statement:
@[simp] theorem nbr_cliqueLoops {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (v : (cliqueLoops n hn).V)
    (i : (cliqueLoops n hn).D) : (cliqueLoops n hn).nbr v i = i

name: Complexity.RegGraph.order_cliqueLoops
statement: @[simp] theorem order_cliqueLoops (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : (cliqueLoops n hn).order = n

name: Complexity.RegGraph.spectralBound_cliqueLoops
statement:
theorem spectralBound_cliqueLoops {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    (cliqueLoops n hn).SpectralBound 0

name: Complexity.RegGraph.step_cliqueLoops
statement:
theorem step_cliqueLoops {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (f : (cliqueLoops n hn).V → ℝ)
    (v : (cliqueLoops n hn).V) :
    (cliqueLoops n hn).step f v
      = (∑ w : (cliqueLoops n hn).V, f w) / ((cliqueLoops n hn).deg : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.card_disagreeDarts_ge
statement:
theorem card_disagreeDarts_ge {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (h : G.SpectralBound lam)
    (hn : 0 < G.order) (f : G.V → α) (c : α) :
    (1 - lam) * (G.deg : ℝ)
        * (((Finset.univ.filter fun v => f v ≠ c).card : ℝ)
          * ((Finset.univ.filter fun v => f v ≠ c)ᶜ.card : ℝ) / (G.order : ℝ))
      ≤ ((G.disagreeDarts f).card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.card_disagreeDarts_ge_of_plurality
statement:
theorem card_disagreeDarts_ge_of_plurality [Fintype α] {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) (h : G.SpectralBound lam) (hn : 0 < G.order) (f : G.V → α) (c : α)
    (hc : G.order ≤ Fintype.card α * (Finset.univ.filter fun v => f v = c).card) :
    (1 - lam) * (G.deg : ℝ)
        * (((Finset.univ.filter fun v => f v ≠ c).card : ℝ) / (Fintype.card α : ℝ))
      ≤ ((G.disagreeDarts f).card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.exists_plurality_value
statement:
theorem exists_plurality_value {V α : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [DecidableEq α] (f : V → α) :
    ∃ c : α, Fintype.card V
      ≤ Fintype.card α * (Finset.univ.filter fun v => f v = c).card

name: Complexity.choose_mul_pow_self_le
statement: theorem choose_mul_pow_self_le (n s : ℕ) : n.choose s * s ^ s ≤ 3 ^ s * n ^ s

name: Complexity.choose_mul_two_pow_le
statement:
theorem choose_mul_two_pow_le (s t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ s) :
    s.choose t * 2 ^ (s - t) ≤ 3 ^ s

name: Complexity.descFactorial_mul_factorial_sub
statement:
theorem descFactorial_mul_factorial_sub {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    n.descFactorial k * Nat.factorial (n - k) = Nat.factorial n

name: Complexity.key_estimate
statement:
theorem key_estimate {n s k B : ℕ} (hs : 1 ≤ s) (hsn : 2 * s ≤ n) (h9 : 9 * s ≤ 10 * k)
    (hB : B * 2 ^ k * n ^ k ≤ 3 ^ s * s ^ k * Nat.factorial n) :
    2 ^ s * (n.choose s * B ^ 30) ≤ Nat.factorial n ^ 30

name: Complexity.pow_self_le_three_pow_mul_factorial
statement:
theorem pow_self_le_three_pow_mul_factorial (s : ℕ) :
    s ^ s ≤ 3 ^ s * Nat.factorial s

name: Complexity.two_pow_three_pow_le
statement:
theorem two_pow_three_pow_le {s k : ℕ} (h9 : 9 * s ≤ 10 * k) :
    2 ^ (2 * s) * 3 ^ (31 * s) ≤ 2 ^ (60 * k)

name: Complexity.card_fiber_le
statement:
theorem card_fiber_le (S K : Finset (Fin n)) (f : {x // x ∈ K} → Fin n)
    (hf : f ∈ restrs S K) :
    ((permsInto S K).filter fun σ => (fun v : {x // x ∈ K} => σ v) = f).card
      ≤ Nat.factorial (n - K.card)

name: Complexity.card_perm_escape_le
statement:
theorem card_perm_escape_le (S : Finset (Fin n)) (t : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) => escape σ S ≤ t).card
      ≤ S.card.choose (S.card - t)
        * (S.card.descFactorial (S.card - t) * Nat.factorial (n - (S.card - t)))

name: Complexity.card_perm_mapsTo_le
statement:
theorem card_perm_mapsTo_le (S K : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (permsInto S K).card ≤ S.card.descFactorial K.card * Nat.factorial (n - K.card)

name: Complexity.card_restrImage
statement:
theorem card_restrImage {S K : Finset (Fin n)} {f : {x // x ∈ K} → Fin n}
    (hf : f ∈ restrs S K) : (restrImage f).card = K.card

name: Complexity.card_restrs_le
statement:
theorem card_restrs_le (S K : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (restrs S K).card ≤ S.card.descFactorial K.card

name: Complexity.mem_restrs
statement:
theorem mem_restrs {S K : Finset (Fin n)} {f : {x // x ∈ K} → Fin n} (hf : f ∈ restrs S K) :
    Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ v, f v ∈ S

name: Complexity.card_escLE_le
statement: theorem card_escLE_le (S : Finset (Fin n)) : (escLE S (tOf S)).card ≤ escB n S.card

name: Complexity.mem_escLE_iff
statement:
theorem mem_escLE_iff {S : Finset (Fin n)} {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} (hS : 1 ≤ S.card) :
    σ ∈ escLE S (tOf S) ↔ ¬ S.card ≤ 10 * escape σ S

name: Complexity.ten_mul_tOf_le
statement: theorem ten_mul_tOf_le (S : Finset (Fin n)) : 10 * tOf S ≤ S.card

name: Complexity.RegGraph.deg_permsGraph
statement:
theorem deg_permsGraph (hD : 0 < D) (σ : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (permsGraph hD σ).deg = 2 * D

name: Complexity.RegGraph.edgeExpansion_permsGraph
statement:
theorem edgeExpansion_permsGraph (hD : 0 < D) (σ : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (c : ℕ)
    (hc : 0 < c)
    (hesc : ∀ S : Finset (Fin n), 2 * S.card ≤ n → ∃ i : Fin D, S.card ≤ c * escape (σ i) S) :
    (permsGraph hD σ).EdgeExpansion (1 / (2 * (c : ℝ) * D))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.nbr_permsGraph_false
statement:
theorem nbr_permsGraph_false (hD : 0 < D) (σ : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (v : Fin n) (i : Fin D) : (permsGraph hD σ).nbr v (i, false) = σ i v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.order_permsGraph
statement:
@[simp] theorem order_permsGraph (hD : 0 < D) (σ : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (permsGraph hD σ).order = n

name: Complexity.RegGraph.permsRot_involutive
statement:
theorem permsRot_involutive (σ : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    Function.Involutive (permsRot σ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_escape_le_dartsBetween
statement:
theorem sum_escape_le_dartsBetween (hD : 0 < D) (σ : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ∑ i : Fin D, escape (σ i) S
      ≤ ((permsGraph hD σ).dartsBetween S Sᶜ).card

name: Complexity.randLam_lt_one
statement: theorem randLam_lt_one : randLam < 1

name: Complexity.randLam_nonneg
statement: theorem randLam_nonneg : 0 ≤ randLam

name: Complexity.RegGraph.card_liftN_none_le_one
statement:
theorem card_liftN_none_le_one {N n m : ℕ} (hm : (m - 1) * n ≤ N) (v : Fin n) :
    ((Finset.range m).filter fun i => liftN N n v i = none).card ≤ 1

name: Complexity.RegGraph.liftN_isSome
statement:
theorem liftN_isSome {N n m : ℕ} (hm : (m - 1) * n ≤ N) (v : Fin n) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i + 1 < m) : (liftN N n v i).isSome

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_sq_step_lift_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_step_lift_le (hn : 0 < n) (hd : 0 < d) (rot : Fin N × Fin d → Fin N × Fin d)
    (hrot : Function.Involutive rot) {lam : ℝ} (hspec : (base hd rot hrot).SpectralBound lam)
    (hN0 : 0 < N) (f : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∑ u : Fin N, ((base hd rot hrot).step (fun w => f (proj n hn w)) u) ^ 2
      ≤ lam ^ 2 * ∑ u : Fin N, (f (proj n hn u)) ^ 2
        + (1 - lam ^ 2) * ((∑ u : Fin N, f (proj n hn u)) ^ 2 / (N : ℝ))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.deg_mergedN
statement:
@[simp] theorem deg_mergedN (hn : 0 < n) (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (hN : N ≤ m * n)
    (rot : Fin N × Fin d → Fin N × Fin d) (hrot : Function.Involutive rot) :
    (mergedN hn hd hm hN rot hrot).deg = m * d

name: Complexity.RegGraph.le_mergeWidth_mul
statement: theorem le_mergeWidth_mul (N : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : N ≤ mergeWidth N n * n

name: Complexity.RegGraph.liftN_projN_slotN
statement:
theorem liftN_projN_slotN (hn : 0 < n) (hN : N ≤ m * n) (u : Fin N) :
    liftN N n (projN n hn u) (slotN n m hN u).val = some u

name: Complexity.RegGraph.mergeRotN_involutive
statement:
theorem mergeRotN_involutive (hn : 0 < n) (hN : N ≤ m * n)
    (rot : Fin N × Fin d → Fin N × Fin d) (hrot : Function.Involutive rot) :
    Function.Involutive (mergeRotN hn hN rot)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.mergeWidth_le
statement:
theorem mergeWidth_le {N n C : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (h : N ≤ C * n) :
    mergeWidth N n ≤ C + 1

name: Complexity.RegGraph.mergeWidth_sub_one_mul_le
statement: theorem mergeWidth_sub_one_mul_le (N n : ℕ) : (mergeWidth N n - 1) * n ≤ N

name: Complexity.RegGraph.order_mergedN
statement:
@[simp] theorem order_mergedN (hn : 0 < n) (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (hN : N ≤ m * n)
    (rot : Fin N × Fin d → Fin N × Fin d) (hrot : Function.Involutive rot) :
    (mergedN hn hd hm hN rot hrot).order = n

name: Complexity.RegGraph.projN_eq_proj
statement: theorem projN_eq_proj (hn : 0 < n) : projN (N := N) n hn = proj n hn

name: Complexity.RegGraph.projN_liftN
statement:
theorem projN_liftN (hn : 0 < n) (v : Fin n) (i : ℕ) (u : Fin N)
    (h : liftN N n v i = some u) : projN n hn u = v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.slotN_liftN
statement:
theorem slotN_liftN (hn : 0 < n) (hN : N ≤ m * n) (v : Fin n) (i : ℕ) (u : Fin N)
    (h : liftN N n v i = some u) : (slotN n m hN u).val = i

name: Complexity.RegGraph.spectralBound_mergedN
statement:
theorem spectralBound_mergedN (hn : 0 < n) (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (hN : N ≤ m * n)
    (hm1 : (m - 1) * n ≤ N) (h2 : 2 * n ≤ N)
    (rot : Fin N × Fin d → Fin N × Fin d) (hrot : Function.Involutive rot)
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam : lam ^ 2 ≤ 1) (hspec : (base hd rot hrot).SpectralBound lam) :
    (mergedN hn hd hm hN rot hrot).SpectralBound
      (Real.sqrt (lam ^ 2 + (1 - lam ^ 2) / (2 * m) + 1 / m))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sq_step_mergedN_le
statement:
theorem sq_step_mergedN_le (hn : 0 < n) (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (hN : N ≤ m * n)
    (rot : Fin N × Fin d → Fin N × Fin d) (hrot : Function.Involutive rot)
    (f : Fin n → ℝ) (v : Fin n) :
    ((mergedN hn hd hm hN rot hrot).step f v) ^ 2
      ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (termN hn hd rot hrot f v i) ^ 2) / (m : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sq_sum_liftN_le
statement:
theorem sq_sum_liftN_le (hn : 0 < n) (hN : N ≤ m * n) (hm1 : (m - 1) * n ≤ N) (hm : 0 < m)
    (f : Fin n → ℝ) (hf : ∑ v : Fin n, f v = 0) :
    (∑ u : Fin N, f (projN n hn u)) ^ 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) * ∑ v : Fin n, (f v) ^ 2

name: Complexity.RegGraph.step_mergedN
statement:
theorem step_mergedN (hn : 0 < n) (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (hN : N ≤ m * n)
    (rot : Fin N × Fin d → Fin N × Fin d) (hrot : Function.Involutive rot)
    (f : Fin n → ℝ) (v : Fin n) :
    (mergedN hn hd hm hN rot hrot).step f v
      = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, termN hn hd rot hrot f v i) / (m : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_liftN_eq
statement:
theorem sum_liftN_eq (hn : 0 < n) (hN : N ≤ m * n) (hm1 : (m - 1) * n ≤ N) (hm : 0 < m)
    (f : Fin n → ℝ) (hf : ∑ v : Fin n, f v = 0) :
    ∑ u : Fin N, f (projN n hn u)
      = ∑ v : Fin n, (match liftN N n v (m - 1) with | some _ => f v | none => 0)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_over_liftN
statement:
theorem sum_over_liftN (hn : 0 < n) (hN : N ≤ m * n) (g : Fin N → ℝ) :
    ∑ p : Fin n × Fin m,
        (match liftN N n p.1 p.2.val with | some u => g u | none => 0)
      = ∑ u : Fin N, g u

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_sq_liftN_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_liftN_le (hn : 0 < n) (hN : N ≤ m * n) (f : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∑ u : Fin N, (f (projN n hn u)) ^ 2 ≤ (m : ℝ) * ∑ v : Fin n, (f v) ^ 2

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_sq_termN_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_termN_le (hn : 0 < n) (hd : 0 < d) (hN : N ≤ m * n)
    (hm1 : (m - 1) * n ≤ N) (rot : Fin N × Fin d → Fin N × Fin d)
    (hrot : Function.Involutive rot) (f : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∑ v : Fin n, ∑ i : Fin m, (termN hn hd rot hrot f v i.val) ^ 2
      ≤ (∑ u : Fin N, ((base hd rot hrot).step (fun w => f (projN n hn w)) u) ^ 2)
        + ∑ v : Fin n, (f v) ^ 2

name: Complexity.RegGraph.three_le_mergeWidth
statement:
theorem three_le_mergeWidth {N n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (h2 : 2 * n ≤ N) :
    3 ≤ mergeWidth N n

name: Complexity.RegGraph.abs_ip_cloudPar_crossStep_le
statement:
theorem abs_ip_cloudPar_crossStep_le {lam : ℝ} (hG : G.SpectralBound lam) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    {f : G.V × G.D → ℝ} (hf : ∑ x : G.V × G.D, f x = 0) :
    |ip G (cloudPar G f) (crossStep G (cloudPar G f))|
      ≤ lam * ip G (cloudPar G f) (cloudPar G f)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.abs_ip_step_zigzag_le
statement:
theorem abs_ip_step_zigzag_le {lamG lamH : ℝ} (hG : G.SpectralBound lamG)
    (hH : H.SpectralBound lamH) (hlamG : 0 ≤ lamG) (hlamH : 0 ≤ lamH)
    (f : (zigzag G H e).V → ℝ) (hf : ∑ x : G.V × G.D, f x = 0) :
    |ip G f ((zigzag G H e).step f)| ≤ (lamG + lamH + lamH ^ 2) * ip G f f

name: Complexity.RegGraph.abs_ip_two_mul_le
statement:
theorem abs_ip_two_mul_le (u w : G.V × G.D → ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    2 * |ip G u w| ≤ t * ip G u u + ip G w w / t

name: Complexity.RegGraph.abs_sum_mul_step_le
statement:
theorem abs_sum_mul_step_le (K : RegGraph) {lam : ℝ} (hK : K.SpectralBound lam)
    (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (g : K.V → ℝ) (hg : ∑ v : K.V, g v = 0) :
    |∑ v : K.V, g v * K.step g v| ≤ lam * ∑ v : K.V, (g v) ^ 2

name: Complexity.RegGraph.cloudMean_crossStep_cloudPar
statement:
theorem cloudMean_crossStep_cloudPar (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) (v : G.V) :
    cloudMean G (crossStep G (cloudPar G f)) v = G.step (cloudMean G f) v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.cloudPar_add_cloudPerp
statement:
theorem cloudPar_add_cloudPerp (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) (x : G.V × G.D) :
    cloudPar G f x + cloudPerp G f x = f x

name: Complexity.RegGraph.cloudStep_add
statement:
theorem cloudStep_add (f g : G.V × G.D → ℝ) (x : G.V × G.D) :
    cloudStep G H e (fun y => f y + g y) x = cloudStep G H e f x + cloudStep G H e g x

name: Complexity.RegGraph.cloudStep_apply
statement:
theorem cloudStep_apply (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) (v : G.V) (i : G.D) :
    cloudStep G H e f (v, i) = H.step (cloudFun G H e f v) (e.symm i)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.cloudStep_cloudPar
statement:
theorem cloudStep_cloudPar (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) (x : G.V × G.D) :
    cloudStep G H e (cloudPar G f) x = cloudPar G f x

name: Complexity.RegGraph.cloudStep_decomp
statement:
theorem cloudStep_decomp (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) (x : G.V × G.D) :
    cloudStep G H e f x = cloudPar G f x + cloudStep G H e (cloudPerp G f) x

name: Complexity.RegGraph.crossStep_add
statement:
theorem crossStep_add (f g : G.V × G.D → ℝ) (x : G.V × G.D) :
    crossStep G (fun y => f y + g y) x = crossStep G f x + crossStep G g x

name: Complexity.RegGraph.deg_zigzag
statement: @[simp] theorem deg_zigzag : (zigzag G H e).deg = H.deg * H.deg

name: Complexity.RegGraph.eq_zero_of_ip_self_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_ip_self_eq_zero {g : G.V × G.D → ℝ} (h : ip G g g = 0)
    (x : G.V × G.D) : g x = 0

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_add_left
statement:
theorem ip_add_left (f g h : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G (fun x => f x + g x) h = ip G f h + ip G g h

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_add_right
statement:
theorem ip_add_right (f g h : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G f (fun x => g x + h x) = ip G f g + ip G f h

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_cloudPar
statement:
theorem ip_cloudPar (f g : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G (cloudPar G f) (cloudPar G g)
      = (G.deg : ℝ) * ∑ v : G.V, cloudMean G f v * cloudMean G g v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_cloudPar_cloudPerp
statement:
theorem ip_cloudPar_cloudPerp (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G (cloudPar G f) (cloudPerp G f) = 0

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_cloudPar_crossStep
statement:
theorem ip_cloudPar_crossStep (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G (cloudPar G f) (crossStep G (cloudPar G f))
      = (G.deg : ℝ) * ∑ v : G.V, cloudMean G f v * G.step (cloudMean G f) v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_cloudPar_crossStep_le
statement:
theorem ip_cloudPar_crossStep_le {lam : ℝ} (hG : G.SpectralBound lam) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    {f : G.V × G.D → ℝ} (hf : ∑ x : G.V × G.D, f x = 0) :
    ip G (cloudPar G f) (crossStep G (cloudPar G f))
      ≤ lam * ip G (cloudPar G f) (cloudPar G f)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_cloudPar_self
statement:
theorem ip_cloudPar_self (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G (cloudPar G f) (cloudPar G f)
      = (G.deg : ℝ) * ∑ v : G.V, (cloudMean G f v) ^ 2

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_cloudStep
statement:
theorem ip_cloudStep (f g : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G (cloudStep G H e f) g = ip G f (cloudStep G H e g)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_cloudStep_cloudPerp_le
statement:
theorem ip_cloudStep_cloudPerp_le {lam : ℝ} (hH : H.SpectralBound lam)
    (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G (cloudStep G H e (cloudPerp G f)) (cloudStep G H e (cloudPerp G f))
      ≤ lam ^ 2 * ip G (cloudPerp G f) (cloudPerp G f)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_cloudStep_le
statement:
theorem ip_cloudStep_le (g : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G (cloudStep G H e g) (cloudStep G H e g) ≤ ip G g g

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_comm
statement: theorem ip_comm (f g : G.V × G.D → ℝ) : ip G f g = ip G g f

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_crossStep
statement:
theorem ip_crossStep (f g : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G (crossStep G f) g = ip G f (crossStep G g)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_crossStep_expand
statement:
theorem ip_crossStep_expand (p q : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G (fun x => p x + q x) (crossStep G (fun x => p x + q x))
      = ip G p (crossStep G p) + ip G p (crossStep G q)
        + ip G q (crossStep G p) + ip G q (crossStep G q)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_crossStep_self
statement:
theorem ip_crossStep_self (g : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G (crossStep G g) (crossStep G g) = ip G g g

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_eq_sum_clouds
statement:
theorem ip_eq_sum_clouds (f g : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G f g = ∑ v : G.V, ∑ i : G.D, f (v, i) * g (v, i)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_neg_left
statement:
theorem ip_neg_left (u w : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G (fun x => -u x) w = -ip G u w

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_neg_self
statement:
theorem ip_neg_self (u : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G (fun x => -u x) (fun x => -u x) = ip G u u

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_nonneg
statement: theorem ip_nonneg (g : G.V × G.D → ℝ) : 0 ≤ ip G g g

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_polarise
statement:
theorem ip_polarise (f g : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    4 * ip G ((zigzag G H e).step f) g
      = ip G ((zigzag G H e).step (fun x => f x + g x)) (fun x => f x + g x)
        - ip G ((zigzag G H e).step (fun x => f x - g x)) (fun x => f x - g x)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_self_split
statement:
theorem ip_self_split (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G f f = ip G (cloudPar G f) (cloudPar G f) + ip G (cloudPerp G f) (cloudPerp G f)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_sq_le
statement: theorem ip_sq_le (f g : G.V × G.D → ℝ) : (ip G f g) ^ 2 ≤ ip G f f * ip G g g

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_step_zigzag_comm
statement:
theorem ip_step_zigzag_comm (f g : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G ((zigzag G H e).step f) g = ip G f ((zigzag G H e).step g)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_step_zigzag_expand
statement:
theorem ip_step_zigzag_expand (f : (zigzag G H e).V → ℝ) :
    ip G f ((zigzag G H e).step f)
      = ip G (cloudPar G f) (crossStep G (cloudPar G f))
        + ip G (cloudPar G f) (crossStep G (cloudStep G H e (cloudPerp G f)))
        + ip G (cloudStep G H e (cloudPerp G f)) (crossStep G (cloudPar G f))
        + ip G (cloudStep G H e (cloudPerp G f))
            (crossStep G (cloudStep G H e (cloudPerp G f)))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_step_zigzag_le
statement:
theorem ip_step_zigzag_le {lamG lamH : ℝ} (hG : G.SpectralBound lamG)
    (hH : H.SpectralBound lamH) (hlamG : 0 ≤ lamG) (hlamH : 0 ≤ lamH)
    (f : (zigzag G H e).V → ℝ) (hf : ∑ x : G.V × G.D, f x = 0) :
    ip G f ((zigzag G H e).step f) ≤ (lamG + lamH + lamH ^ 2) * ip G f f

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_sub_left
statement:
theorem ip_sub_left (f g h : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G (fun x => f x - g x) h = ip G f h - ip G g h

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_sub_right
statement:
theorem ip_sub_right (f g h : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ip G f (fun x => g x - h x) = ip G f g - ip G f h

name: Complexity.RegGraph.ip_two_mul_le
statement:
theorem ip_two_mul_le (u w : G.V × G.D → ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    2 * ip G u w ≤ t * ip G u u + ip G w w / t

name: Complexity.RegGraph.order_zigzag
statement: @[simp] theorem order_zigzag : (zigzag G H e).order = G.order * G.deg

name: Complexity.RegGraph.spectralBound_zigzag
statement:
theorem spectralBound_zigzag {lamG lamH : ℝ} (hG : G.SpectralBound lamG)
    (hH : H.SpectralBound lamH) (hlamG : 0 ≤ lamG) (hlamH : 0 ≤ lamH) :
    (zigzag G H e).SpectralBound (lamG + lamH + lamH ^ 2)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.step_sub
statement:
theorem step_sub (K : RegGraph) (f g : K.V → ℝ) (v : K.V) :
    K.step (fun w => f w - g w) v = K.step f v - K.step g v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.step_zigzag
statement:
theorem step_zigzag (f : (zigzag G H e).V → ℝ) (x : (zigzag G H e).V) :
    (zigzag G H e).step f x
      = cloudStep G H e (crossStep G (cloudStep G H e f)) x

name: Complexity.RegGraph.step_zigzag_decomp
statement:
theorem step_zigzag_decomp (f : (zigzag G H e).V → ℝ) :
    ip G f ((zigzag G H e).step f)
      = ip G (fun x => cloudPar G f x + cloudStep G H e (cloudPerp G f) x)
          (crossStep G (fun x => cloudPar G f x + cloudStep G H e (cloudPerp G f) x))

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_cloudFun
statement:
theorem sum_cloudFun (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) (v : G.V) :
    ∑ u : H.V, cloudFun G H e f v u = ∑ i : G.D, f (v, i)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_cloudMean
statement:
theorem sum_cloudMean (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ∑ v : G.V, cloudMean G f v = (∑ x : G.V × G.D, f x) / (G.deg : ℝ)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_cloudMean_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sum_cloudMean_eq_zero {f : G.V × G.D → ℝ} (hf : ∑ x : G.V × G.D, f x = 0) :
    ∑ v : G.V, cloudMean G f v = 0

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_cloudPerp
statement:
theorem sum_cloudPerp (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) (v : G.V) :
    ∑ i : G.D, cloudPerp G f (v, i) = 0

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_cloudStep
statement:
theorem sum_cloudStep (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) (v : G.V) :
    ∑ i : G.D, cloudStep G H e f (v, i) = ∑ i : G.D, f (v, i)

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_crossStep
statement:
theorem sum_crossStep (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ∑ x : G.V × G.D, crossStep G f x = ∑ x : G.V × G.D, f x

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_mul_step_comm
statement:
theorem sum_mul_step_comm (K : RegGraph) (f g : K.V → ℝ) :
    ∑ v : K.V, f v * K.step g v = ∑ v : K.V, K.step f v * g v

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_mul_step_le_of_spectralBound
statement:
theorem sum_mul_step_le_of_spectralBound (K : RegGraph) {lam : ℝ} (hK : K.SpectralBound lam)
    (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (g : K.V → ℝ) (hg : ∑ v : K.V, g v = 0) :
    ∑ v : K.V, g v * K.step g v ≤ lam * ∑ v : K.V, (g v) ^ 2

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_sq_cloudFun
statement:
theorem sum_sq_cloudFun (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) (v : G.V) :
    ∑ u : H.V, (cloudFun G H e f v u) ^ 2 = ∑ i : G.D, (f (v, i)) ^ 2

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_sq_cloudStep_cloudPerp_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_cloudStep_cloudPerp_le {lam : ℝ} (hH : H.SpectralBound lam)
    (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) (v : G.V) :
    ∑ i : G.D, (cloudStep G H e (cloudPerp G f) (v, i)) ^ 2
      ≤ lam ^ 2 * ∑ i : G.D, (cloudPerp G f (v, i)) ^ 2

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_sq_cloudStep_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_cloudStep_le {lam : ℝ} (hH : H.SpectralBound lam)
    (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) (v : G.V) (hv : ∑ i : G.D, f (v, i) = 0) :
    ∑ i : G.D, (cloudStep G H e f (v, i)) ^ 2 ≤ lam ^ 2 * ∑ i : G.D, (f (v, i)) ^ 2

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_sq_crossStep
statement:
theorem sum_sq_crossStep (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ∑ x : G.V × G.D, (crossStep G f x) ^ 2 = ∑ x : G.V × G.D, (f x) ^ 2

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_sq_crossStep_aux
statement:
theorem sum_sq_crossStep_aux (f : G.V × G.D → ℝ) :
    ∑ x : G.V × G.D, crossStep G f x * crossStep G f x
      = ∑ x : G.V × G.D, f x * f x

name: Complexity.RegGraph.sum_sq_eq_ip
statement:
theorem sum_sq_eq_ip (g : (zigzag G H e).V → ℝ) :
    ∑ v : (zigzag G H e).V, (g v) ^ 2 = ip G g g

statement: @[simp] theorem V_graph : F.graph.V = Fin (F.deg ^ 4)

name: Complexity.FinBase.baseVal_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseVal_apply (x : Fin (F.deg ^ 4)) (a : Fin F.deg) :
    F.baseVal x.val a.val = ((F.rot (x, a)).1.val, (F.rot (x, a)).2.val)

name: Complexity.FinBase.baseVal_lt
statement:
theorem baseVal_lt {x a : ℕ} (hx : x < F.deg ^ 4) (ha : a < F.deg) :
    (F.baseVal x a).1 < F.deg ^ 4 ∧ (F.baseVal x a).2 < F.deg

name: Complexity.FinBase.data_succ_apply
statement:
theorem data_succ_apply (k : ℕ) (v : Fin (F.size (k + 1))) (i : Fin (F.deg ^ 2))
    {us : Fin (F.size k) × (Fin 2 → Fin (F.deg ^ 2))} (hus : us = (F.vertName k).symm v)
    {ab : Fin F.deg × Fin F.deg} (hab : ab = F.dartName.symm i)
    {p : Fin (F.deg ^ 4) × Fin F.deg} (hp : p = F.rot (F.baseName.symm us.2, ab.1))
    {q : Fin (F.size k) × (Fin 2 → Fin (F.deg ^ 2))}
    (hq : q = ((F.graphAt k).power 2).rot (us.1, F.baseName p.1))
    {r : Fin (F.deg ^ 4) × Fin F.deg} (hr : r = F.rot (F.baseName.symm q.2, ab.2)) :
    (F.data (k + 1)).1 (v, i)
      = (F.vertName k (q.1, F.baseName r.1), F.dartName (r.2, p.2))

name: Complexity.FinBase.data_succ_apply'
statement:
theorem data_succ_apply' (k : ℕ) (v : Fin (F.size (k + 1))) (i : Fin (F.deg ^ 2))
    {us : Fin (F.size k) × (Fin 2 → Fin (F.deg ^ 2))} (hus : us = (F.vertName k).symm v)
    {ab : Fin F.deg × Fin F.deg} (hab : ab = F.dartName.symm i)
    {p : Fin (F.deg ^ 4) × Fin F.deg} (hp : p = F.rot (F.baseName.symm us.2, ab.1))
    {q₀ : Fin (F.size k) × Fin (F.deg ^ 2)}
    (hq₀ : q₀ = (F.data k).1 (us.1, F.baseName p.1 0))
    {q₁ : Fin (F.size k) × Fin (F.deg ^ 2)}
    (hq₁ : q₁ = (F.data k).1 (q₀.1, F.baseName p.1 1))
    {r : Fin (F.deg ^ 4) × Fin F.deg}
    (hr : r = F.rot (F.baseName.symm ![q₁.2, q₀.2], ab.2)) :
    (F.data (k + 1)).1 (v, i)
      = (F.vertName k (q₁.1, F.baseName r.1), F.dartName (r.2, p.2))

name: Complexity.FinBase.data_zero_apply
statement:
theorem data_zero_apply (v : Fin (F.size 0)) (i : Fin (F.deg ^ 2))
    {s : Fin 2 → Fin F.deg} (hs : s = F.zeroDartName.symm i)
    {p₀ : Fin (F.deg ^ 4) × Fin F.deg} (h0 : p₀ = F.rot (F.zeroVertName.symm v, s 0))
    {p₁ : Fin (F.deg ^ 4) × Fin F.deg} (h1 : p₁ = F.rot (p₀.1, s 1)) :
    (F.data 0).1 (v, i) = (F.zeroVertName p₁.1, F.zeroDartName ![p₁.2, p₀.2])

name: Complexity.FinBase.graphAt_zero

name: Complexity.FinBase.spectral_graphAt
statement:
theorem spectral_graphAt (F : FinBase) : ∀ k : ℕ, (F.graphAt k).SpectralBound (2 / 5)
  | 0 => by
      rw [graphAt_zero]
      exact RegGraph.spectralBound_relabel _ _
        (RegGraph.spectralBound_relabelV _ _ F.toBase.towerZero.spec)
  | k + 1 => by
      rw [graphAt_succ]
      exact RegGraph.spectralBound_relabel _ _
        (RegGraph.spectralBound_relabelV _ _
          (F.toBase.towerSuccOf ⟨F.graphAt k, by simp [toBase], spectral_graphAt F k⟩
            F.baseName).spec)

statement:
theorem satisfies_iff {φ : CNF} {a : (toGraph φ).Assignment}
    (e : Fin (toGraph φ).numEdges) :

      (clauseSat φ (edgeClause e.val) (a (clauseVertex φ (edgeClause e.val))) = true ∧
        a (clauseVertex φ (edgeClause e.val)) (edgePos e.val)
          = a (varVertex φ (litOf φ (edgeClause e.val) (edgePos e.val)).var) 0)

    (hfc : IsClose f (signOf (hadamard a)) ε)

name: Complexity.prob_input_reads
statement:
theorem prob_input_reads (a : Cube (k + t)) (f : BooleanFunction (k + t))

    1 - 2 * ε ≤ Pr[fun z : Cube (k + (k + t)) =>
      f (rightBlock z) * f (embedInput (leftBlock z) + rightBlock z)
        = chi (hadamard a (embedInput (leftBlock z)))]

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.TaggedFOInterpretation.coordEnv_lift
statement:
theorem coordEnv_lift (A : FinStruct V) (τ : Fin n → Fin tags)
    (κ : Fin n → Fin dim → Term V m) (σ : Env A.card m)
    (tag : Fin tags) (v : Env A.card dim) :
    coordEnv A (Fin.cons tag τ) (liftCoords κ) (envBlock σ v) =
      envCons ((elementEquiv A.card tags dim).symm (tag, v)) (coordEnv A τ κ σ)

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.TaggedFOInterpretation.pullbackWith_sat
statement:
theorem pullbackWith_sat (I : TaggedFOInterpretation V W tags dim) (A : FinStruct V)
    (φ : Formula W n) (τ : Fin n → Fin tags) (κ : Fin n → Fin dim → Term V m)
    (σ : Env A.card m) :
    (I.pullbackWith φ τ κ).Sat A σ ↔ φ.Sat (I.apply A) (coordEnv A τ κ σ)

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.TaggedFOInterpretation.relationEnv_evalTerms
statement:
theorem relationEnv_evalTerms (I : TaggedFOInterpretation V W tags dim) (A : FinStruct V)
    (τ : Fin n → Fin tags) (κ : Fin n → Fin dim → Term V m) (σ : Env A.card m)
    {arity : Nat} (ts : Fin arity → Term W n) :
    relationEnv (fun j => (ts j).eval (I.apply A) (coordEnv A τ κ σ)) =
      fun k => (I.termCoords κ (ts (finProdFinEquiv.symm k).1)
        (finProdFinEquiv.symm k).2).eval A σ

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.TaggedFOInterpretation.termCoords_eval
statement:
theorem termCoords_eval (I : TaggedFOInterpretation V W tags dim) (A : FinStruct V)
    (τ : Fin n → Fin tags) (κ : Fin n → Fin dim → Term V m) (σ : Env A.card m)
    (t : Term W n) :
    elementEquiv A.card tags dim (t.eval (I.apply A) (coordEnv A τ κ σ)) =
      (I.termTag τ t, fun j => (I.termCoords κ t j).eval A σ)

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.TaggedFOInterpretation.comp_coordEnv
statement:
theorem comp_coordEnv (A : FinStruct U) {arity : Nat}
    (args : Fin arity → Fin ((t₂ * t₁ ^ d₂) * A.card ^ (d₂ * d₁))) :
    coordEnv A (compTags (fun j => (elementEquiv A.card _ _ (args j)).1))
      (compCoords U arity d₁ d₂) (relationEnv args) =
        relationEnv (unflattenElement A.card t₁ d₁ t₂ d₂ ∘ args)

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.TaggedFOInterpretation.flatten_unflatten

    flattenElement card t₁ d₁ t₂ d₂ (unflattenElement card t₁ d₁ t₂ d₂ x) = x

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.TaggedFOInterpretation.unflatten_flatten

    unflattenElement card t₁ d₁ t₂ d₂ (flattenElement card t₁ d₁ t₂ d₂ x) = x

statement:

      φ.Sat (I.apply A) σ

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.numerical_sat_internal
statement:
theorem numerical_sat_internal {V : Vocabulary} {n : Nat} (A : FinStruct V)

    (args : Fin (predicates.get r).arity → Term (V.withNumerical predicates) n)
    (σ : Env A.card n) :
    (Formula.numerical predicates r args).Sat (A.withNumerical predicates) σ ↔
      (predicates.get r).Holds

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.Formula.add_sat
statement:
@[simp] theorem Formula.add_sat (A : FinStruct V) (x y z : Term V.withArithmetic n)
    (σ : Env A.card n) :
    (add x y z).Sat (A.withNumerical [.add, .mul]) σ ↔
      (x.eval (A.withNumerical [.add, .mul]) σ).val +
        (y.eval (A.withNumerical [.add, .mul]) σ).val =
          (z.eval (A.withNumerical [.add, .mul]) σ).val

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.Formula.bit_sat
statement:
@[simp] theorem Formula.bit_sat (A : FinStruct V) (x i : Term V.withBit n)
    (σ : Env A.card n) :
    (bit x i).Sat (A.withNumerical [.bit]) σ ↔
      (x.eval (A.withNumerical [.bit]) σ).val.testBit
        (i.eval (A.withNumerical [.bit]) σ).val = true

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.Formula.mul_sat
statement:
@[simp] theorem Formula.mul_sat (A : FinStruct V) (x y z : Term V.withArithmetic n)
    (σ : Env A.card n) :
    (mul x y z).Sat (A.withNumerical [.add, .mul]) σ ↔
      (x.eval (A.withNumerical [.add, .mul]) σ).val *
        (y.eval (A.withNumerical [.add, .mul]) σ).val =
          (z.eval (A.withNumerical [.add, .mul]) σ).val

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.Formula.numerical_sat
statement:
@[simp] theorem Formula.numerical_sat (A : FinStruct V)
    (predicates : List NumericalPredicate) (r : Fin predicates.length)
    (args : Fin (predicates.get r).arity → Term (V.withNumerical predicates) n)
    (σ : Env A.card n) :
    (numerical predicates r args).Sat (A.withNumerical predicates) σ ↔
      (predicates.get r).Holds (fun i => (Term.eval (A.withNumerical predicates) σ (args i)).val)

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.Formula.orderLt_sat
statement:
@[simp] theorem Formula.orderLt_sat (A : FinStruct V) (x y : Term V.withOrder n)
    (σ : Env A.card n) :
    (orderLt x y).Sat (A.withNumerical [.lt]) σ ↔
      (x.eval (A.withNumerical [.lt]) σ).val < (y.eval (A.withNumerical [.lt]) σ).val

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.Formula.withNumerical_sat

statement:
theorem checkCertificate_complete_internal {V : Vocabulary} (A : DecFinStruct V)
    {rctx : List Nat} {n : Nat} (φ : SOFormula V rctx n) :
    ∀ (h : φ.IsExistSO) (σ : Env A.card n) (ρ : DecREnv A.card rctx),
      φ.Sat A.toFinStruct σ ρ.toREnv →
        ∃ bits, φ.checkCertificate A h σ ρ bits = true

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.SOFormula.checkCertificate_sound_internal
statement:
theorem checkCertificate_sound_internal {V : Vocabulary} (A : DecFinStruct V)
    {rctx : List Nat} {n : Nat} (φ : SOFormula V rctx n) :
    ∀ (h : φ.IsExistSO) (σ : Env A.card n) (ρ : DecREnv A.card rctx) (bits : List Bool),
      φ.checkCertificate A h σ ρ bits = true →
        bits.length = DecREnv.encodingLength A.card φ.witnessArities ∧
          φ.Sat A.toFinStruct σ ρ.toREnv

statement:
theorem checkCertificate_length (A : DecFinStruct V) (φ : SOFormula V rctx n)
    (h : φ.IsExistSO) (σ : Env A.card n) (ρ : DecREnv A.card rctx) (bits : List Bool)
    (haccept : φ.checkCertificate A h σ ρ bits = true) :
    bits.length = DecREnv.encodingLength A.card φ.witnessArities

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.SOFormula.checkCertificate_matrix
statement:

    (h : φ.IsExistSO) (hm : φ.IsFOMatrix) (σ : Env A.card n)
    (ρ : DecREnv A.card rctx) (bits : List Bool) :
    φ.checkCertificate A h σ ρ bits = (bits.isEmpty && φ.evalMatrixB A hm σ ρ)

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.SOFormula.checkCertificate_ofFormula
statement:
theorem checkCertificate_ofFormula (A : DecFinStruct V) (φ : Formula V n)
    (σ : Env A.card n) (ρ : DecREnv A.card rctx) (bits : List Bool) :
    (ofFormula φ rctx).checkCertificate A (ofFormula_isExistSO φ rctx) σ ρ bits =
      (bits.isEmpty && Formula.evalB A σ φ)

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.SOFormula.checkCertificate_soExist_append
statement:
theorem checkCertificate_soExist_append (A : DecFinStruct V) {k : Nat}
    (φ : SOFormula V (k :: rctx) n) (h : φ.IsExistSO) (σ : Env A.card n)
    (ρ : DecREnv A.card rctx) (τ : DecREnv A.card [k]) (bits : List Bool) :
    (soExist k φ).checkCertificate A h σ ρ (τ.encode ++ bits) =
      φ.checkCertificate A h σ (ρ.cons (τ 0)) bits

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.SOFormula.checkCertificate_sound
statement:
theorem checkCertificate_sound (A : DecFinStruct V) (φ : SOFormula V rctx n)
    (h : φ.IsExistSO) (σ : Env A.card n) (ρ : DecREnv A.card rctx) (bits : List Bool)
    (haccept : φ.checkCertificate A h σ ρ bits = true) :

name: Complexity.DescriptiveComplexity.GraphQuery.disjointCopies_edge
statement:
theorem disjointCopies_edge (copies : Nat) (hcopies : 0 < copies)
    (A : FinStruct Vocabulary.graph) (x y : Fin (copies * A.card ^ 1)) :
    Edge ((disjointCopies copies hcopies).apply A) x y ↔
      (elementEquiv A.card copies 1 x).1 = (elementEquiv A.card copies 1 y).1 ∧
      Edge A ((elementEquiv A.card copies 1 x).2 0)
        ((elementEquiv A.card copies 1 y).2 0)

      (TaggedFOInterpretation.elementEquiv A.card 2 1 (args 0)).1 = 0 ∧
      (TaggedFOInterpretation.elementEquiv A.card 2 1 (args 1)).1 = 1 ∧
      A.rel 0 (fun j => (TaggedFOInterpretation.elementEquiv A.card 2 1 (args j)).2 0)

@[simp] theorem length_encode (frame : α → List Bool) (fs : List α) :
    (encode frame fs).length =
      fs.foldr (fun f n => 2 * (frame f).length + 2 + n) 0

name: Complexity.StackEncoding.length_encode_le
statement:
theorem length_encode_le (frame : α → List Bool) : ∀ (fs : List α) (B : ℕ),
    (∀ f ∈ fs, (frame f).length ≤ B) →
      (encode frame fs).length ≤ fs.length * (2 * B + 2)
  | [], _, _ => by simp
  | f :: fs, B, h => by
      have hf

theorem polynomialTimeOverhead_kolmogorov_transfer_internal
    {simulatorTapes sourceTapes : ℕ}
    {simulator : OracleTM simulatorTapes} {source : OracleTM sourceTapes}
    {compile : List Bool → List Bool} {constant : ℕ}
    {clock : TM.TimeOverhead}
    (hsim : simulator.SimulatesInTime source compile clock)
    (hlength : TM.HasAdditiveProgramOverhead compile constant)
    (hclock : TM.PolynomialTimeOverhead clock) :
    ∃ coefficient exponent,
      ∀ (oracle : BooleanOracle) (output : List Bool)
        (sourceTime bound : ℕ),
        source.timeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity oracle output sourceTime ≤
            (bound : WithTop ℕ) →
          simulator.timeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity oracle output
              (coefficient * (bound + sourceTime + 1) ^ exponent) ≤
            (bound + constant : ℕ)

statement:
theorem timeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity_pair_le_add_of_conditional_composition_internal
    {jointTapes conditionTapes resultTapes : ℕ}
    {jointMachine : TM jointTapes} {conditionMachine : TM conditionTapes}
    {resultMachine : OracleTM resultTapes}
    {compile : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool}
    {result condition : List Bool}
    {conditionTime resultTime jointTime conditionBound resultBound constant : ℕ}
    (hcompose : TimeBoundedConditionalPairCompositionAt jointMachine
      conditionMachine resultMachine compile result condition conditionTime
      resultTime jointTime conditionBound resultBound)
    (hlength : ∀ conditionProgram resultProgram,
      conditionProgram.length ≤ conditionBound →
      resultProgram.length ≤ resultBound →
      (compile conditionProgram resultProgram).length ≤
        resultProgram.length + conditionProgram.length + constant)
    (hconditionFinite : conditionMachine.timeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
      condition conditionTime ≠ ⊤)
    (hresultFinite :
      resultMachine.randomAccessConditionalTimeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
        result condition resultTime ≠ ⊤)
    (hconditionBound : conditionMachine.timeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
      condition conditionTime ≤ (conditionBound : WithTop ℕ))
    (hresultBound :
      resultMachine.randomAccessConditionalTimeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
        result condition resultTime ≤ (resultBound : WithTop ℕ)) :
    jointMachine.timeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
        (pair result condition) jointTime ≤
      resultMachine.randomAccessConditionalTimeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
            result condition resultTime +
          conditionMachine.timeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
            condition conditionTime +
        (constant : WithTop ℕ)

    {jointTapes firstTapes secondTapes : ℕ}
    {jointMachine : TM jointTapes} {firstMachine : TM firstTapes}
    {secondMachine : OracleTM secondTapes}
    {compile : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool}
    {firstOutput secondOutput : List Bool}
    {firstTime secondTime jointTime firstBound secondBound combinedBound : ℕ}
    (hcompose : TimeBoundedProgramCompositionAt jointMachine firstMachine
      secondMachine compile firstOutput secondOutput firstTime secondTime
      jointTime firstBound secondBound)
    (hlength : ∀ firstProgram secondProgram,
      firstProgram.length ≤ firstBound →
      secondProgram.length ≤ secondBound →
      (compile firstProgram secondProgram).length ≤ combinedBound)
    (hfirst : firstMachine.timeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
      firstOutput firstTime ≤ (firstBound : WithTop ℕ))
    (hsecond : secondMachine.randomAccessConditionalTimeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
        secondOutput firstOutput secondTime ≤ (secondBound : WithTop ℕ)) :
    jointMachine.timeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
        (pair firstOutput secondOutput) jointTime ≤
      (combinedBound : WithTop ℕ)

      conditionalMachine clock loss)
    {first condition : List Bool}

      constant : ℕ}
    (hsize : first.length + condition.length ≤ time)
    (hclock : conditionTime ≤ clock time)
    (hcompose : TimeBoundedConditionalPairCompositionAt ordinaryMachine
      ordinaryMachine alternativeMachine compile first condition conditionTime
      alternativeTime time conditionBound alternativeBound)
    (hlength : ∀ conditionProgram alternativeProgram,
      conditionProgram.length ≤ conditionBound →
      alternativeProgram.length ≤ alternativeBound →
      (compile conditionProgram alternativeProgram).length ≤
        alternativeProgram.length + conditionProgram.length + constant)
    (hconditionFinite : ordinaryMachine.timeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
      condition conditionTime ≠ ⊤)
    (halternativeFinite :
      alternativeMachine.randomAccessConditionalTimeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
        first condition alternativeTime ≠ ⊤)
    (hconditionBound : ordinaryMachine.timeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
      condition conditionTime ≤ (conditionBound : WithTop ℕ))
    (halternativeBound :
      alternativeMachine.randomAccessConditionalTimeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
        first condition alternativeTime ≤ (alternativeBound : WithTop ℕ)) :
    conditionalMachine.randomAccessConditionalTimeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
        first condition (clock time) ≤
      alternativeMachine.randomAccessConditionalTimeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
            first condition alternativeTime +
          ordinaryMachine.computationalDepthBetween

        first condition alternativeTime ≤ (alternativeBound : WithTop ℕ)) :

    {alternativeMachine : OracleTM alternativeTapes}
    {clock loss : ℕ → ℕ}

      conditionalMachine clock loss)
    {first condition : List Bool}

    (hsize : first.length + condition.length ≤ time)

          (pair first condition) time ≤
        OracleTM.randomAccessConditionalTimeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
              alternativeMachine first condition alternativeTime +
            ordinaryMachine.timeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
              condition conditionTime +
          (upperLoss : WithTop ℕ)) :
    conditionalMachine.randomAccessConditionalTimeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
        first condition (clock time) ≤
      OracleTM.randomAccessConditionalTimeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
            alternativeMachine first condition alternativeTime +
          ordinaryMachine.computationalDepthBetween
            condition conditionTime (clock time) +
        (upperLoss : WithTop ℕ) + (loss time : WithTop ℕ)

        inst.complexity conditionalMachine +
            ordinaryMachine.timeBoundedKolmogorovComplexity
              inst.condition inst.time +

    Compatible (plan clock pairUpperLoss correction) ordinaryMachine
      conditionalMachine (ordinaryParameters clock) (conditionalParameters clock)

statement:
theorem losses_le_slackExponent_internal
    {clock : ℕ → ℕ} (hclock : Monotone clock)
    (additive compilerLoss : ℕ) (inst : MINCKT.Instance) :
    Nat.log 2 (clockIterate clock 2 (paddedTime inst)) +
          logarithmicSoILoss clock additive
            (clockIterate clock 2 (paddedTime inst)) +
        correction clock compilerLoss inst ≤
      slackExponent clock additive compilerLoss inst.output.length

      clock time ≤ coefficient * (time + 1) ^ exponent) :

statement:

    (outputLength conditionLength time : ℕ) :
    2 ^ slackExponent clock additive compilerLoss
          outputLength conditionLength time ≤

        (clockIterate clock 3

        (clockIterate clock 4

        2 ^ additive * 2 ^ compilerLoss

    (hsource : ∀ inst : MINKT.Instance, ∀ optimum : ℕ,

theorem exists_hybridGap_ge_average_internal
    {seedLength outputLength : ℕ}
    (generator : BitGenerator seedLength outputLength)
    (test : Finset (Fin outputLength → Bool)) {advantage : ℚ}
    (houtputLength : 0 < outputLength)
    (hadvantage : advantage ≤
      generator.generatedAcceptanceProbability test -
        uniformAcceptanceProbability test) :
    ∃ step < outputLength,
      advantage / (outputLength : ℚ) ≤ generator.hybridGap test step

name: Complexity.BitGenerator.exists_orientation_of_distinguishingAdvantage_internal

    (hadvantage : advantage ≤ generator.distinguishingAdvantage test) :
    ∃ complement : Bool,
      advantage ≤
        generator.generatedAcceptanceProbability
            (orientTest test complement) -
          uniformAcceptanceProbability (orientTest test complement)

theorem successProbability_eq_half_add_gap_internal
    {background : Type*} [Fintype background] [Nonempty background]
    (target : background → Bool) (testAt : background → Bool → Bool) :
    successProbability target testAt =
      1 / 2 + targetAcceptanceProbability target testAt -
        candidateAcceptanceProbability testAt

    (later : laterCoordinates current → Bool) (candidate : Bool)

          ((design.generator hardFunction).testAtCandidate test current

name: Complexity.NWDesign.exists_fixed_reconstruction_of_randomTest_internal
statement:
theorem exists_fixed_reconstruction_of_randomTest_internal
    {outputLength inputLength seedLength tapes time threshold budget : ℕ}
    {design : NWDesign outputLength inputLength seedLength}
    {hardFunction : (Fin inputLength → Bool) → Bool}
    {machine : TM tapes} {test : Finset (Fin outputLength → Bool)}
    {density : ℚ} (houtputLength : 0 < outputLength)
    (hlow : (design.generator hardFunction).HasLowTimeBoundedComplexity
      machine time threshold)
    (hrandom : BitGenerator.IsTimeBoundedRandomTest
      test machine time threshold)
    (hdense : BitGenerator.IsDenseTest test density)
    (hbudget : design.HasOverlapBudget budget) :
    ∃ (complement : Bool) (current : Fin outputLength)
        (advice : design.ReconstructionAdvice current),
      1 / 2 + density / (outputLength : ℚ) ≤
          design.reconstructionAgreementProbability hardFunction
            (BitGenerator.orientTest test complement) current advice ∧
        design.reconstructionDataBitsAt current ≤
          budget + (seedLength - inputLength) + 1

statement:
theorem whileFoldEnvelope {α σ : Type*} {indexBound valueBound test : ℕ}
    {body : Cmd} (Inv : List α → σ → Store → Prop)
    (advance : σ → α → σ) (bodySteps bodyCost : α → ℕ)
    (hstore : ∀ (items : List α) (state : σ) (store : Store),
      Inv items state store → StoreEnvelope indexBound valueBound store)
    (hnil : ∀ (state : σ) (store : Store),
      Inv [] state store → store test = 0)
    (hcons : ∀ (item : α) (rest : List α) (state : σ) (store : Store),
      Inv (item :: rest) state store → store test ≠ 0)
    (hbody : ∀ (item : α) (rest : List α) (state : σ) (store : Store),
      Inv (item :: rest) state store →
        ∃ next,
          MeasuredRuns body store next (bodySteps item) (bodyCost item)
            (envelopeSpace indexBound valueBound) ∧
          Inv rest (advance state item) next)
    {items : List α} {state : σ} {initial : Store}
    (hinv : Inv items state initial) :
    ∃ final,
      MeasuredRuns (.whileNonzero test body) initial final
        (whileFoldSteps bodySteps items)
        (whileFoldCost (valueWidth valueBound) bodyCost items)
        (envelopeSpace indexBound valueBound) ∧
      Inv [] (items.foldl advance state) final

theorem whileNonzeroEnvelope {indexBound valueBound test : ℕ} {body : Cmd}
    {initial middle final : Store}
    {bodySteps loopSteps bodyCost loopCost : ℕ}
    (htest : initial test ≠ 0)
    (hstore : StoreEnvelope indexBound valueBound initial)
    (hbody : MeasuredRuns body initial middle bodySteps bodyCost
      (envelopeSpace indexBound valueBound))
    (hloop : MeasuredRuns (.whileNonzero test body) middle final loopSteps loopCost
      (envelopeSpace indexBound valueBound)) :
    MeasuredRuns (.whileNonzero test body) initial final
      (bodySteps + loopSteps + 2)
      (3 * valueWidth valueBound + bodyCost + loopCost)
      (envelopeSpace indexBound valueBound)

statement:
theorem marshalLoopOps_control_internal (n : ℕ) (store : Structured.Store)
    (hcursor : 0 < store stateReg)
    (hzero : store (zeroReg n) = 0) :
    let final := Structured.Basic.execList (marshalLoopOps n) store
    final stateReg = store stateReg - 1 ∧
      final (zeroReg n) = 0 ∧
      final (oneReg n) = 1 ∧
      final (tapeCountReg n) = n + 2 ∧
      final (stateScratchReg n) = cellBase n ∧
      0 < final (cellReg n (inputTape n) (store stateReg))

    (hzero : store (zeroReg n) = 0)
    (hfree : store stateReg ∉ captureRegs n)
    (hdata : cellBase n ≤ reg) :
    Structured.Basic.execList (marshalLoopOps n) store reg =
      Function.update
        (Function.update store (store stateReg) 0)
        (cellReg n (inputTape n) (store stateReg))
        (store (store stateReg) + 1) reg

name: Complexity.RAM.TMConfig.Sparse.marshalLoop_exec_internal
statement:
theorem marshalLoop_exec_internal (n cursor : ℕ)
    (store : Structured.Store)
    (hcursor : store stateReg = cursor)
    (hzero : store (zeroReg n) = 0)
    (hone : store (oneReg n) = 1)
    (hcount : store (tapeCountReg n) = n + 2)
    (hbase : store (stateScratchReg n) = cellBase n) :
    ∃ final cost space,
      Structured.Exec (marshalLoop n) store final
        (marshalLoopSteps n cursor) cost space ∧
      final stateReg = 0 ∧
      final (zeroReg n) = 0 ∧
      final (oneReg n) = 1 ∧
      final (tapeCountReg n) = n + 2 ∧
      final (stateScratchReg n) = cellBase n

statement:
theorem compileAt_correct_internal
    {cmd : Cmd} {initial final : Store} {steps cost space : ℕ}
    (hexec : Exec cmd initial final steps cost space)
    (pre suffix : Program) :
    let P := pre ++ cmd.compileAt pre.length ++ suffix
    let start : Cfg := { pc := pre.length, regs := initial }
    run P steps start =
        { pc := pre.length + cmd.codeSize, regs := final } ∧
      logTimeUpto P steps start = cost ∧
      spaceUpto P steps start = space

      (run (sqProg k) (k + 1) sqStart).regs 1 = 2 ^ 2 ^ k ∧
      unitTimeUpto (sqProg k) (k + 1) sqStart = k + 1 ∧

          { pc := 0, regs := inputStore bits } ≤ spaceBound bits.length ∧

          lengthReg = weight bits

theorem pairValidateTM_lift_hoareTime_internal (workTapes : ℕ) (bits : List Bool) :
    (pairValidateTM.liftTM workTapes).HoareTime
      (fun inp work out =>
        inp = Tape.init (bits.map Γ.ofBool) ∧
        work = (fun _ => Tape.init []) ∧
        out = Tape.init [])
      (fun inp work out =>
        AllTapesWF inp work out ∧
        inp.cells = (Tape.init (bits.map Γ.ofBool)).cells ∧
        inp.head ≤ bits.length + 2 ∧
        (∀ i, work i = (Tape.init []).move Dir3.right) ∧
        out.head ≤ bits.length + 2 ∧
        (bits ∈ validPairEncoding → out.cells 1 = Γ.one) ∧
        (bits ∉ validPairEncoding → out.cells 1 = Γ.zero))
      (bits.length + 2)

theorem select_compiled {count test one indexBound valueBound : ℕ}
    (branch : Fin count → Cmd) (initial final : Store)
    {code branchSteps branchCost : ℕ}
    (hcode : code < count) (htest : initial test = code)
    (hone : initial one = 1) (hne : test ≠ one)
    (htestIndex : test < indexBound)
    (hinitial : StoreEnvelope indexBound valueBound initial)
    (hbranch : MeasuredRuns (branch ⟨code, hcode⟩) (cleared initial test)
      final branchSteps branchCost (envelopeSpace indexBound valueBound)) :
    ∃ cost space,
      Exec (select count test one branch) initial final
        (stepCount code branchSteps) cost space ∧
      run (select count test one branch).compile (stepCount code branchSteps)
          { pc := 0, regs := initial } =
        { pc := (select count test one branch).codeSize, regs := final } ∧
      Halted (select count test one branch).compile
        (run (select count test one branch).compile (stepCount code branchSteps)
          { pc := 0, regs := initial }) ∧
      logTimeUpto (select count test one branch).compile
          (stepCount code branchSteps) { pc := 0, regs := initial } ≤
        costBound code branchCost (valueWidth valueBound) ∧
      spaceUpto (select count test one branch).compile
          (stepCount code branchSteps) { pc := 0, regs := initial } ≤
        envelopeSpace indexBound valueBound

      logTimeUpto compiled (stepCount bits.length)
          { pc := 0, regs := inputStore bits } ≤ timeBound bits.length ∧
      spaceUpto compiled (stepCount bits.length)
          { pc := 0, regs := inputStore bits } ≤ spaceBound bits.length ∧
      ((run compiled (stepCount bits.length)
          { pc := 0, regs := inputStore bits }).regs verdictReg = 1 ↔
        bits ∈ Syntax.language)

name: Complexity.RAM.Structured.ThreeSATSyntax.program_performance

    ∃ final cost space,
      Exec program (inputStore bits) final (stepCount bits.length) cost space ∧
      cost ≤ timeBound bits.length ∧ space ≤ spaceBound bits.length ∧
      final verdictReg = Input.bitValue
        (Syntax.accept (bits.foldl Syntax.bitStep Syntax.bitStart))

theorem loopTM_iteration_halt (tmBody tmTest : TM n)
    {t_body : ℕ} {c_body_start c_body_end : Cfg n tmBody.Q}
    (hreach_body : tmBody.reachesIn t_body c_body_start c_body_end)
    (hhalt_body : c_body_end.state = tmBody.qhalt)
    {t_test : ℕ} {c_test_end : Cfg n tmTest.Q}
    (hreach_test : tmTest.reachesIn t_test
      { state := tmTest.qstart,
        input := transitionInput c_body_end.input,
        work := fun i => transitionTape (c_body_end.work i),
        output := transitionTape c_body_end.output }
      c_test_end)
    (hhalt_test : c_test_end.state = tmTest.qhalt)
    {p : ℕ}
    (hcell0 : (transitionTape c_test_end.output).cells 0 = Γ.start)
    (hnostart : ∀ j, j ≥ 1 →
      (transitionTape c_test_end.output).cells j ≠ Γ.start)
    (hhead : (transitionTape c_test_end.output).head = p)
    (hcell1 : (transitionTape c_test_end.output).cells 1 = Γ.one) :
    ∃ c_final,
      (loopTM tmBody tmTest).reachesIn (t_body + 1 + t_test + 1 + (p + 1) + 1)
        (loopBodyWrap tmBody tmTest c_body_start) c_final ∧
      (loopTM tmBody tmTest).halted c_final ∧
      c_final.output.cells 1 = Γ.one

    c.output.cells 0 = Γ.start →
    (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.output.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
    c.output.head = p →
    ∃ c_check,
      (loopTM tmBody tmTest).reachesIn (p + 1) c c_check ∧
      c_check.state = Sum.inr (Sum.inl LoopPhase.check) ∧
      c_check.output.head = 1 ∧
      c_check.output.cells = c.output.cells

theorem loopTM_hoareTime_indexed (tmBody tmTest : TM n)
    {E : ℕ → TapePred n} {post : TapePred n} {N b : ℕ}
    {idx : Tape → (Fin n → Tape) → Tape → ℕ}
    (hidx : ∀ j inp work out, E j inp work out → idx inp work out = j)
    (hstep : ∀ j, j < N → ∀ inp work out, E j inp work out →
      ∃ inp' work' out' t, t ≤ b ∧
        (loopTM tmBody tmTest).reachesIn t
          ⟨(loopTM tmBody tmTest).qstart, inp, work, out⟩
          ⟨(loopTM tmBody tmTest).qstart, inp', work', out'⟩ ∧
        E (j + 1) inp' work' out')
    (hstop : ∀ inp work out, E N inp work out →
      ∃ c' t, t ≤ b ∧
        (loopTM tmBody tmTest).reachesIn t
          ⟨(loopTM tmBody tmTest).qstart, inp, work, out⟩ c' ∧
        (loopTM tmBody tmTest).halted c' ∧ post c'.input c'.work c'.output) :
    (loopTM tmBody tmTest).HoareTime
      (E 0) post ((N + 1) * b)

    (bigSeqTM ms).HoareTime

    (hms : ∀ k, (hk : k < ms.length) →
      ms[k].HoareTime (fun inp work out => inp = I ∧ work = W k ∧ out = O k)
        (fun inp work out => inp = I ∧ work = W (k + 1) ∧ out = O (k + 1)) b) :
    (bigSeqTM ms).HoareTime
      (fun inp work out => inp = I ∧ work = W 0 ∧ out = O 0)
      (fun inp work out => inp = I ∧ work = W ms.length ∧ out = O ms.length)

      (∀ k, (hk : k < ms.length) →
        ms[k].HoareTime (fun inp work out => inp = I k ∧ work = W k ∧ out = O k)
          (fun inp work out => inp = I (k + 1) ∧ work = W (k + 1) ∧ out = O (k + 1)) b) →
      (bigSeqTM ms).HoareTime
        (fun inp work out => inp = I 0 ∧ work = W 0 ∧ out = O 0)

    {t : ℕ} {c' : Cfg n onBlank.Q}

    (hinp : inp.read ≠ Γ.start) (hwork : ∀ i, (work i).read ≠ Γ.start)

      { state := onBlank.qstart, input := inp, work := work, output := out } c')
    (hhalt : onBlank.halted c') :
    ∃ C,
      (branchWorkBlankTM idx onBlank onNonblank).reachesIn (t + 1)
        { state := (branchWorkBlankTM idx onBlank onNonblank).qstart
          input := inp

statement:
theorem trace_of_det_prefix {N : NTM n} {t : ℕ} {c c' : Cfg n N.Q}
    (hreach : (N.det false).ReachesInVia N.BranchesAgreeAt t c c')
    (s : ℕ) (choices : Fin (s + t) → Bool) :
    N.trace (s + t) choices c =
      N.trace s (fun i => choices ⟨i.val + t, by omega⟩) c'

name: Complexity.NTM.trace_succ_det
statement:
theorem trace_succ_det {N : NTM n} {c : Cfg n N.Q} {T : ℕ}
    (choices : Fin (T + 1) → Bool) (hne : c.state ≠ N.qhalt) :
    N.trace (T + 1) choices c =
      N.trace T (fun i => choices ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩)
        (((N.det (choices ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ T⟩)).step c).get
          (by simp [TM.step, det, hne]))

statement:
theorem Scatter1MidInv.done {k : ℕ} {t : Tape} {w : Fin k → Tape}
    {wact : Fin k → Γw × Dir3} {M : ℕ} (h : Scatter1MidInv t w wact M (M + 1))
    (p : ℕ) (hp1 : 1 ≤ p) (hpM : p ≤ M) (j : Fin k) :
    t.cells (headBitCell k p j)
        = (if (scatterInterWork (w j) (wact j)).head = p then Γ.one else Γ.zero) ∧
      t.cells (symCell k p j) = (encSymΓ ((scatterInterWork (w j) (wact j)).cells p)).1 ∧
      t.cells (symCell k p j + 1) = (encSymΓ ((scatterInterWork (w j) (wact j)).cells p)).2

name: Complexity.NTM.SingleTape.commit_step
statement:
theorem commit_step {k : ℕ} (N : NTM k) (q' : N.Q) (oW : Γw) (oD iD : Dir3)
    (iSym oSym : Γ) (b : Bool) (c1 : Cfg 1 (SimQ k N.Q))
    (hst : c1.state = SimQ.commit (q', oW, oD, iD, iSym, oSym)) :
    (singleTapeSim N).trace 1 (fun _ => b) c1 =
      { state := SimQ.run q',
        input := c1.input.move
          (if iSym = Γ.start then TM.idleDir c1.input.read else safeDir c1.input.read iD),
        work := fun i => (c1.work i).writeAndMove
          ((TM.readBackWrite ((c1.work 0).read) : Γw) : Γ) (TM.idleDir ((c1.work 0).read)),
        output := c1.output.writeAndMove
          ((if oSym = Γ.start then TM.readBackWrite c1.output.read else oW : Γw) : Γ)
          (if oSym = Γ.start then TM.idleDir c1.output.read else safeDir c1.output.read oD) }

theorem corr_iterate {k : ℕ} (N : NTM k) (hk : 1 ≤ k) {M : ℕ}
    {c1 : Cfg 1 (SimQ k N.Q)} {c : Cfg k N.Q}
    (hcorr : Corr N M c1 c) (g : ℕ → Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ (m M' : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Bool),
      Corr N M' ((singleTapeSim N).trace m (fun i => F i.val) c1)
        (N.trace t (fun i => g i.val) c)
        ∧ M' ≤ M + t ∧ m ≤ t * macroBound k (M + t)

name: Complexity.NTM.SingleTape.corr_macroStep
Complexity.NTM.SingleTape.corr_macroStep_explicit
statement:
theorem corr_macroStep_explicit {k : ℕ} (N : NTM k) (hk : 1 ≤ k) {M : ℕ}
    {c1 : Cfg 1 (SimQ k N.Q)} {c : Cfg k N.Q}
    (hcorr : Corr N M c1 c) (hne : c.state ≠ N.qhalt) (b : Bool) :
    Corr N (M + 1)
        ((singleTapeSim N).trace
          (1 + 3 * k * M + 1 + blockStart k (M + 1)
            + (3 * k * (M + 1) + 1) + (3 * k * (M + 1) + 1) + 1) (fun _ => b) c1)
        (N.trace 1 (fun _ => b) c)

name: Complexity.NTM.SingleTape.corr_trace_macroPos
statement:
theorem corr_trace_macroPos {k : ℕ} (N : NTM k) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (ch : ℕ → Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    ∀ t : ℕ,
      (∀ s, s < t →
        (N.trace s (fun i => inducedChoices k ch i.val) (N.initCfg x)).state ≠ N.qhalt) →
      Corr N t
        ((singleTapeSim N).trace (macroPos k t) (fun i => ch i.val)
          ((singleTapeSim N).initCfg x))
        (N.trace t (fun i => inducedChoices k ch i.val) (N.initCfg x))

name: Complexity.NTM.SingleTape.encSymW_toΓ_eq_encSymΓ
statement:
theorem encSymW_toΓ_eq_encSymΓ (s : Γw) :
    (encSymW s).1.toΓ = (encSymΓ s.toΓ).1 ∧ (encSymW s).2.toΓ = (encSymΓ s.toΓ).2

name: Complexity.NTM.SingleTape.gather_acc_eq
statement:
theorem gather_acc_eq {k : ℕ} {t : Tape} {w : Fin k → Tape} {M : ℕ}
    (hinv : SimInvAt k t w M) :
    (fun j => if 1 ≤ (w j).head ∧ (w j).head ≤ M then (w j).read else Γ.start)
      = (fun j : Fin k => (w j).read)

name: Complexity.NTM.SingleTape.gather_sentinel
statement:
theorem gather_sentinel {k : ℕ} (N : NTM k) (bb : Bool) (q : N.Q) (acc : Fin k → Γ)
    (iSym oSym : Γ) (pos : SweepPos k) (rf : Bool) (pending : Γ) (c1 : Cfg 1 (SimQ k N.Q))
    (hst : c1.state = SimQ.gather (q, acc, iSym, oSym, pos, rf, pending))
    (hblank : (c1.work 0).read = Γ.blank) :
    (singleTapeSim N).trace 1 (fun _ => bb) c1 =
      { state := SimQ.rewind ((N.δ bb q iSym acc oSym).1,
          (fun i => ((N.δ bb q iSym acc oSym).2.1 i, (N.δ bb q iSym acc oSym).2.2.2.2.1 i)),
          ((N.δ bb q iSym acc oSym).2.2.1, (N.δ bb q iSym acc oSym).2.2.2.2.2),
          (N.δ bb q iSym acc oSym).2.2.2.1, iSym, oSym, (fun j => decide (acc j = Γ.start))),
        input := c1.input.move (TM.idleDir c1.input.read),
        work := fun i => (c1.work i).writeAndMove Γw.blank.toΓ Dir3.left,
        output := c1.output.writeAndMove (TM.readBackWrite c1.output.read).toΓ
          (TM.idleDir c1.output.read) }

name: Complexity.NTM.SingleTape.gather_sweep_no_sentinel
statement:
theorem gather_sweep_no_sentinel {k : ℕ} (N : NTM k) (bb : Bool) {M : ℕ} {w : Fin k → Tape}
    (c_g : Cfg 1 (SimQ k N.Q))
    (hg0 : ∃ d, c_g.state = SimQ.gather d)
    (hhead : (c_g.work 0).head = 1)
    (hinv : SimInvAt k (c_g.work 0) w M)
    (his : c_g.input.read ≠ Γ.start) (hos : c_g.output.read ≠ Γ.start) :
    ∀ i, i < 3 * k * M →
      (∃ d, ((singleTapeSim N).trace i (fun _ => bb) c_g).state = SimQ.gather d) ∧
      (((singleTapeSim N).trace i (fun _ => bb) c_g).work 0).read ≠ Γ.blank

name: Complexity.NTM.SingleTape.gather_sweep_step1
statement:
theorem gather_sweep_step1 {k : ℕ} (N : NTM k) (bb : Bool) (d : GatherData k N.Q)
    (c : Cfg 1 (SimQ k N.Q)) (hst : c.state = SimQ.gather d)
    (hb : (c.work 0).read ≠ Γ.blank) (hs : (c.work 0).read ≠ Γ.start)
    (his : c.input.read ≠ Γ.start) (hos : c.output.read ≠ Γ.start) :
    ∃ d', (singleTapeSim N).trace 1 (fun _ => bb) c =
      { state := SimQ.gather d', input := c.input,
        work := fun _ => { (c.work 0) with head := (c.work 0).head + 1 },
        output := c.output }

name: Complexity.NTM.SingleTape.gather_trace1
statement:
theorem gather_trace1 {k : ℕ} (N : NTM k) (d : GatherData k N.Q) (b : Bool)
    (c1 : Cfg 1 (SimQ k N.Q)) (hst : c1.state = SimQ.gather d) :
    (singleTapeSim N).trace 1 (fun _ => b) c1 =
      (let r := gatherStep N b d c1.input.read ((c1.work 0).read) c1.output.read
       { state := r.1, input := c1.input.move r.2.2.2.1,
         work := fun i => (c1.work i).writeAndMove (r.2.1 i) (r.2.2.2.2.1 i),
         output := c1.output.writeAndMove r.2.2.1 r.2.2.2.2.2 } : Cfg 1 (SimQ k N.Q))

name: Complexity.NTM.SingleTape.gather_triple
statement:
theorem gather_triple {k : ℕ} (N : NTM k) (bb : Bool)
    (q : N.Q) (acc : Fin k → Γ) (iSym oSym : Γ) (rf₀ : Bool) (pending₀ : Γ)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j < k) (c1 : Cfg 1 (SimQ k N.Q))
    (hst : c1.state = SimQ.gather (q, acc, iSym, oSym, (⟨j, by omega⟩, 0), rf₀, pending₀))
    (his : c1.input.read ≠ Γ.start) (hos : c1.output.read ≠ Γ.start)
    (hb0 : (c1.work 0).cells ((c1.work 0).head) ≠ Γ.blank)
    (hb1 : (c1.work 0).cells ((c1.work 0).head + 1) ≠ Γ.blank)
    (hb2 : (c1.work 0).cells ((c1.work 0).head + 2) ≠ Γ.blank)
    (hs0 : (c1.work 0).cells ((c1.work 0).head) ≠ Γ.start)
    (hs1 : (c1.work 0).cells ((c1.work 0).head + 1) ≠ Γ.start)
    (hs2 : (c1.work 0).cells ((c1.work 0).head + 2) ≠ Γ.start) :
    (singleTapeSim N).trace 3 (fun _ => bb) c1 =
      { state := SimQ.gather (q,
          (if (c1.work 0).cells ((c1.work 0).head) = Γ.one then
             Function.update acc ⟨j, hj⟩ (decSymΓ ((c1.work 0).cells ((c1.work 0).head + 1))
               ((c1.work 0).cells ((c1.work 0).head + 2)))
           else acc),
          iSym, oSym, (⟨if j + 1 < k then j + 1 else 0, by split <;> omega⟩, 0),
          decide ((c1.work 0).cells ((c1.work 0).head) = Γ.one),
          (c1.work 0).cells ((c1.work 0).head + 1)),
        input := c1.input, output := c1.output,
        work := fun _ => { c1.work 0 with head := (c1.work 0).head + 3 } }

name: Complexity.NTM.SingleTape.halted_of_corr
Complexity.NTM.SingleTape.halted_singleTapeSim_of_trace_qhalt
statement:
theorem halted_singleTapeSim_of_trace_qhalt {k : ℕ} (N : NTM k) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (ch : ℕ → Bool)
    (x : List Bool) (Tn : ℕ)
    (hhalt : (N.trace Tn (fun i => inducedChoices k ch i.val) (N.initCfg x)).state
      = N.qhalt) :
    ∃ m ≤ Tn * macroBound k Tn + 1,
      (singleTapeSim N).halted
        ((singleTapeSim N).trace m (fun i => ch i.val) ((singleTapeSim N).initCfg x)) ∧
      (((singleTapeSim N).trace m (fun i => ch i.val)
          ((singleTapeSim N).initCfg x)).output.cells 1 = Γ.one
        ↔ (N.trace Tn (fun i => inducedChoices k ch i.val)
            (N.initCfg x)).output.cells 1 = Γ.one)
